title: Wirtgen Technical Trainer & Communicator
description:
Summary of Primary Functions

This individual will be responsible for the communications of technical issues to both Deere & technicians. The Wirtgen Technical Trainer & Communicator will work closely with John Deere and internal customers to support the ongoing service and support program for Dobbs Equipment. This position is responsible for directing, developing, and overseeing the development of technicians & technical data at the corporate level to ensure the attainment of the company growth and profitability objectives are met. It is imperative for this position to develop consistency in product support expectations across all Dobbs Equipment branches. It is critical that this role provides cross functional direction, training, and motivation of Service Department Personnel. The Wirtgen Technical Trainer / Communicator reports directly to the Corporate Product Support Manager.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities: May include some or all of the following. Other duties may be assigned.

  • Work as liaison with manufacturers and all departments regarding product support issues.
  • Analyze product issues and provide support for parts/service/sales
  • Research product issues using DTAC, technical manuals, business system, and troubleshooting techniques to help resolve issues
  • Provide technical communications and updates for DTAC, monitor case status, and ensure timely closure of open cases.
  • Provide timely communication of solutions to Service/Parts/Sales & manufacturers
  • Advise customers of all pertinent technical data to ensure customer satisfaction or product repairs
  • Manage technical tooling for service departments
  • Record solutions and maintain database of repairs
  • Remains Capstone current with new machine training
  • Delivers Capstone & other technical training to Service Technicians

Qualifications: The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required.

  • Individual must be proficient in cross functional leadership, customer focused, analytical and comfortable communicating with customers.
  • Highly developed technical abilities across Heavy Equipment line – electrical / hydraulic / powertrain / fuel systems, ect…

Technical Skills & Knowledge:

  • Minimum 5 years or more of management responsibility in product support areas within the Construction/Forestry industry
  • Must have competence in Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Outlook and quickly adapt to new software systems.
  • Must have a great deal of flexibility to handle the changing work environment
  • Must be mature, team orientated and possess a positive attitude
  • Must have good interpersonal skills and strong communication skillsets
  • Must be able to handle multiple projects simultaneously
  • Must proactively determine customer needs and exceed their expectations
  • Must adhere to ethical principles, has sound character and honesty
  • The ideal candidate has an analytical bias, strong personal skills and is comfortable managing service technician personnel.
  • Must be able to comprehend and present complex technical data for the purpose of training employees
  • Must have knowledge of construction equipment dealer business practices, ideally including the practices followed at John Deere dealerships, is preferred.
  • Must remain current on all Certifications required to lead & instruct Capstone & technical training

Education: Formal education or training required to perform the essential functions of the job. Includes degrees, certifications, licenses and/or registration requirements.

  • Degree in a Business/Management discipline or equivalent experience.
  • Capstone Certifications Required, ongoing training provided.

Work Environment:

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is occasionally exposed to wet and/or humid conditions, moving mechanical parts, and outside weather conditions. The noise level in the work environment is usually quiet.

Physical Demands:

The physical demands described here represent those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is continuously required to:

  • Ability to work using Personal Protective Equipment, including respirators, welding shields, hard hats, vests, safety glasses, goggles, gloves etc.
  • Ability to use full range of motion for back, arms, hands, and fingers.
  • Able to use full range of motion for both legs, including climbing, twisting, squatting, and pushing with both legs.
  • Able to climb onto or down from mobile construction equipment, typically 3-4 feet of climbing, for service and inspection.
  • The employee is frequently required to lift or carry loads greater than 50 lbs but less than 75 lbs.
  • Specific vision abilities required by this job include close, distance and color vision.
  • The employee is regularly required to talk or hear at moderate noise levels.

title: Burger King Orkanger søker renholder (kveld/natt)
description:
Burger King Orkanger søker renholder 3-4 dager i uken kveld/natt

Arbeidstid 22:00 til 03:00 (03:30 noen dager)

Gode gjesteopplevelser i Burger King begynner med rene restauranter og et rent kjøkken. Derfor er stillingen som renholder en av de viktigste rollene i restaurantene våre. Som renholder i Burger King arbeider du i hovedsak utenom restaurantens åpningstid. Du har ansvar for å rengjøre gjesteareal, kjøkken og kjøkkenutstyr.

For å lykkes i jobben er det viktig at du er selvstendig, grundig i din arbeidsutførelse og effektiv.

Vi ser etter deg som er pålitelig, nøyaktig og som har et øye for detaljer. Har du også godt humør og stor ansvarsfølelse, vil du med stor sannsynlighet passe inn hos oss.

Du må gjerne ha erfaring fra renholdsarbeid fra før, men dette er ikke et krav da du vil få full opplæring og kontinuerlig oppfølging hos oss.

Hvem er du?

I våre restauranter er vi ikke opptatt en fancy CV, men hvem du er og hva du kan tilføre, og (viktigst av alt) at du vil gi 100% hver dag for å behandle hver eneste gjest som en konge gjemmom ditt bidrag til renslighet!

Vil du bli en del av vårt team? Ta kontakt med oss i dag!

title: Junior Systems Administrator
description:
Location: GuildfordSalary: £30,000 - £35,000 DOE

A great opportunity for an ambitious Junior Systems Administrator to join a growing technology business. Working within a collaborative IT team, you'll be involved in everything from server and network administration to user support, gaining valuable experience across a broad technical estate.

Key Responsibilities

Reporting to the IT Manager, as a Junior Systems Administrator your responsibilities will include:

  • Deploying software and administering user accounts, groups and system policies
  • Monitoring infrastructure, services and applications to identify and resolve issues
  • Installing, configuring and maintaining hardware, software, networking and application components
  • Diagnosing and troubleshooting system, network and hardware faults
  • Managing data backup, recovery and secure storage processes
  • Replacing, upgrading and maintaining IT equipment and infrastructure
  • Supporting cyber security best practices and internal security controls
  • Assisting with compliance against recognised information security standards
  • Maintaining accurate IT documentation, processes and asset records
  • Providing technical support to internal users and external customers
  • Managing the IT asset lifecycle from deployment through to retirement
  • Undertaking occasional travel to other business locations for support and maintenance activities
  • Supporting access control, CCTV and telephony systems
  • Setting up workstations and IT equipment for new and existing employees
  • Assisting with network infrastructure tasks, including cabling where required
  • Supporting ad hoc IT projects and operational requirements

Requirements

Junior Systems Administrator, these are the essential skills that will be required:

  • Ability to obtain UK Security Clearance - must be UK citizen from birth
  • A-Level education (or equivalent) with strong IT, English and Maths skills
  • Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office applications, including Word, Excel and Outlook
  • Basic networking knowledge
  • Experience administering Windows Server and desktop environments within Active Directory
  • Linux administration experience, including Debian/Ubuntu, package management, web servers, NFS and SSH
  • Understanding of system security principles and business continuity planning
  • Basic scripting experience using Bash and/or PowerShell
  • Strong organisational skills with the ability to prioritise and manage multiple tasks effectively
  • Excellent attention to detail
  • Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting skills
  • A proactive approach and willingness to learn new technologies
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team

Desirable

  • Full UK driving licence
  • Experience with PKI certificate management

Benefits

  • Salary: £30,000 - £35,000 depending on experience
  • Full-time, Monday to Friday (40 hours per week)
  • Free on-site parking
  • 10% employer pension contribution
  • Private medical insurance
  • Life assurance and income protection cover
  • 25 days annual leave plus bank holidays
  • Cycle to Work scheme
  • Electric vehicle scheme
  • Six-monthly salary reviews
  • Company bonus scheme

If you have not been contacted within 5 working days, then unfortunately on this occasion your CV has not been shortlisted.

Are you an experienced Data Protection professional who combines GDPR expertise with strong stakeholder management skills? Can you translate complex legal and regulatory requirements into practical and sustainable solutions?

We are looking for an experienced Data Governance & Protection Expert to strengthen ING Netherlands' Safe Data team. In this role, you will help ensure that privacy and data protection requirements are translated into clear responsibilities, effective controls and practical ways of working.

Roles & responsibilities

The Safe Data Team helps ING Netherlands handle personal data with care and comply with all relevant privacy and data protection requirements.

As Data Governance & Protection Expert, you will provide guidance and interpretations on privacy legislation, identify and assess privacy risks, and help design practical, sustainable work instructions. You will translate legal obligations and regulatory expectations into clear responsibilities, controls and work instructions, supporting ING in remaining compliant while enabling business objectives. In this role you will:

title: Software Engineer, Host Assurance
description:
About the Team

Security is foundational to OpenAI’s mission to ensure that artificial general intelligence benefits all of humanity.

The Security organization protects OpenAI’s technology, people, and products by building and operating deeply technical systems that must work reliably at massive scale. Our work underpins OpenAI’s commitments around safety, privacy, and security across research, products, and emerging platforms.

The Host Assurance team exists to make bare metal and VMs dependable & scalable foundations for OpenAI: secure by default, verifiable in practice, and resilient across providers and operating models. We operate at the trust boundary between hardware and cloud-scale orchestration, ensuring that hosts are eligible to safely run workloads with predictable security properties and auditability.

About the Role

OpenAI is seeking a Software Engineer, Host Assurance to build and operate the services, APIs, and host software that establish and maintain trust in our compute infrastructure. You will own production software from design and implementation through testing, rollout, observability, and operation. Your work will support capabilities such as machine identity, certificate issuance and enrollment, secure bootstrap, and host attestation across bare-metal and VM environments.

Success in this role requires strong technical judgment, the ability to reason across software and host-system boundaries and learn unfamiliar parts of the stack, and a practical mindset for building systems that are secure, reliable, and usable in fast-moving production environments. The systems you build will sit on the critical path of OpenAI’s frontier infrastructure investments and will directly shape how large amounts of compute are brought online - securely, responsibly, and at global scale - underpinning long-lived commitments around privacy, security, and reliability.

You will partner closely with infrastructure, research, and confidential computing initiatives—including novel hardware platforms and emerging deployment models– to make the secure path the easiest path. This role is well suited for engineers who enjoy working across trust services, operating systems, hardware and firmware validation, and infrastructure security, and who are excited by ambiguous, high-impact problems at the boundary of hardware and large-scale systems.

In this role, you will:

  • Design, build, and operate components of the Host Assurance platform that establish trust in both bare-metal & VM hosts before they are eligible for production use.

  • Help ensure hosts are verifiably trustworthy from delivery and installation through secure bootstrap and readiness to join orchestration systems.

  • Build and improve systems such as machine identity, certificate issuance and enrollment, HSM-backed or key-management-backed trust services, host attestation, measurement, and baseline verification tooling.

  • Validate delivered hardware and firmware against vendor claims and continuously detect and manage drift over time.

  • Eliminate insecure bootstrap patterns while preserving deployment throughput and operational reliability. Partner with provisioning, fleet, and orchestration teams to deliver paved paths where the secure approach is the easiest approach.

  • Own software components through implementation, operational readiness, launch, and ongoing operation. Define readiness criteria, validate behavior under load and failure, establish monitoring and actionable alerts, plan staged rollouts and tested recovery procedures, and maintain runbooks. Use production experience to improve reliability and reduce operational burden.

  • Participate in production support via oncall rotation.

  • Help define observable, testable security properties for host platforms and improve the telemetry and validation needed to enforce them in practice.

  • Work across different deployment models and provider boundaries while maintaining a consistent bar for host trust outcomes.

You might thrive in this role if you:

  • Have strong software engineering experience building and operating reliable production systems at scale.

  • Bring depth in distributed systems, backend or platform engineering, operating systems, or infrastructure security. Experience with PKI, HSMs, machine identity, attestation, secure boot, or hardware security is valuable but not required.

  • Can reason across services, APIs, and host software, and learn the boot, firmware, and hardware trust mechanisms relevant to your work. Apply sound judgment to trust boundaries, correctness, and safe failure behavior.

  • Have experience writing production quality code and ability to reason clearly about failure modes, operational safety, and long-term maintainability.

  • Have experience supporting critical production systems at scale, such as being on-call.

  • Balance rigor with pragmatism, and care about making strong security controls deployable in real-world environments.

  • Are self-directed, low ego, and willing to work across disciplines to solve the most important problems.

  • Enjoy building in ambiguous spaces where the architecture is still emerging, stakes are at all time high, and the future is being built.

About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity.

We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic.

For additional information, please see OpenAI’s Affirmative Action and Equal Employment Opportunity Policy Statement.

Background checks for applicants will be administered in accordance with applicable law, and qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment consistent with those laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act, for US-based candidates. For unincorporated Los Angeles County workers: we reasonably believe that criminal history may have a direct, adverse and negative relationship with the following job duties, potentially resulting in the withdrawal of a conditional offer of employment: protect computer hardware entrusted to you from theft, loss or damage; return all computer hardware in your possession (including the data contained therein) upon termination of employment or end of assignment; and maintain the confidentiality of proprietary, confidential, and non-public information. In addition, job duties require access to secure and protected information technology systems and related data security obligations.

title: Experienced Data Governance and Protection Expert
description:
Experienced Data Governance & Protection Expert

Are you an experienced Data Protection professional who combines GDPR expertise with strong stakeholder management skills? Can you translate complex legal and regulatory requirements into practical and sustainable solutions?

We are looking for an experienced Data Governance & Protection Expert to strengthen ING Netherlands' Safe Data team. In this role, you will help ensure that privacy and data protection requirements are translated into clear responsibilities, effective controls and practical ways of working.

Roles & responsibilities

The Safe Data Team helps ING Netherlands handle personal data with care and comply with all relevant privacy and data protection requirements.

As Data Governance & Protection Expert, you will provide guidance and interpretations on privacy legislation, identify and assess privacy risks, and help design practical, sustainable work instructions. You will translate legal obligations and regulatory expectations into clear responsibilities, controls and work instructions, supporting ING in remaining compliant while enabling business objectives. In this role you will:

  • Provide expert advice and guidance on data protection and privacy matters across ING Netherlands.

  • Interpret relevant legislation and/or regulatory developments and translate them into practical requirements, controls and hands on work instructions.

  • Identify, assess and help mitigate privacy related risks.

  • Contribute to key data protection processes, including risk assessments, data subject rights requests, personal data breach management and maintaining a records of processing activities.

  • Support awareness and continuous improvement of privacy practices across ING.

The team

You will join ING Netherlands’ Safe Data Team, within this team you will be joining the Data Privacy Office and work closely with the Data Protection Executive, Data Protection Officer, Legal, Compliance, Non-Financial Risk, global privacy teams and business stakeholders. The other part of the Safe Data team covers the Data Governance aspects.

How to succeed

We hire smart people like you for your potential. Our biggest expectation is that you’ll stay curious. Keep learning. Take on responsibility. In return, we’ll back you to develop into an even more awesome version of yourself.

In addition to relevant privacy and data protection expertise, we are looking for someone who can effectively navigate a complex stakeholder environment and drive meaningful change.

You bring:

  • A Bachelor's or Master's degree, preferably in Law.

  • Demonstrable expertise in GDPR and privacy-related regulation, supported by relevant certifications.

  • Proven experience translating regulatory requirements into operational processes, controls and practical business solutions.

  • Strong organizational sensitivity and the ability to balance regulatory, business and operational considerations.

  • At least 7 years of experience in data protection, privacy, compliance or risk management.

  • Experience operating in a highly regulated environment, preferably within financial services.

  • Strong influencing and stakeholder management skills, including the ability to engage constructively with senior management, control functions and global stakeholders.

  • The confidence and professional resilience to challenge decisions when required and defend well-reasoned positions.

  • An autonomous working style, taking ownership and driving initiatives from concept to implementation.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in both Dutch and English.

  • A pragmatic mindset combined with a strong sense of accountability and delivery.

  • Familiarity with ING's organization and governance structure is considered a strong advantage.

Our offer

ING offers you a job from 36 hours that fits in with the times of today. We want to make sure that it is possible for you to strike the right balance between your career and your private life. You can find out more about our employment conditions at: .

The benefits of working with us at ING include:

  • A salary tailored to your qualities and experience;

  • 24-27 vacation days, depending on contract;

  • Pension scheme;

  • 13 month’s salary;

  • Individual Saving Contribution (BIS), 3,5% of your gross annual salary;

  • 8% holiday payment;

  • Hybrid working to blend home working for focus and office working for collaboration and co-creation

  • Personal growth and challenging work with many possibilities;

  • An informal working environment with innovative colleagues;

  • A unique opportunity to be closely involved in a broad scope of activities around data protection.

About us

With 60,000 employees and operations in approximately 40 countries, there is no shortage of opportunities for people with initiative who want to help people take a step ahead in life and in business. Do you want to work at the cutting edge of what’s possible and at the same time ensure you work with integrity and hold the customer’s interests at heart? Do you want to be surrounded by progressive, inspiring, diverse and supportive colleagues? Then there is no better place to invest your talents than at ING. Join us. Apply today.

Questions?

title: Director of Food and Beverage Operations
description:
Mandarin Oriental, Boston is looking for a Director of Food & Beverage Operations to join our Restaurants, Bars, & Experiences team.

Are you a master of craft? Do you thrive in a team that succeeds together, demonstrating integrity and respect while acting responsibly? Do you embrace a growth mindset? We invite you to become a fan of the exceptional.

Mandarin Oriental is the award-winning owner and operator of some of the most luxurious hotels, resorts and residences located in prime destinations around the world, with a strong development pipeline. Increasingly recognised for creating some of the world’s most sought-after properties, the Group provides legendary service inspired by Asian heritage whilst representing the very cutting-edge of luxury experiences.

Mandarin Oriental, Boston is situated in the heart of the Back Bay overlooking Boylston Street. Our luxurious 138 guest rooms and 12 suites set the standard for spaciousness, combining classic Bostonian residential elegance with refined hints of our Oriental heritage. Our spa introduces Boston to world-acclaimed and unique Mandarin Oriental therapies.

About the job

Based at the Mandarin Oriental, Boston within the Restaurants, Bars, & Experiences division in Boston, Massachusetts, the Director of Food & Beverage Operations is responsible for the strategic leadership, financial performance, and operational execution of all Food & Beverage outlets, with specific oversight of Banquets & Catering, In-Room Dining, and Food & Beverage Storytelling & Experiences. This role serves as a key commercial and operational partner, ensuring exceptional guest experiences while driving revenue growth, market awareness, and brand differentiation.

The Director of Food & Beverage Operations will work closely with the Commercial team to develop innovative programming, signature events, strategic partnerships, and compelling storytelling initiatives that elevate the hotel's positioning within the local community and luxury hospitality marketplace.

The Director of Food & Beverage Operations reports to the Hotel Manager. The Assistant Food & Beverage Manager, In-Room Dining Manager, and Executive Banquet Chef report to the Director of Food & Beverage Operations.

As Director of Food & Beverage Operations, you will be responsible for the following duties:

Strategic Leadership

  • Provide visionary leadership and direction for all Food & Beverage operations.
  • Develop and execute strategic plans that align with hotel business objectives, revenue goals, and brand standards.
  • Drive innovation and continuously enhance the guest experience through creative programming, culinary experiences, and service excellence.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement across all F&B teams.

Banquets & Catering

  • Oversee the planning, execution, and financial performance of all banquet and catering operations.
  • Ensure flawless delivery of weddings, corporate events, social functions, VIP experiences, and hotel-led activations.
  • Partner closely with the Commercial team to maximize catering revenues and conversion opportunities.
  • Develop unique event concepts that strengthen the hotel's reputation as a premier destination for gatherings and celebrations.
  • Continuously evaluate service standards, operational efficiencies, and profitability of banquet operations.

In-Room Dining

  • Lead and elevate the in-room dining experience to reflect the hotel's luxury positioning.
  • Develop innovative menus and service enhancements that improve guest satisfaction and increase capture rates.
  • Monitor service delivery, quality standards, operational efficiency, and financial performance.
  • Identify opportunities to create distinctive experiences that differentiate the hotel from competitors.

Food & Beverage Storytelling & Experiences

  • Curate and lead storytelling initiatives that bring the hotel's culinary identity to life.
  • Work with chefs, beverage leaders, and marketing teams to create authentic narratives around menus, ingredients, local culture, sustainability efforts, and partnerships.
  • Develop experiential dining concepts, seasonal activations, chef collaborations, wellness-focused offerings, and destination experiences.
  • Ensure consistency of brand messaging across all guest touchpoints and platforms.

Commercial Team Partnership

  • Serve as a strategic partner to the Commercial team in driving awareness, revenue generation, and guest engagement.
  • Develop annual calendars of special events, culinary activations, promotions, and partnership opportunities.
  • Collaborate on public relations initiatives, media events, influencer experiences, and community outreach efforts.
  • Support the creation of compelling marketing content, social media storytelling, and promotional campaigns.
  • Participate in key business development opportunities, sales presentations, and client entertainment events.

Local Partnerships & Community Engagement

  • Identify and cultivate meaningful relationships with local businesses, luxury brands, cultural institutions, chefs, artisans, beverage producers, and community organizations.
  • Create partnerships that enhance visibility, strengthen the hotel's market presence, and deliver unique guest experiences.
  • Position the hotel as a recognized culinary and social destination within the local market.
  • Represent the hotel at industry events, networking functions, and community initiatives.

Financial Management

  • Achieve and exceed revenue, profit, and productivity targets across all Food & Beverage operations.
  • Manage budgets, forecasting, labor costs, food and beverage costs, and capital expenditures.
  • Identify opportunities to drive incremental revenue and improve margins.
  • Analyze business trends and implement strategies to optimize financial performance.

Talent Development & Leadership

  • Recruit, develop, coach, and retain high-performing leaders and colleagues.
  • Establish clear performance expectations and succession plans.
  • Promote a culture focused on luxury service, innovation, teamwork, and professional development.
  • Lead by example and champion employee engagement initiatives.

Other duties as assigned by management.

As Director of Food & Beverage Operations we expect from you:

  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in a similar role; experience in luxury hospitality is strongly preferred.
  • Strong business acumen with the ability to analyze complex financial data and translate results into operational action.
  • Proven ability to lead and manage change in a high-volume environment.
  • Effective management, leadership, organizational, and communication skills.
  • Complete administrative proficiency. Knowledge of purchasing, inventory controls, supplies and equipment.
  • Reading, writing, and oral proficiency in the English language.
  • Ability to stand or walk for prolonged periods of the shift; ability to frequently push, pull, and lift carts or items weighing up to 25 pounds.

Desirable:

  • College degree in Hospitality Management or a similar field.

Compensation:

The salary range for this position is $115,000-125,000 annually.

Our commitment to you

  • Learning & Development. Your success is our success. We craft unique learning and development programmes for various stages in your career so that you grow, continuously.
  • MOstay. When you work as hard as our colleagues do, it’s important to take time off. As a member of the #MOfamily, you can stay with us wherever you go in the world. The MOstay programme offers complimentary nights and additionally attractive rates on rooms for you and your loved ones.
  • Heath & Colleague Wellness. Finding the right work-life balance is important. Your wellbeing matters to us. A variety of health benefits and wellness programmes are offered to all our colleagues, globally.
  • Retirement Plans. When you show commitment to us, we reciprocate. We offer different retirement plans depending on the length of your service and your role.

Local Benefits

  • A competitive salary and benefits package
  • Complimentary dry-cleaning services
  • Meals served while on duty
  • Discounted colleague parking available

title: Strength & Conditioning Coach (Chanhassen, MN)
description:
Job description


ETS Sports Performance Specialist

Join ETS Partner Adam Thielen as we open additional ETS Sports Performance locations across the country!


Position Overview:

We are seeking motivated and experienced Strength and Performance Specialists that are searching for a unique opportunity to work and flourish in the private sector of the Sports Performance industry. The ideal candidate would have a strong interest in working with youth, high school, college and professional athletes in an electric atmosphere utilizing proven next level training and business systems that continue to set ETS apart from the competition. In addition to being aligned with ETS Partner and NFL All Pro Adam Thielen among other notable current and past professional athletes, the candidate will immediately be surrounded by one of our elite ETS Sports Performance Facility Directors along with a host of other successful ETS Performance Specialists from across the country. The entire “ETS Family” will be there to assist and support the Performance Specialist to enhance and maximize the development of our athletes at the highest possible level. This opportunity includes a very competitive industry level salary, full benefits along with a financial and personal development growth and promotions plan that can’t be matched.


ETS Training Philosophy:

The ETS training philosophy is to provide every athlete (regardless of age and sport) the opportunity to significantly improve their relative strength, power, linear and lateral speed, ability to biomechanically master the art of deceleration while also significantly improving their overall athleticism and becoming less prone to injury. Our systematic and step by step approach to developing better athletes will dramatically improve performance on the field, court, track, pool or ice.

Each athlete will take part in a progressive ability-appropriate plan of strength, speed, agility and deceleration training that will not only allow them to maximize their skills and athleticism for their sport, but also improve their overall athleticism. It’s crucial for every athlete to develop the basic-fundamental athletic and biomechanical movements, strength techniques and deceleration protocols through a customized plan in order to truly maximize their potential.

We believe the missing link in most programs is the lack of consistent and professional emphasis and attention to detail on the basics of an athlete’s complete athletic development separated from their sport-specific skill work. Our vision is that every athlete will experience an unmatched next level training atmosphere that is equally focused on character development, accountability and competition as it is the next level performance results that every athlete will gain. Our goal is for every athlete to leave each session understanding the physical objective for that session, but also understand the importance of consistency, dedication and commitment to ensure they are maximizing their results.


Position Qualifications:

  • Post graduate experience in the Strength/Conditioning or Performance field.
  • Must be a former competitive athlete and possess an accredited professional certification.
  • Outgoing, motivating and personable with a willingness to learn and continue growing.
  • Sports-minded with a strong desire for continual development of leadership skills.
  • Enjoys working with kids of all ages and ability levels.
  • Patient yet persistent with the task at hand.
  • Exercise Science/athletics or business background.
  • Accountable and dependable - on time and willing to put forth the extra effort.
  • Graduating GPA of a 2.5 or higher.


The ETS Opportunity:

With ETS being in significant growth mode we are looking to develop our Sports Performance Specialists in preparation for a larger role within our company. Mastering of the unique ETS training and business systems will provide each Sports Performance Specialist the opportunity to enter in our “ETS University Pool” of development to run and operate one of our new upcoming ETS locations.

In recap, this unique and one-of-a-kind opportunity offers the following:

  • Competitive fair market base salary, 401k, + incentives.
  • Health, dental, and vision benefits package.

The course runs for 140 weeks with 5-day training blocks every 7-weeks which take place at our partner’s state-of-the-art workshop in Glasgow. The course will give you skills and experience across all core elements of vehicle body repair including;

  • Motor vehicle chassis and body alignment, e.g. underbody measurement and its impact on suspension and steering geometry

  • Vehicle body types, panel identification, safety systems, materials and alternative fuel

  • Use of Body Panel Repair tools, equipment and devices used in the process e.g. alignment jigs, resistance welding equipment, riveting and bonding tools

  • Removal and replacement of body panels and associated parts e.g. mechanically fixed components, chemically fixed components

  • Interpretation of technical data for joining techniques and replacement panels

  • Health & Safety and compliance requirements of the bodyshop industry

This is a programme designed for people at every stage in life. It could be your first venture into work after finishing school, or the exciting career move you’ve been looking for. Whatever your motivation, we’re looking for those with an inquisitive mindset who love solving problems and don’t mind getting their hands dirty.

As an apprentice with us the starting salary will is £8.00 per hour in your first year if you are under 18, £10.85 if you are 18 to 20 or £12.71 if you are 21 and over rising in line with national minimum wage and progression.

Together, we strive to make travelling by bus the best choice for everyone. With our doors open to all, you’ll have the chance to build a fulfilling career with us, one where you can explore your passions, aspirations and realise your full potential. As you progress, you'll have the opportunity to earn a competitive salary, and we'll be there to support you every step of the way. Join us and be at the forefront of revolutionising bus travel. You'll be a vital part of something big – by connecting communities, promoting sustainable travel, and contributing to a better tomorrow. You'll also gain invaluable skills and knowledge that will stay with you for a lifetime.

title: Product Development Engineer
description:
Job Description:

ITW Power Nailing | An Illinois Tool Works (ITW) Company

Location: Glenview, IL

COMPANY DESCRIPTION

ITW Power Nailing, a division within the Construction Products segment, is a global provider of premium nailing and fastening solutions. Our products are engineered to improve contractor productivity and elevate building quality across both new residential construction and remodeling projects. With trusted, category-defining brands like Paslode, we set the standard in wood-to-wood fastening systems—delivering performance, reliability, and productivity that professionals count on.

ITW offers you a path for advancement, a competitive salary, and a comprehensive benefits package designed to help employees care for themselves, their families, and their futures. Our Glenview office has a free onsite fitness center, active employee resource groups, corporate discounts, and much more. We are just one block away from the Golf Metra station and quick train ride to downtown Chicago.

Why This Role Matters

The Product Development Engineer plays a key role in developing and advancing fastening solutions that improve contractor productivity, jobsite efficiency, and construction quality. As the engineering owner of assigned nail and staple product families, you will lead products through their lifecycle, from concept and commercialization to continuous improvement and optimization. You will serve as the design authority for fasteners and the technical authority for fastening system performance, ensuring seamless integration between Paslode fasteners and fastening tools. Working closely with Product Management, Manufacturing Engineering, Quality Engineering, Operations, and the adjacent Paslode tool engineering team, you will help transform customer needs into innovative, differentiated solutions that drive growth and strengthen industry-leading brands.

What You Will Do

  • Design, develop, validate, and commercialize innovative fastening solutions that achieve performance, quality, manufacturability, cost, and timing objectives.

  • Own the technical performance and evolution of nails, staples, and related fastening products throughout their lifecycle, driving improvements in fastener-to-tool compatibility, customer value, reliability, quality, and manufacturing efficiency.

  • Partner with Product Management to evaluate customer needs, market opportunities, and product concepts, providing technical expertise throughout the product development process.

  • Apply engineering analysis, prototyping, testing, risk assessment, and structured problem-solving methods to solve complex technical challenges and validate product performance.

  • Lead product development projects through ITW's New Product Development process from concept through commercialization.

  • Collaborate with Manufacturing Engineering, Operations, and Quality Engineering to launch new products, improve existing products, resolve product performance issues, and implement robust corrective actions.

  • Conduct customer visits, field evaluations, competitive benchmarking, and technology assessments to identify opportunities for innovation and competitive advantage.

What You Bring

  • Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Materials Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or related field.

  • 5+ years of combined product development, product engineering, design engineering

  • Strong mechanical design, analytical problem-solving, and project leadership skills.

  • Experience developing products from concept through commercialization.

  • Knowledge of materials, manufacturing processes, and product validation methods.

  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate across technical and commercial teams.

  • Ability to travel up to 15% to domestic jobsites and manufacturing facilities

Preferred Qualifications

Candidates should possess experience, knowledge, or demonstrated capability in several of the following areas:

  • Knowledge of materials engineering, metallurgy, material compatibility, coatings, or related engineering disciplines.

  • Familiarity with manufacturing processes such as forming, machining, stamping, molding, assembly, heat treating, coating, or other high-volume production methods.

  • Experience applying Design for Manufacturability (DFM), Design of Experiments (DOE), FMEA, statistical methods, or structured problem-solving techniques.

  • Experience with product testing, reliability engineering, validation methods, and performance evaluation.

  • Familiarity with electromechanical, pneumatic, hydraulic, combustion, battery-powered, or other mechanical systems.

  • Experience with CAD tools, engineering analysis, and technical documentation.

What's In It For You

Join a market-leading business known for innovation, customer-focused product development, and continuous improvement. You'll have the opportunity to develop new fastening technologies, advance existing product platforms, solve meaningful engineering challenges, and collaborate across the full product lifecycle while making a direct impact on products used every day by professional contractors.

Compensation Information:

Annual base salary range for this position is $98,000 - $123,000. Please note that this salary information serves as a general guideline. Company considers various factors when extending an offer, including but not limited to the scope and responsibilities of the position, the candidate's work experience, education and training, key skills, as well as market and business considerations. In addition, our benefits include paid vacation, sick, holiday, and parental leave. For more details, visit our Benefits page.

ITW is an equal opportunity employer. We value our colleagues’ unique perspectives, experiences and ideas and create workplaces where everyone can develop their careers and perform to their full potential.


As an equal employment opportunity employer, ITW is committed to equal employment opportunity and fair treatment for employees, beginning with the hiring process and continuing through all aspects of the employment relationship.


All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, religion, national origin, age, disability, protected Veteran status or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws.

title: Strength & Conditioning Director (Pittsburgh, PA)
description:
NOW HIRING: PRO ATHLETE STRENGTH & CONDITIONING DIRECTOR UP TO $150,000.00 OR MORE PLUS BENEFITS.

PREMIUM BENEFITS INCLUDE:

  • 401(k)
  • Health Insurance
  • Dental Insurance
  • Vision Insurance
  • Paid Time Off

  • Relocation Assistance

STRENGTH COACH WITH RAPID GROWTH TO MANAGEMENT: Are you a GA or a Head Strength Coach looking for an amazing opportunity to work with one of the premiere sports performance companies in the country? After 3 months of training at our headquarters in Minnesota, you could have the opportunity to become the Director of our soon-to-be ETS Pittsburgh facility.

ABOUT ETS PERFORMANCE: Since 2010 ETS has produced over 2,500 D1/D2/D3 athletes, 200+ Pros, and over 50,000 athletes in total from various sports; football, hockey, basketball, softball, soccer, baseball, lacrosse, swimming. With nearly 40 locations in the USA, this is the perfect time to embark on a career with a thriving team. We’re looking for true leaders who will GROW WITH US as we expand in the United States.

PRO ATHLETE STRENGTH & CONDITIONING DIRECTOR: TRAIN THE PROS AND UP AND COMING STARS. We are looking for athletes who know what it takes to perform at the highest level and have a passion to guide and motivate the next wave of athletes with the desire to achieve UNCOMMON results.

THE IDEAL MATCH TO LEAD OUR TEAM: The ideal candidate would have a strong interest in working with youth, high school, college and professional athletes in an electric atmosphere utilizing proven next level training and business systems that continue to set ETS apart from the competition.

PROFESSIONAL ATHLETE ATMOSPHERE AND DEVELOPMENT: In addition to being aligned with ETS Partner NFL All-Pro ADAM THIELEN, KIRK COUSINS, and CJ HAM among other notable current and past professional athletes, the candidate will immediately be surrounded by one of our elite ETS Sports Performance Facility Directors along with a host of other successful ETS Performance Specialists from across the country.

TRUE CAREER GROWTH: The entire “ETS Family” will be there to assist and support the Performance Specialist to enhance and maximize the development of our athletes at the highest possible level. This opportunity includes a very competitive industry level salary along with personal development growth and promotions plan that can’t be matched.

THE METHOD: The ETS training philosophy is to provide every athlete (regardless of age and sport) the opportunity to significantly improve their relative strength, power, linear and lateral speed, ability to bio-mechanically master the art of deceleration while also significantly improving their overall athleticism and becoming less prone to injury.
Our systematic and step by step approach to developing better athletes will dramatically improve performance on the field, court, track, pool or ice. Each athlete will take part in a progressive ability-appropriate plan of strength, speed, agility and deceleration training that will not only allow them to maximize their skills and athleticism for their sport, but also improve their overall athleticism. It’s crucial for every athlete to develop the basic-fundamental athletic and bio-mechanical movements, strength techniques and deceleration protocols through a customized plan in order to truly maximize their potential.

We believe the missing link in most programs is the lack of consistent and professional emphasis and attention to detail on the basics of an athlete’s complete athletic development separated from their sport-specific skill work. Our vision is that every athlete will experience an unmatched next level training atmosphere that is equally focused on character development, accountability and competition as it is the next level performance results that every athlete will gain.

SERIOUS GAINS AND GOALS: Our goal is for every athlete to leave each session understanding the physical objective for that session, but also understand the importance of consistency, dedication and commitment to ensure they are maximizing their results.

We are seeking motivated Strength and Performance Specialists that are searching for a unique opportunity to work and flourish in the private sector of the Sports Performance industry.

COMMITMENT REQUIRED

  • Work week consists of a minimum of 40-60 hours a week
  • Available for off-site meetings – Should conduct a minimum of one offsite meeting per week with a coach or director of a team, school, or club/organization
  • Available via cell, email & social media for staff, athletes, parents, & potential leads
  • Committed to growing all of the ETS Performance Services (Speed Plus, Strength Plus, Elite Speed, Team Training, Adult Fit Program (off peak performance hours), etc.
  • Committed to following the ETS Marketing Plan and daily duties
  • Committed to monthly dialogue with parents to provide a training update/progress report for their athlete
  • Follow and adhere to all daily, weekly and monthly responsibilities via the ETS Directors Non-Negotiable Manual

PERFORMANCE EXPECTATIONS

  • Perform a minimum of 3-5 new athlete evaluations each week
  • Arrive 30 minutes early to work each day
  • Be present and command the training floor during all ETS training sessions
  • Follow-up with past inquiries and prospects
  • Provide a safe, clean and intense training atmosphere
  • Maintain a positive public image on social media platforms
  • Create and maintain a positive image both inside and outside the facility
  • Wear proper ETS attire for every session/shift
  • Interview and hire all new staff/interns each semester/quarter
  • Follow and adhere to ETS Directors Non-Negotiable Manual

Job Type: Full-time

Pay: $42,000.00 - $150,000.00+ per year

Schedule: 8 hour shift

Pittsburgh, PA: Reliably commute or willing to relocate with an employer-provided relocation package (Required)

Experience: Fitness Strength Training: 2 years (Required)

title: Buyer - Focus Digital & Technology Specialist
description:
With 85 years of experience in the construction and management of natural gas infrastructure, Snam is a leading European operator in three main business areas: transportation, where it ranks first with a network extending for approximately 38,000 km in Italy and abroad;storage, with one-sixth of the entire capacity of the European Union; and regasification, where it is currently the thirdlargest European player, with an annual managed (or co-managed) capacity of 28 billion cubic meters.


One of the leading Italian listed companies by market capitalization, Snam ensures Italy's security of supply through its infrastructure system, enables energy integration between different sources, and promotes decarbonization projects that support competitiveness and development of businesses and communities.


Why should you consider joining us?


🚀 Challenge: Work directly with business managers and key decision-makers.


📈 Growth: Gain the opportunity to develop your career by contributing to challenging projects in a dynamic environment.


🌐 Company Culture: We are a passionate team that has always valued talent and fostered a positive work environment. Would you like to be part of our growth journey?


⚙️ A Growing Industry: The energy sector is constantly evolving, and you will have the opportunity to be at the heart of the dynamics shaping this transformative industry.


Buyer - Focus Digital & Technology Specialist

Vuoi trasformare le tue passioni in un percorso di sviluppo continuo?

Come professionista Buyer Digital & Technology, sarai una figura chiave nel nostro impegno quotidiano di definire ed implementare le strategie di sourcing per le categorie di riferimento (ICT hardware, software and services). Farai parte della nostra Direzione Procurement, nello specifico nell'area Corporate & Group Procurement e avrai la responsabilità di relazionarti sia con i Line Manager che le funzioni specialistiche corporate, occupandoti di acquisti in ambito ICT

Cosa farai in particolare:

  • Redazione, aggiornamento e sviluppo del piano degli acquisti (Mater Plan) in collaborazione con le altre funzioni interessate a partire dal Cliente Interno;
  • Partecipazione attiva allo sviluppo dei progetti di sourcing, valutando e definendo la strategia di gara e l’approccio negoziale;
  • Predisposizione della documentazione necessaria per l’iter di sourcing in collaborazione con le varie funzioni aziendali (cliente interno, legale ecc.);
  • Conduzione del processo di acquisto dalla richiesta d’offerta alla formalizzazione del contratto e successive revisioni attraverso l’utilizzo di strumenti aziendali (es. piattaforme di e-procurement come Jaggaer One; ERP aziendali come SAP) e nel rispetto delle regole aziendali;
  • Gestione delle negoziazioni e della relazione commerciale con i fornitori nonché quella operativa con i Clienti Interni nell’ambito dei progetti assegnati;
  • Analisi dei dati riferiti alla propria area di competenza per monitoraggio delle performance e del mercato di riferimento;
  • Individuazione di strategie/soluzioni di acquisto alternative al fine di portare innovazione e/o ottimizzare la spesa;
  • Partecipazione a progetti funzionali ed interfunzionali.

Cosa serve per unirti al nostro team?

  • Conoscenza del mercato di riferimento in ambito acquisti indiretti (plus se nel mondo industriale/produttivo) e relativi vendor di riferimento, con particolare riferimento preferenziale a: ICT Services, Software, Hardware;
  • Tecniche negoziali
  • Analisi ed elaborazione dati;
  • Buona Conoscenza del pacchetto office (Excel, PowerPoint, Word);
  • Buona conoscenza della lingua inglese necessaria per interfacciarsi con controparti straniere;
  • Laurea in materie tecnico-scientifiche/economiche/giuridiche; saranno considerati come plus titoli di studio/certificazioni specifici in ambito Procurement/Supply Chain
  • Esperienza di 3-5 anni nel ruolo di Buyer/Procurement Specialist/Supply Chain Specialist in società strutturate e dinamiche
  • Preferenziale: conoscenza del Codice Appalti

Completano il profilo ideale

  • Spiccate capacità negoziali e di orientamento al risultato
  • Capacità di agire con prospettiva e proattività
  • Forte orientamento al cliente
  • Ottime Capacità di analisi
  • Ottime capacità relazionali e comunicative

Sei tu la persona che stiamo cercando?

Sei una persona fortemente orientata al risultato, efficace sia nel lavoro in team che nella comunicazione a tutti i livelli organizzativi.

Lavori in autonomia sapendo individuare e gestire le priorità con flessibilità, dinamismo e proattività.

Pianifichi le attività e gestisci le scadenze in modo puntuale, grazie a buone doti di organizzazione, pianificazione e problem solving.

Cosa offriamo

CCNL applicato: Energia e Petrolio

Tipologia contrattuale: Tempo Indeterminato

La retribuzione offerta sarà commisurata all’esperienza maturata e alle competenze specifiche.

La Retribuzione Annua Lorda minima per il ruolo è indicativamente pari a €48.200.

In caso di contratto di apprendistato professionalizzante, alla retribuzione sarà applicata la percentualizzazione prevista dal CCNL di riferimento per la specifica tipologia contrattuale.

La posizione è inoltre destinataria di un sistema incentivante annuale, secondo le policy aziendali.

Benefit:

Nel nostro impegno per il benessere dei dipendenti e per favorire l’equilibrio tra lavoro e vita privata, offriamo un pacchetto completo di benefit tra cui:

  • Assicurazione Sanitaria: copertura completa per te e la tua famiglia
  • Previdenza complementare: risparmio pensionistico sostenuto dal datore di lavoro
  • Welfare e Wellbeing: accesso a un ampio programma di iniziative e convenzioni dedicate al benessere, allo sport, alla salute e alla qualità della vita
  • Modello di lavoro flessibile che include la possibilità di lavorare da remoto, per aiutarti a conciliare al meglio impegni professionali e personali
  • Offerta formativa: sosteniamo la crescita delle persone attraverso programmi di formazione continua e sviluppo professionale
  • Piano di Azionariato Diffuso: opportunità di aderire al piano di azionariato diffuso godendo di tutti i benefici riservati ai dipendenti del Gruppo

In conformità agli obblighi definiti dalla Direttiva UE 2023/970 e dalla normativa nazionale di recepimento, e coerentemente con procedure interne dedicate, Snam non richiede né raccoglie informazioni sulla retribuzione o sull’inquadramento pregressi dei/delle candidati/e: tali informazioni non vengono richieste durante i colloqui, né via e-mail, né tramite società di selezione, head hunter o altri soggetti terzi coinvolti nel processo

L’azienda si riserva, al termine del processo di selezione, in presenza di esperienza professionale e competenze tecniche e trasversali diverse dal profilo ricercato, di formulare una offerta retributiva differente rispetto a quanto riportato nel presente annuncio, nel rispetto degli obblighi di trasparenze definiti nel decreto rif. D. Lgs 96/26. A tal fine si è dotata di procedure interne volte ad assicurare l’adozione di fattori oggettivi e non discriminatori che possano motivare retribuzioni diverse nell’ambito di una medesima categoria di lavoratori.

Tutti gli annunci di lavoro da noi pubblicati si intendono rivolti ad ambo i sessi, a persone di tutte l’età e nazionalità (ex L.903/77, D.Lgs 215/03 e 216/03 s.m.i.). Informativa sul trattamento dati (GDPR: Reg. UE 2016/679).


Our Culture


At Snam, we believe that diversity is the key to innovation and long-term success. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where every voice is heard, respected and valued.

We actively promote fairness in hiring, professional development and career progression, while fostering a culture of open dialogue, collaboration, and continuous feedback.


We provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified candidates, making our hiring decisions based solely on objective criteria and alignment with the requirements of the role.


Candidates whose profiles best match the position will be contacted and invited to participate in the selection process.


If you are ready to take on a new challenge and see yourself reflected in the profile described above, we encourage you to submit your application through the Snam Careers Portal. For further information, please contact carriere@snam.it.

title: Senior Associate, Project Finance
description:
Looking for a role where you can put your financial modelling skills to work on live, high-value transactions? Join our Project Finance team in Copenhagen as a Senior Associate and play a key role in financing renewable energy projects across Europe.

European Energy is a growing company in the renewable energy sector. We are a privately owned Danish company founded in 2004, with our headquarters in Copenhagen. We develop, construct, finance, and operate solar (PV) and wind energy projects globally, as well as Power-to-X projects. In addition, we explore new technologies, including battery storage, biogas, and carbon capture. Our core values form the foundation of everything we do: In It Together, Trust and Courage, Ambition, Excitement, Inclusion, and Agility.

Your New Team

As a part of the CCO Area, the Project and Asset Finance team is responsible for sourcing all financing needed to construct EE's project pipeline. In this role, you will work directly with the Global Head of Project and Asset Finance and a team of Project Finance transaction leads, as well as the more than 25 other members of the broader M&A and Project Finance department dedicated to commercialising EE's asset portfolio.

Your New Role

As a Senior Associate, Project Finance, you will be the deal team's go-to person for the financial model on the live transactions to which you are assigned, while acting as a sounding board for junior associates with respect to their own modelling responsibilities. You will build, tailor, and maintain complex financial models, populate and maintain the transaction data room, coordinate Q&A with lenders and advisors, support in commercial negotiations and documentation review, and assist in all other aspects of the transaction, from mandate to financial close. This is a hands-on role offering significant responsibility, exposure to high-value transactions, and excellent opportunities for professional growth.

Your Responsibilities

  • Build, tailor, and maintain the financial model for each transaction, including running scenarios and sensitivities.

  • Provide support and mentoring to junior Associate regarding their own financial modelling responsibilities.

  • Populate and maintain the transaction data room.

  • Run the RfP process for the LIA and Model Auditor.

  • Coordinate lender and advisor to Q&A throughout the transaction process.

  • Assist the Transaction Principal in producing transaction information materials.

  • Support due diligence processes and the preparation of term sheets and financing documentation.

Prerequisites to progress in the job

  • You have 1-3 years of experience as a financial analyst, ideally within project finance, infrastructure, leveraged finance, or a related field.

  • You are highly proficient in financial modelling and can independently build, tailor, and audit a project finance model.

  • You have a solid understanding of non-recourse financing structures; exposure to both debt and equity financing is an advantage.

  • You have strong Excel and quantitative skills, with close attention to detail and accuracy.

  • You have an interest in participating in, and learning about, all aspects of renewable energy project structuring, including project documents, structuring and commercial negotiation, and financing documentation.

  • You have an interest in renewable power markets and market dynamics.

As a person, you are proactive and have a results-driven mindset, which you use in your problem-solving. You are collaborative with excellent communication skills, and comfortable explaining complex financial concepts to diverse audiences. You have an eye for detail, particularly in your financial modelling work, and a genuine interest in the financial market and the renewable energy sector.

You are willing to travel as needed (expected approximately quarterly) to meet with stakeholders across Europe.

With us you get

  • Close collaboration with senior colleagues and meaningful deal ownership from day one

  • A culture of knowledge sharing and international collaboration across 21+ countries

  • Flexible work policy and a diverse, inclusive work environment

  • Opportunities for career advancement in a growing company and sector

  • Six weeks of paid annual leave, a subsidised lunch scheme, employee discounts on glasses, furniture, and massage, free access to a gym, a mobile phone for both professional and personal use, and access to professional development opportunities, including on-the-job learning, internal and external training, and networking.

European Energy at a glance — The Power of Tomorrow, Today

We are now more than 970 employees with 51 nationalities represented in 21 countries, and we are growing rapidly in both Copenhagen and across our global offices. We all work for our common goal: to be a leading partner in the renewable energy transition and to create The Power of Tomorrow, Today.

Our working environment is built on mutual respect for the varied strengths and talents of our employees, with a flat hierarchy and a culture that encourages initiative and innovation. Our employees value our flexible working culture, which supports a better balance between work and personal life. We are a team, whether it is in the workplace, on our company trips, or during our weekly company training sessions. At European Energy, you will work with colleagues from around the world and become part of a collaborative international network.

We lead with purpose

At European Energy, our leadership culture is built on six guiding principles that shape how we collaborate, make decisions, and grow together. These principles help us act responsibly and empower each other to succeed.

Apply now

Workplace: Søborg, Denmark

Reference: Jeremy Bennett, Director, Global Head of Project and Asset Finance

How to apply: We value a diverse and inclusive workplace and encourage all qualified candidates to apply, regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, religion, or background. To support a fair and unbiased recruitment process, we kindly ask that you do not include a photograph in your CV. We assess all candidates based on their skills, experience, qualifications, and potential to succeed in the role. We review applications and conduct interviews on an ongoing basis and will close the position once a suitable candidate has been identified. We therefore encourage you to apply as soon as possible. Please note that we do not accept applications via email or any other direct messaging channels. Applications must be submitted through the designated application link.

Background check: As a last step of the hiring process, a background check will be conducted on the final candidate. This is to safeguard our operations and ensure compliance with EU regulations for critical infrastructure. The check can include verification of identity, employment history, and criminal records.

Contact person: For more information about the position, please reach out to Jeremy Bennett, jben@europeanenergy.com

After 3 months of training at our headquarters in Minnesota, you could have the opportunity to become the Director of our soon-to-be ETS Fort Mill facility.

ABOUT ETS PERFORMANCE: Since 2010 ETS has produced over 2,500 D1/D2/D3 athletes, 200+ Pros, and over 50,000 athletes in total from various sports; football, hockey, basketball, softball, soccer, baseball, lacrosse, swimming. With nearly 40 locations in the USA, this is the perfect time to embark on a career with a thriving team. We’re looking for true leaders who will GROW WITH US as we expand in the United States.

PRO ATHLETE STRENGTH & CONDITIONING DIRECTOR: TRAIN THE PROS AND UP AND COMING STARS. We are looking for athletes who know what it takes to perform at the highest level and have a passion to guide and motivate the next wave of athletes with the desire to achieve UNCOMMON results.

THE IDEAL MATCH TO LEAD OUR TEAM: The ideal candidate would have a strong interest in working with youth, high school, college and professional athletes in an electric atmosphere utilizing proven next level training and business systems that continue to set ETS apart from the competition.

PROFESSIONAL ATHLETE ATMOSPHERE AND DEVELOPMENT: In addition to being aligned with ETS Partner NFL All-Pro ADAM THIELEN, KIRK COUSINS, and CJ HAM among other notable current and past professional athletes, the candidate will immediately be surrounded by one of our elite ETS Sports Performance Facility Directors along with a host of other successful ETS Performance Specialists from across the country.

TRUE CAREER GROWTH: The entire “ETS Family” will be there to assist and support the Performance Specialist to enhance and maximize the development of our athletes at the highest possible level. This opportunity includes a very competitive industry level salary along with personal development growth and promotions plan that can’t be matched.

THE METHOD: The ETS training philosophy is to provide every athlete (regardless of age and sport) the opportunity to significantly improve their relative strength, power, linear and lateral speed, ability to bio-mechanically master the art of deceleration while also significantly improving their overall athleticism and becoming less prone to injury.
Our systematic and step by step approach to developing better athletes will dramatically improve performance on the field, court, track, pool or ice. Each athlete will take part in a progressive ability-appropriate plan of strength, speed, agility and deceleration training that will not only allow them to maximize their skills and athleticism for their sport, but also improve their overall athleticism. It’s crucial for every athlete to develop the basic-fundamental athletic and bio-mechanical movements, strength techniques and deceleration protocols through a customized plan in order to truly maximize their potential.

We believe the missing link in most programs is the lack of consistent and professional emphasis and attention to detail on the basics of an athlete’s complete athletic development separated from their sport-specific skill work. Our vision is that every athlete will experience an unmatched next level training atmosphere that is equally focused on character development, accountability and competition as it is the next level performance results that every athlete will gain.

SERIOUS GAINS AND GOALS: Our goal is for every athlete to leave each session understanding the physical objective for that session, but also understand the importance of consistency, dedication and commitment to ensure they are maximizing their results.

We are seeking motivated Strength and Performance Specialists that are searching for a unique opportunity to work and flourish in the private sector of the Sports Performance industry.

  • Available for off-site meetings – Should conduct a minimum of one offsite meeting per week with a coach or director of a team, school, or club/organization

title: Electrical Training Facilitator
description:
Job Description

Help power the future of the skilled trades. Indian River State College is looking for a dedicated Electrical Training Facilitator to lead engaging classroom and laboratory experiences that prepare students for successful careers in the electrical industry. This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced electrician or industry professional who enjoys teaching, mentoring, and sharing real-world knowledge.

You'll guide students through hands-on training aligned with NCCER curriculum standards, support workforce readiness, promote a culture of safety, and help learners build the confidence and competencies needed to thrive in today's electrical trade professions.

About Us

Indian River State College is a leading public institution on Florida’s Treasure Coast, serving students across multiple campuses in four counties. We are committed to academic excellence, innovation, and community engagement, offering associate and bachelor’s degrees, workforce training, and continuing education programs that meet the needs of our region.

At The River, we believe every student’s and every employee’s story matters. We value the diverse perspectives, experiences, and talents that come together across our campuses, creating a learning environment and workplace that is supportive, inclusive, and inspiring.

With flexible learning options online, on campus, and hybrid, we meet students where they are and prepare them for real-world success. Programs like the Promise Program expand access by providing eligible students with tuition-free opportunities, ensuring every learner has the chance to thrive.

Why Join The River

When you join Indian River State College, you become part of a collaborative and mission-driven community where your work makes a meaningful impact. Here, your role is more than a job; it’s an opportunity to shape futures, support student success, and contribute to a college that is changing lives every day.

JOB SUMMARY:

The Electrical Training Facilitator provides classroom and laboratory instruction to prepare participants for entry-level employment and apprenticeship opportunities in the electrical trade. Responsibilities also include managing the electrical training lab, maintaining equipment and inventory, supporting safety practices, and ensuring instructional readiness.

SPECIFIC DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

Instruction & Training,

Facilitate classroom and hands-on laboratory instruction aligned with the NCCER curriculum, preparing participants for entry-level employment and apprenticeship opportunities. Deliver competency-based training in electrical safety, basic electrical theory and circuits, tools and testing equipment, NEC navigation, wiring methods, conduit bending and raceways, blueprint and schematic interpretation, and residential electrical services. Demonstrate proper installation, troubleshooting, and safe work practices while preparing students for applicable NCCER assessments and industry-recognized credentials

Lab Supervision

Oversee students in a hands-on lab environment, guiding them through the safe use of miscellaneous equipment. Maintain lab equipment, machines, software licenses, and consumables. Enforce strict adherence to safety standards and operational procedures in labs and workshops. Enforce safety protocols and OSHA regulations to minimize risk and accidents.

Curriculum Development

Design and update instructional content covering electrical principles and practical applications. Ensure instructional materials meet educational goals and prepare students for certifications and workforce readiness.

Student Assessment

Evaluate and assess students’ skills, providing feedback to help improve their performance and technical competencies. Administer written, oral, and hands-on tests to gauge student proficiency. Support students in achieving certifications, where applicable.

Industry Engagement

Maintain industry connections to stay current with trends and technological advancements in general fabrication and advanced manufacturing. Liaise with local businesses and industries to ensure the training aligns with current job market needs.

Miscellaneous

Completes all other duties and responsibilities as assigned.

QUALIFICATIONS, KNOWLEDGE, AND SKILL REQUIREMENTS:

  • Associate degree in Electrical Technology, Electrical Systems, Construction Trades, or a related field; or an equivalent combination of education, apprenticeship training, industry certifications, and relevant work experience.
  • Minimum of five (5) years of experience in the electrical trade.
  • One (1) to two (2) years of teaching, training, mentoring, or workforce development experience preferred.
  • Demonstrated working knowledge of electrical theory, installation practices, electrical safety, tools and equipment, and the National Electrical Code (NEC).
  • Must meet Indian River State College credentialing requirements.
  • Must meet credentialing requirements set by Indian River State College.
  • Prior experience teaching or delivering technical training sessions in electrical or related trade settings.
  • Strong practical knowledge of the electrical trade and safe work practices.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of electrical theory, wiring methods, electrical safety, tools, equipment, and installation practices.
  • Working knowledge of the National Electrical Code (NEC).
  • Ability to safely demonstrate and supervise hands-on electrical training activities.
  • Ability to translate technical concepts into clear, practical, hands-on instruction.
  • Excellent communication, instructional, and classroom management skills.
  • Strong organizational skills, patience, and a passion for teaching and helping students succeed.

title: QA/QC Manager
description:
We are looking for an experienced QA/QC Manager with strong experience in interior design and fit-out projects. The candidate will be responsible for implementing and maintaining quality standards across projects, ensuring that all works, materials, and installations meet approved drawings, specifications, quality standards, and client requirements.

The ideal candidate should have strong knowledge of fit-out works, quality control procedures, inspections, documentation, and coordination with consultants, clients, subcontractors, and site teams.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop, implement, and maintain Project Quality Plans (PQP) and QA/QC procedures.
  • Establish quality standards and inspection procedures for interior fit-out projects.
  • Review project drawings, specifications, method statements, and material submittals.
  • Prepare and implement Inspection & Test Plans (ITPs) and checklists.
  • Conduct regular inspections of site activities and completed works.
  • Ensure all works are executed according to approved drawings, specifications, and project requirements.
  • Monitor the quality of joinery, carpentry, flooring, ceilings, partitions, painting, doors, furniture, and architectural finishes.
  • Coordinate material inspections and ensure materials comply with approved samples and specifications.
  • Manage and close NCRs, observations, and corrective/preventive actions.
  • Coordinate with consultants, clients, project managers, site engineers, subcontractors, and suppliers regarding quality matters.
  • Conduct internal quality audits and site quality inspections.
  • Monitor subcontractor quality performance and ensure compliance with project standards.
  • Maintain QA/QC documentation, inspection records, test reports, approvals, and quality registers.
  • Review and approve quality-related documentation submitted by subcontractors.
  • Identify quality risks and implement appropriate corrective actions.
  • Ensure proper inspection and documentation at various stages of project execution.
  • Participate in project meetings and provide regular quality status updates to management.
  • Assist with project handover, snagging, de-snagging, and final quality documentation.
  • Ensure compliance with applicable ISO standards and project-specific quality requirements.


Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering, Architecture, Construction Management, or a related field.
  • 7–12 years of experience in QA/QC, with significant experience in interior design and fit-out projects.
  • Strong experience with commercial, residential, hospitality, retail, or office fit-out projects.
  • Good knowledge of architectural finishes, joinery, carpentry, ceilings, partitions, flooring, painting, and other fit-out activities.
  • Strong understanding of QA/QC procedures, ITPs, method statements, checklists, NCRs, and inspection processes.
  • Experience coordinating with consultants, clients, subcontractors, suppliers, and project teams.
  • Ability to read and interpret architectural, structural, and MEP drawings.
  • Knowledge of relevant construction quality standards and specifications.
  • ISO 9001 knowledge/certification is an advantage.
  • Strong documentation, reporting, problem-solving, and communication skills.
  • Proficiency in MS Office, particularly Excel and Word.
  • UAE/GCC experience in interior fit-out is highly preferred.
