title: Director of Compliance, Employee Benefits-Insurance Advisory Solutions
description:
The Baldwin group is an award-winning entrepreneur-led and inspired insurance brokerage firm delivering expertly crafted commercial insurance and risk management, private insurance and risk management, employee benefits and benefit administration, asset and income protection, and risk mitigation strategies to clients wherever their passions and businesses take them throughout the U.S. and abroad. The Baldwin group has award-winning industry expertise, colleagues, competencies, insurers, and most importantly, a highly differentiated culture that our clients consider an invaluable expansion of their business. The Baldwin group (nasdaq: bwin), takes a holistic and tailored approach to insurance and risk management.


The Director of Benefits Compliance provides complex, senior-level legal and regulatory compliance support and guidance for the benefit of clients and colleagues. This role will have primary responsibility for supporting the West region and will serve as a key subject matter resource on federal and state health and welfare compliance matters, with particular expertise in California-specific requirements.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Coordinate with other compliance team members on the National Compliance Team throughout the country to complete large-scale projects and support day-to-day workflow and project operations.

  • Provide mentoring and guidance to junior compliance team members, including support with project management, drafting, research, public speaking and professional development, as well as interpretation of legal, regulatory and industry developments.

  • Participate in the planning, drafting and delivery of timely and legally relevant client deliverables, including regulatory rule summaries, statutory interpretations, compliance alerts, presentations, educational materials and other client- and colleague-facing resources.

  • At the direction of the National Director of Compliance, proactively manage the firm's compliance-related activities and duties for the West region of the United States. Help support sales and drive growth in the West region by partnering with client experience teams and advisors on sales initiatives, prospect meetings, educational sessions and trainings. Serve as a subject matter resource for California-specific employee benefits compliance matters, including state and local requirements affecting employer-sponsored health and welfare programs, and provide practical guidance and education to West region colleagues, clients and prospects.

  • Review, digest and translate regulatory and legal developments for the benefit of clients and colleagues, with an emphasis on translating complex requirements into practical, actionable guidance.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS & ABILITIES:

  • Knowledge of federal and state regulatory agencies, Congress and the executive branch, as well as the scope of legislative and regulatory rulemaking authority of each.

  • Demonstrated expertise in a wide range of health and welfare employee benefit-related laws, regulations, statutes and ordinances and the ability to assist clients and colleagues in understanding and navigating applicable compliance requirements.

  • Demonstrated knowledge and experience with California state and local laws and regulations impacting employer-sponsored health and welfare benefit programs, including the San Francisco Health Care Security Ordinance (SFHCSO), Cal-COBRA, California disability and paid family leave requirements, applicable state and local leave requirements, and other California-specific health and welfare mandates. Ability to monitor, interpret and communicate evolving California state and local requirements and their practical impact on employer benefit programs.

  • Ability to quickly and concisely review, draft, edit and explain complex legal rulemaking and litigation matters for the benefit of non-legal practitioners.

  • Ability to guide and mentor junior colleagues on all aspects of the Director's job-related duties and obligations.

  • Demonstrated leadership and project management capabilities, including the ability to take ownership of the timely and accurate development and delivery of large-scale client deliverables and colleague-facing resources.

  • Ability to effectively manage competing priorities and deadlines across a broad range of tasks affecting both clients and colleagues.

  • Ability to translate complex legal theories, judicial determinations and regulatory matters into clear, practical guidance for the benefit of clients, colleagues and prospective clients.

  • Ability to create forms, documents, alerts, checklists, presentations and graphical interpretations of current law and regulation across a range of software applications, including Microsoft Office applications.

  • Ability to triage, organize, respond to and manage a high volume of client-facing correspondence and deliverables across email, print, virtual and live training seminars, workshops and conferences, as well as individual compliance inquiries and follow-up requests.

  • Strong understanding of client service and prospecting processes and the ability to effectively support sales, finalist presentations, prospect meetings, client education and ongoing client relationship activities throughout the West region.

EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE:

  • Graduate/Advanced Degree (Master, JD, Ph.D., etc.) required

  • Juris Doctor strongly preferred

  • Minimum of 10 years of relevant health and welfare employee benefits compliance experience required; significant experience advising on California-specific health and welfare compliance requirements strongly preferred.

IMPORTANT NOTICE:

This position description is intended to describe the level of work required of the person performing in the role and is not a contract. The essential responsibilities are outlined; other duties may be assigned as needs arise or as required to support the organization. All requirements may be subject to reasonable accommodation to applicants and colleagues who need them for medical or religious reasons.

The starting pay is $185,000 salary. Salary is negotiable upon time of offer

description:

STRENGTH COACH WITH RAPID GROWTH TO MANAGEMENT: Are you a GA or a Head Strength Coach looking for an amazing opportunity to work with one of the premiere sports performance companies in the country? After 3 months of training at our headquarters in Minnesota, you could have the opportunity to become the Director of our soon-to-be ETS Germantown facility.

ABOUT ETS PERFORMANCE: Since 2010 ETS has produced over 2,500 D1/D2/D3 athletes, 200+ Pros, and over 50,000 athletes in total from various sports; football, hockey, basketball, softball, soccer, baseball, lacrosse, swimming. With nearly 40 locations in the USA, this is the perfect time to embark on a career with a thriving team. We’re looking for true leaders who will GROW WITH US as we expand in the United States.

PRO ATHLETE STRENGTH & CONDITIONING DIRECTOR: TRAIN THE PROS AND UP AND COMING STARS. We are looking for athletes who know what it takes to perform at the highest level and have a passion to guide and motivate the next wave of athletes with the desire to achieve UNCOMMON results.

THE IDEAL MATCH TO LEAD OUR TEAM: The ideal candidate would have a strong interest in working with youth, high school, college and professional athletes in an electric atmosphere utilizing proven next level training and business systems that continue to set ETS apart from the competition.

PROFESSIONAL ATHLETE ATMOSPHERE AND DEVELOPMENT: In addition to being aligned with ETS Partner NFL All-Pro ADAM THIELEN, KIRK COUSINS, and CJ HAM among other notable current and past professional athletes, the candidate will immediately be surrounded by one of our elite ETS Sports Performance Facility Directors along with a host of other successful ETS Performance Specialists from across the country.

TRUE CAREER GROWTH: The entire “ETS Family” will be there to assist and support the Performance Specialist to enhance and maximize the development of our athletes at the highest possible level. This opportunity includes a very competitive industry level salary along with personal development growth and promotions plan that can’t be matched.

THE METHOD: The ETS training philosophy is to provide every athlete (regardless of age and sport) the opportunity to significantly improve their relative strength, power, linear and lateral speed, ability to bio-mechanically master the art of deceleration while also significantly improving their overall athleticism and becoming less prone to injury.
Our systematic and step by step approach to developing better athletes will dramatically improve performance on the field, court, track, pool or ice. Each athlete will take part in a progressive ability-appropriate plan of strength, speed, agility and deceleration training that will not only allow them to maximize their skills and athleticism for their sport, but also improve their overall athleticism. It’s crucial for every athlete to develop the basic-fundamental athletic and bio-mechanical movements, strength techniques and deceleration protocols through a customized plan in order to truly maximize their potential.

We believe the missing link in most programs is the lack of consistent and professional emphasis and attention to detail on the basics of an athlete’s complete athletic development separated from their sport-specific skill work. Our vision is that every athlete will experience an unmatched next level training atmosphere that is equally focused on character development, accountability and competition as it is the next level performance results that every athlete will gain.

SERIOUS GAINS AND GOALS: Our goal is for every athlete to leave each session understanding the physical objective for that session, but also understand the importance of consistency, dedication and commitment to ensure they are maximizing their results.

We are seeking motivated Strength and Performance Specialists that are searching for a unique opportunity to work and flourish in the private sector of the Sports Performance industry.

COMMITMENT REQUIRED

  • Work week consists of a minimum of 40-60 hours a week
  • Available for off-site meetings – Should conduct a minimum of one offsite meeting per week with a coach or director of a team, school, or club/organization
  • Available via cell, email & social media for staff, athletes, parents, & potential leads
  • Committed to growing all of the ETS Performance Services (Speed Plus, Strength Plus, Elite Speed, Team Training, Adult Fit Program (off peak performance hours), etc.
  • Committed to following the ETS Marketing Plan and daily duties
  • Committed to monthly dialogue with parents to provide a training update/progress report for their athlete
  • Follow and adhere to all daily, weekly and monthly responsibilities via the ETS Directors Non-Negotiable Manual

PERFORMANCE EXPECTATIONS

  • Perform a minimum of 3-5 new athlete evaluations each week
  • Arrive 30 minutes early to work each day
  • Be present and command the training floor during all ETS training sessions
  • Follow-up with past inquiries and prospects
  • Provide a safe, clean and intense training atmosphere
  • Maintain a positive public image on social media platforms
  • Create and maintain a positive image both inside and outside the facility
  • Wear proper ETS attire for every session/shift
  • Interview and hire all new staff/interns each semester/quarter
  • Follow and adhere to ETS Directors Non-Negotiable Manual

Job Description Summary:

The Capilano University Library is seeking a Copyright and Public Services Librarian to join our faculty in a Regular Limited Term position from October 1, 2026 to August 31, 2027. The librarian in this role will be responsible for teaching critical information literacy workshops for English 100 and other courses, providing in-person and online research services for the campus community, co-managing our institutional repository, and developing copyright education and tools for students, faculty, and colleagues. The librarian in this position will work primarily at our North Vancouver campus, with one day per week at the Squamish campus during the fall and spring terms while classes are in session.

Job Description:

We have a robust teaching program at CapU. We help students and faculty become more skilled at library research and critical information literacy both in the classroom and at our Research Help Desk. Our team values active learning, needs- and outcomes-based class design, and critical approaches to pedagogy, technologies, and research processes. The librarian in this role can expect mentorship in learning design and delivery as they teach classes primarily in English 100 classrooms and similar courses. Work on the Research Help Desk will involve providing personalized, one-on-one research support in-person and online via chat or video call.

As part of offering student support to the Squamish campus, this librarian will act as a liaison between the Squamish team and the library, including collaborating with the Squamish Student Success and Experience team members on student-focused initiatives as time and their areas of responsibility permit.

The copyright portfolio includes collaborating with the University Librarian to develop copyright education and awareness, including promoting fair dealing and users' rights. This librarian will develop and maintain copyright education and tools for campus community use, such as our Copyright Guide, and provide copyright support in response to individual needs. This will include providing support to library staff for ILL and course pack processes.

The Copyright and Public Services Librarian also collaborates with the systems team to manage the CapU Institutional Repository, focusing on collection development, teaching opportunities, and faculty partnerships.

Required Qualifications

  • MLIS or equivalent from an ALA-accredited university, or MLIS in progress with a Fall 2026 or Spring 2027 completion date

Required Skills and Experience

  • Outstanding service orientation and public service experience, preferably in a post-secondary environment

  • Knowledge of the Canadian copyright context and the rights and responsibilities of university students and faculty

  • Ability to design and deliver a lesson that prioritizes active learning and based on discrete learning outcomes

  • Excellent written and oral communication skills, including public speaking

  • Ability to work well both independently and collaboratively in a rapidly changing and diverse campus environment

Preferred Skills and Experience

  • Experience or training in instructional design, adult learning, or teaching

Additional Details:

Our Working Environment

This is a full-time (35 hours/week) position from October 1, 2026 - August 31, 2027. As this position was generated by a temporary secondment, we do not expect the position to be extended or to become permanent.

The Copyright and Public Services Librarian will join a team of seven other faculty librarians who work within a collegial management model. All librarians participate in collective decision-making related to work within the department, attend department meetings, and participate in peer evaluation, search-hire committees, and other working groups in the Library and across campus. Librarians collaborate with the University Librarian, Library staff, and partners across campus.

Benefits for this position include 42 annual vacation days and 42 professional development days, prorated for a mid-year start. We have a typical working schedule of Monday to Friday with flexible start and end times. Librarians work on campus and remotely, and the successful candidate can determine which day of the week they will spend at the Squamish campus according to their availability and the campus’s service needs.

The Capilano Faculty Association Collective Agreement informs our work, including our rights and responsibilities. The successful candidate will be placed on the faculty salary scale according to their previous experience as outlined in the collective agreement.

A full-time workload for 12 months is expressed at Capilano University as 8 sections. Because this position will start mid-year, the number of sections will be prorated to the start date. For example, an October 1 start date will result in 7.3337 sections. The salary scale is from $9,420 per section to a maximum of $14,391 per section, or $69,083 to $105,539 for the 11-month term, depending on scale placement.

title: Senior Salesforce Administrator
description:
We understand that the world we want tomorrow starts with how we do business today, and that’s why we’re inspired to make A Better World for Pets. Antech is comprised of a diverse team of individuals who are committed to each other’s growth and development. Our culture is centered on our guiding philosophy, The Five Principles: Quality, Responsibility, Mutuality, Efficiency and Freedom. Today Antech is driving the future of pet health as part of Mars Science & Diagnostics, a family-owned company focused on veterinary care.

Current Associates will need to apply through the internal career site. Please log into Workday and click on Menu or View All Apps, select the Jobs Hub app, then click the magnifying glass to Browse Jobs.

Senior Salesforce Administrator (m/f/d)

Are you an experienced Salesforce professional with a strong understanding of system administration, configuration and process optimisation? Do you enjoy translating business requirements into effective technical solutions?

In this role, you will play a key part in the day-to-day administration and optimisation of our Salesforce platform, while also taking ownership of minor functional developments. Working closely with internal stakeholders, external service providers and Salesforce partners, you will help ensure efficient business processes, high data quality and excellent support for our users.

Key Responsibilities

  • Take responsibility for the day-to-day administration and configuration of Salesforce, including user management, roles, profiles, permission sets, sharing rules, custom fields, page layouts and validation rules

  • Design, create and maintain complex, declarative automations using Salesforce Flows, as well as maintain existing legacy automations

  • Independently carry out minor development tasks and system adjustments, including simple Apex triggers, Apex classes and Lightning Web Components where declarative tools cannot provide the required solution

  • Work closely with external service providers and Salesforce partners on the design and implementation of complex solutions

  • Coordinate structured bug tracking and resolution through support and ticket management

  • Perform data imports, exports and bulk updates using tools such as Data Loader

  • Ensure high levels of data quality and consistency while complying with data protection regulations, including GDPR

  • Provide first- and second-level support to Salesforce users, carrying out error analysis and proactively resolving system and integration issues

  • Plan, test and deploy Salesforce releases three times per year

  • Maintain and refresh sandbox environments

  • Create and maintain system documentation, process descriptions and training materials for end users

  • Act as a key interface between business requirements and their technical implementation within Salesforce


Experience & Qualifications

  • Degree in (Business) Computer Science, Business Administration with an IT focus, or a comparable qualification; equivalent relevant professional experience will also be considered

  • 3–5+ years of proven, hands-on experience in Salesforce administration and customisation, preferably within a dynamic corporate environment

  • Fluent German and professional working proficiency in English, both written and spoken

  • Practical experience with declarative Salesforce development, particularly Salesforce Flows

  • Basic knowledge and initial practical experience in programmatic Salesforce development, such as Apex, Visualforce or Lightning Web Components

  • Deep understanding of Salesforce architecture, data models and security concepts, including sharing models and permission structures

  • Strong analytical skills, with the ability to quickly understand complex business processes and translate them into efficient technical Salesforce solutions

  • Basic understanding of interfaces, APIs and data flows between Salesforce and other systems, such as ERP systems, marketing automation platforms or data warehouses

  • Experience providing functional guidance and coordinating external developers and IT service providers

  • Structured, independent and solution-oriented approach to work, with a strong focus on quality

  • Excellent communication and teamwork skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non-IT colleagues

About Antech

Antech is a leader in veterinary diagnostics, driven by our passion for innovation that delivers better animal health outcomes. Our products and services span 90+ reference laboratories around the globe; in-house diagnostic laboratory instruments and consumables, including rapid assay diagnostic products and digital cytology services; local and cloud-based data services; practice information management software and related software and support; veterinary imaging and technology; veterinary professional education and training; and board-certified specialist support services.

Any resumes, curriculum vitae, and other unsolicited assistance from search firms that do not have a written search agreement or position-specific requisition submitted to any Associate of Antech will be deemed the sole property of Antech and no fee will be paid in the event the candidate is hired by Antech.

title: Staff Identity Governance and Access Engineer
location: Bellevue, Washington; Chicago, Illinois; Washington, DC
description:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

The Identity Governance and Access Security Team

The Identity Governance and Access Security team runs Identity Governance and Administration (IGA), Privileged Access Management (PAM), and Identity Security Posture Management (ISPM) for Okta itself — serving as Okta's "Customer Zero." The team owns the complete identity lifecycle for the workforce, from birthright provisioning through Workday to access certifications, privileged access management, and mover/leaver processes. What the team builds becomes the reference architecture that Okta customers deploy at scale.

The Staff Identity Security Engineer Opportunity

We're looking for a Staff Identity Security Engineer to take deep technical ownership of our Okta Identity Governance (OIG), Okta Privileged Access (OPA), and ISPM implementations. This is a senior individual-contributor role where you'll set technical direction for how the team builds on top of these platforms and raise the bar for the engineering team through review, mentorship, and documentation. You should be equally comfortable in an architecture discussion, in a live Okta Workflows debugging session, and writing the design doc that a Jira epic gets broken down from. The ideal candidate is a self-starter who thrives in an autonomous environment and actively drives "what's next" for our identity security posture — identifying process bottlenecks, designing technical solutions, and pushing initiatives from concept to production without waiting for direction.

What you'll be doing

  • OIG Architecture Ownership: Own OIG architecture end-to-end — design access request workflows, entitlement/Resource Collections structures, and certification campaigns that reduce reviewer fatigue and rubber-stamping.
  • Lifecycle, Birthright & RBAC Strategy: Lead lifecycle, birthright, and RBAC strategy — design and deploy automated birthright access rules, RBAC frameworks, and seamless joiner/mover/leaver (JML) processes across the enterprise.
  • Workday Integration Architecture: Drive Workday integration architecture — balance scheduled reconciliation (attribute accuracy) with Real-Time Sync (immediate termination), and define the attribute sets that access rules depend on.
  • Mover/Leaver Automation: Design and harden mover/leaver automation — implement attribute-driven group re-evaluation on role changes, safe decommissioning of stale access, and close gaps between automated joiner flows and historically manual processes.
  • OPA, ISPM & Zero Standing Privilege: Lead OPA, ISPM, and Zero Standing Privilege (ZSP) initiatives — design privileged session access, Just-In-Time (JIT) elevation, break-glass emergency access, identity security vulnerability detection, and tiering models for Tier 0/Tier 1 systems.
  • PAM & ISPM Metrics: Own PAM and ISPM telemetry and KPIs — establish and track metrics around standing-privilege reduction, JIT adoption, stale access cleanup, and break-glass test success as ongoing operational measures.
  • Okta Workflows Automation: Build and maintain Okta Workflows automation — streamline access requests, approvals, and remediation across IGA and PAM processes using the Okta Workflows engine.
  • Technical Leadership & Mentorship: Mentor engineers, review designs, and communicate with leadership — be the technical escalation point for the team's hardest problems, help junior engineers grow, and present clear updates, risk assessments, and roadmaps to executive stakeholders.

What you'll bring to the role

  • Domain Experience: Minimum 4+ years of direct, advanced experience managing and administering enterprise IGA, PAM/ISPM tools and platforms.
  • Birthright Provisioning & RBAC: Demonstrated hands-on experience designing and deploying Birthright Provisioning models and RBAC architectures in production environments.
  • PAM/OPA Tooling: Production experience with OPA or equivalent PAM tooling, including Zero Standing Privilege, Just-In-Time access models, break-glass design, and admin tiering.
  • ISPM Tooling: Production experience with ISPM tools (such as Okta ISPM) that integrate with EDR solutions like Crowdstrike Falcon.
  • Identity Standards: Solid grounding in identity and access standards (SAML, OIDC, OAuth 2.0, SCIM) and role/attribute-based access control concepts.
  • Lifecycle Ownership: Track record of owning technical designs for identity lifecycle problems (joiner/mover/leaver) end-to-end, from design doc through production rollout.
  • Compliance Experience: Experience operating in SOX and compliance-critical environments — understanding audit evidence requirements, segregation of duties, and access certification integrity.
  • Autonomy & Executive Communication: Works independently and drives initiatives without waiting for direction, with the executive-ready communication skills to present updates, risks, and roadmaps to leadership.

And extra credit if you have experience in any of the following!

  • Experience governing non-human identities (service accounts, API tokens, secrets, AI agents/workload identities) and scaling access certification programs — including distinct ownership models, lifecycle states, and certification approaches
  • Familiarity with ServiceNow and JIRA-based service request intake for IGA/PAM/ISPM operations
  • Okta certifications — Okta Certified Administrator, Okta Certified Consultant, or Okta Workflows Specialist

title: Software Engineer - Full-Stack (React)
description:
Excited to grow your career?

Our purpose is to make it easy for people to save and invest for a better future. We are looking for great people to join us, so please come and invest in YOUR future at Hargreaves Lansdown.

We know that sometimes people can be put off applying for a job if they don't tick every box. If you're excited about working for us and have most of the skills or experience we're looking for, please go ahead and apply. We’d love to hear from you!

About the role

We are building a next-generation platform for one of the UK's leading financial services providers — trusted by over 2 million clients and managing approximately £150 billion in assets. This is a unique opportunity to help shape technology that transforms how people invest and achieve financial freedom.

We are looking for a Software Engineer to join our Dealing Journeys squad, delivering critical capabilities at the heart of the investment experience.

You will join our Trading Tribe — a domain responsible for end-to-end investment journeys, from pre-trade decision-making and order placement through to trade execution, delivering fast, reliable and seamless investing experiences at scale.

In this role, you will build and enhance modern applications using TypeScript, contributing to products and platforms used by millions of clients. Working closely with engineers, product managers and designers, you will deliver high-quality solutions while continuously developing your technical skills and engineering expertise.

By joining us, you will help deliver innovative, scalable solutions that make investing simpler, faster and more accessible for millions of investors across the UK.

Be part of HL's future. Be part of the future of investing. Shape it with us.

What you'll do

  • Develop, maintain and improve high-quality software across web, mobile and backend services, following engineering, security and regulatory standards

  • Collaborate with engineers, product managers and designers to deliver valuable new features and enhancements for our clients

  • Build and enhance customer-facing experiences using React and React Native, while contributing to the APIs and services that support them

  • Write clean, secure and maintainable code, actively participating in code reviews and adopting engineering best practices

  • Support and improve existing applications, helping ensure they remain reliable, performant and scalable

  • Contribute to the development of cloud-native and distributed systems that support business-critical customer journeys

  • Develop automated tests and contribute to quality engineering practices throughout the software development lifecycle

  • Apply modern secure coding practices and help ensure solutions meet regulatory and compliance requirements

  • Document solutions and technical decisions in line with team standards

  • Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives across engineering practices, tooling and developer experience

  • Build strong working relationships across the squad and wider engineering organisation

  • Participate in technical discussions, knowledge-sharing activities and communities of practice

  • Continuously develop your technical and interpersonal skills while contributing to a positive and collaborative team culture

What you bring

  • Commercial experience developing modern applications using TypeScript and React

  • Good understanding of frontend engineering principles, including component-based architectures, state management and performance optimisation

  • Solid knowledge of HTML, CSS and JavaScript/TypeScript

  • Experience designing and consuming REST APIs and/or GraphQL services

  • Understanding of cloud-native development practices and modern software delivery approaches

  • Experience working with AWS and cloud platforms

  • Knowledge of software design patterns, testing approaches and engineering best practices

  • Experience with automated testing and test frameworks

  • Understanding of CI/CD principles and development workflows

  • Awareness of accessibility best practices, including WCAG compliance and keyboard navigation support

  • Strong focus on writing secure, maintainable and well-tested code

  • Collaborative and communicative, with the ability to work effectively within cross-functional Agile teams

  • A proactive mindset and passion for learning new technologies and approaches

  • Comfortable contributing to technical discussions and continuously improving your engineering skills

Nice to have

  • Experience building mobile applications with React Native in a production environment

  • Experience working with PHP applications and services

  • Experience developing applications using Java

  • Experience contributing to backend services and APIs

  • Familiarity with microservice architectures and distributed systems

  • Experience working within highly regulated industries such as financial services

What Success Looks Like

You'll be comfortable taking ownership of features from design through to production, collaborating closely with design, product and engineering teams, and proactively identifying opportunities to improve both the customer experience and the way we work.

Why us?

Here at HL, we’re the UK’s number 1 investment platform for private investors, based in Bristol. For more than 40 years we’ve helped investors save time, tax and money on their investments.

To achieve our mission, we believe we have a workplace like no other, with constant learning, dynamic teams, and a great ethos. We're steered by core values that promote service, quality, innovation, and opportunity in everything we do.

What's on offer?

  • Discretionary annual bonus* and annual pay review
  • 25 days* holiday plus bank holidays and 1-day additional Christmas closure
  • Option to purchase an additional 5 days holiday**
  • Flexible working options available, including hybrid working
  • Enhanced parental leave
  • Pension scheme up to 11% employer contribution
  • Income Protection and Life insurance (4 x salary core level of cover)
  • Private medical insurance*
  • Health care cash plans - including optical, dental, and outpatient care
  • Health screening programme
  • Help@hand - confidential support including mental health counselling and remote GP
  • Wellhub - unlimited access to fitness providers and wellness coach sessions
  • Variety of travel to work schemes with bike storage and shower facilities
  • Inhouse barista and deli serving subsidised coffee and sandwiches
  • Two paid volunteering days per year

* dependant on role level

** only available to select during our annual benefits window, in November each year

​

title: Lead Polysomnographic Technologist
description:
At Duly Health and Care, you are supported to do your best work and make a meaningful impact every day. You will be part of a collaborative, physician-led team that works as one and puts patients at the center of everything we do.

With a connected network of providers, care teams, and services across primary and specialty care, surgery centers, imaging, lab, and therapy, you are part of a system designed to deliver high-quality, coordinated care. Together, we create an environment where you can grow, contribute, and help improve the experience and outcomes for every patient we serve.

Overview: Lead Polysomnographic Technologist (Sleep Tech)


Position Highlights:

  • ​Full-Time, 40 hours per week

  • Hours: 4 x 10-hour overnight shifts; Monday-Friday approximately 7:30PM to 6:00AM

  • Every other weekend required

  • Location: Lockport

  • Travel: Lombard as needed.


Benefits:

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision benefits that include healthcare navigation assistance.

  • Access to a mental health benefit at no cost.

  • Employer provided life and disability insurance.

  • Immediate 401(k) match.

  • 5 days paid volunteer time off.

  • A culture committed to community engagement and social impact.

  • 12 weeks parental leave at 100% pay and a financial benefit for adoption and surrogacy for non-physician team members.


Responsibilities:

A Polysomnographic Technologist works under the general supervision of the Sleep Center Supervisor and clinical direction of the pulmonary physicians who are diplomats of the ABSM. The technologist provides comprehensive evaluation and treatment of sleep disorders.

  • Assist in ordering supplies, helping with quality assurance

  • Assist with scheduling PM Sleep Technicians

  • Gather & review patient information -histories, medications, procedure request and study protocol

  • Explain procedures and orient patient to sleep lab

  • Prepare and calibrate equipment required for testing to determine proper functioning and make adjustments if necessary

  • Perform routine positive airway pressure (PAP) mask fitting

  • Follow procedural protocols (such as Multiple Sleep Latency Test (MSLT), Maintenance of Wakefulness Test (MWT), parasomnia studies, PAP and oxygen titration, etc. to ensure collection of appropriate data

  • Follow "lights out" procedures to establish and document baseline values

  • Perform polysomnographic data acquisition

  • Document routine observations

  • Implement appropriate interventions

  • Follow "lights on" procedures to verify integrity of collected data and complete the data collection process

  • Assist with scoring sleep/wake stages and clinical events

  • Generate accurate reports

  • Comply with applicable laws, regulations & guidelines

  • Perform routine equipment care and maintenance and inventory evaluations

  • All other duties as assigned


Qualifications:

  • Successful completion of an accredited polysomnographic program leading to an associate’s degree with emphasis on polysomnography

  • Successful completion of an accredited polysomnographic program with emphasis on polysomnography or completion of ASTEP Program

  • Registered Polysomnographic Technologist (RPSGT) by the Board of Registered Polysomnographic Technologists required OR Certified Polysomnographic Technician (CPSGT) upon hire with RPSGT obtained within 6 months of hire

  • BLS certification required

  • A minimum of 3 years experience as a Polysomnographic Technician preferred.

The compensation for this role includes a base pay range of $25.94-38.91 with the actual pay determined by factors such as skills, experience, education, certifications, geographic location, and internal equity. Additional compensation may be available through shift differentials, bonuses, and other incentives. Base pay is only a portion of the total rewards package.

Artificial Intelligence Disclosure

Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools may be used in some portions of the candidate review process for this position, however, all employment decisions will be made by a person.

title: Client Service Coordinator
description:
If you are a current associate, you will need to apply through our internal career site. Please log into Workday and click on the Jobs Hub app or search for Browse Jobs.

The Client Service Coordinator ("CSC") drives the flow of clients and pets through the hospital, maximizes the productivity of the veterinary medical team (in terms of numbers of clients and pets), ensures good communication with associates and clients, and coordinates the care of clients and pets in a happy, welcoming, friendly and efficient manner, influencing clients to return and refer their friends and families.

ESSENTIAL RESPONSIBILITIES AND TASKS  Live and exemplify the Five Principles of Mars, Inc. within self and team.  Actively recruit new clients by promoting hospital services and route the flow of clients and pets to ensure superior client care and maximum productivity of the veterinary medical team.  Maximize the number of pets seen by the hospital team through through a productive and efficiently run hospital to support the needs of our wellness plan clients.  Provide professional, efficient and exceptional service at all times. This includes encouraging hospital visits, welcoming clients and pets, ensuring that they are comfortable in the hospital, and educating them about their pet's health.  Educate clients about Optimum Wellness Plans, preventative care, pet health needs and hospital services Assist incoming clients by completing the required documentation, entering all pet information and history in the computer, utilizing proper collars and tags for identification, and ensuring prompt service.  Assist outgoing clients by providing all necessary instructions, information and invoices, dispensing prescription items per the veterinarian's instructions, selling retail products and scheduling future appointments.  Manage the finances by maintaining accurate balances and utilizing proper opening and closing procedures.  Conduct administrative function

THE FIVE PRINCIPLES  Quality – The consumer is our boss, quality is our work and value for money is our goal.  Responsibility – As individuals, we demand total responsibility from ourselves; as associates, we support the responsibility of others.  Mutuality – A mutual benefit is a shared benefit; a shared benefit will endure.  Efficiency – We use resources to the full, waste nothing and do only what we can do best.  Freedom – We need freedom to shape our future; we need profit to remain free.

CAPABILITIES AND EXPERIENCE (CAN DO)  Ability to multi-task- Manages multiple tasks at one time; quickly and accurately shifts attention among multiple tasks under distracting conditions without loss of accuracy or appearance of frustration.  Communication skills - Reads, writes and speaks fluent English, using appropriate grammar, style and vocabulary. Correctly spells commonly used English words and job specific terms. Demonstrates exceptionally strong written and verbal communication skills.  Organizational ability – Demonstrates a systematic approach in carrying out assignments. Is very orderly and excels at cutting through confusion and turning chaos into order.  Problem solving skills - Demonstrates a strong ability to identify, analyze and solve problems. Translates problems into practical solutions.  Client service skills - Consistently ensures the team provides the client with attentive, courteous and informative service. Gains and shows personal satisfaction from delivering great service.  Intellectual ability - Accurately and consistently follows instructions delivered in an oral, written or diagram format. Can provide directions.  Mathematical ability - Ability to add, subtract, multiply and divide, and to compute rate, ratio and percent; ability to convert units of measurement.  Computer skills - Comfortably and confidently uses a computer and specialized software. Microsoft Word, Excel, Access, Outlook, etc.

ATTITUDES (WILLDO)  Initiative – shows willingness and aptitude to use own discretion in taking appropriate steps in finding solutions to problems; presents options and ideas to enhance current processes or procedures. Takes on additional responsibility when both big and small tasks need to be done.  Integrity – Firmly adheres to the values and ethics of Banfield Pet Hospitals. Exhibits honesty, discretion, and sound judgment.  Cooperativeness – Willing to work with others, collaborating and compromising where necessary; promptly share relevant information with others.  Flexibility – Is open to changing situations and opportunities and is willing to perform all tasks assigned.  Independence – Able and willing to perform tasks and duties without supervision.  Tolerance for Stress / Resiliency – Maintains a positive “can do” outlook, rebounds quickly from frustrations and unpleasantness, and maintains composure and friendly demeanor while dealing with stressful situations.

SPECIAL WORKING CONDITIONS  Ability to work at a computer for long periods of time.  Ability to be confident around pets (i.e., dogs, cats, birds, reptiles, etc.)  Client needs and work volume may often require more than 40 hours per week to complete essential duties of this job. This position requires special hours including working weekends and evenings.  Must have mental processes for reasoning, remembering, mathematics and language ability (reading, writing, and speaking the English language) to perform the duties proficiently.  The noise level in the work environment is moderately high.  Requires sufficient ambulatory skills in order to perform duties while at hospital.  Ability to stand, walk, stoop, kneel, crouch, and climb as well as manipulate (lift, carry, move) up to 50 pounds.  Requires good hand-eye coordination, arm-hand-finger dexterity with the ability to grasp, and visual acuity to use a keyboard and operate equipment.  Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus. Position Description Client Service Coordinator - Job Description.docx 3 of 3 Last Revised: 08/20/2013 JP  Associate is routinely exposed to a variety of pets that may bite or scratch, and on occasion, exposed to anesthesia, radiation, biological hazards and medication/controlled substances.

EXPERIENCE, EDUCATION AND/OR TRAINING  High School Diploma or equivalent preferred.  Must be at least 18 years old to perform duties involving radiography (x-ray) and exposure to radioactive substances.  One year related experience required with customer service preferred.  Medical background (veterinary technician, human healthcare, pharmaceutical, etc.) with medical terminology training is preferred.

$15.00 - $18.69 Hourly

title: Platform Owner – Customer360 Integration
description:
Worker Type:

Permanent

Here at BNZ, it's about more than just banking. We work together in an agile, energising environment to create innovative solutions through our promise "If you can imagine a better future, let's find a way."

We support wellbeing, flexible working and have a generous leave offering. There is the opportunity for growth, learning and career development. No two days are the same.

Ko mātou tēnei | This is Us

We have an exciting opportunity for a Platform Owner to lead our Customer360 Integration team and shape the Integrations capability behind some of BNZ's most strategic technology investments.

At BNZ, we're transforming how we serve our customers through modern, connected technology that makes banking simpler, faster, and more reliable. As part of the Customer360 programme, our Integrations connect Salesforce/nCino with core systems, data platforms, banker and customer channels across the bank.

This is a permanent, full-time opportunity based in either Wellington or Auckland, with a hybrid working approach of three days in the office and two days working flexibly.

Mō te Tūranga | About the Role

You will be responsible for maximising the value delivered by our Integrations while ensuring they remain secure, resilient, scalable, well-governed and sustainable to operate over the long term.

You'll provide both service ownership and people leadership, guiding a team of Business Analysts and working closely alongside our Integration Engineering Lead. You'll own the Customer360 Integrations roadmap, working with business stakeholders, Platform Owners, Architects and Engineers to prioritise delivery, continuous improvement and service performance.

What are the key responsibilities for this role?

  • Integrations Strategy & Roadmap Management - Develop and maintain the Customer360 Integrations strategy, roadmap and priorities, ensuring investment aligns to outcomes and enterprise architecture direction.
  • Backlog Prioritisation & Value Delivery - Own and prioritise the backlog, balancing business demand, technical debt, operational risk, regulatory expectations and strategic initiatives to maximise value.
  • Service Ownership & Operational Excellence - Monitor reliability, security and availability through data-driven metrics, continuous improvement and service maturity initiatives.
  • Stakeholder Engagement & Collaboration - Partner with business stakeholders, technology leaders, vendors and delivery teams to align priorities, manage expectations and communicate direction, risks and outcomes.
  • People Leadership & Team Development - Lead and develop Business Analysts, fostering accountability, collaboration, continuous learning and high performance.

What is the team culture and environment like?

You'll join a collaborative leadership team working across Salesforce, nCino, integrations, data, security and enterprise technologies, with a shared focus on making complex change easier for customers, colleagues and teams to adopt.

We value curiosity, practical innovation and teamwork, and encourage people to challenge the status quo and bring fresh thinking to complex problems.

What is the most exciting thing about this opportunity?

Integrations sit at the heart of BNZ’s digital ecosystem. This role gives you the opportunity to influence how critical systems connect across the bank, reduce complexity for delivery teams, and enable seamless customer and colleague experiences.

You'll play a key leadership role in one of BNZ's largest technology programmes, helping shape strategy, guide investment decisions and deliver capabilities that support the future of banking.

What is the most challenging thing about this opportunity?

Customer360 Integrations support a wide range of business capabilities, programmes and technology teams, each with competing priorities, dependencies and evolving needs.

Success will come from creating clarity, balancing delivery commitments with sustainability and risk, and helping the team stay focused on the outcomes that matter most.

Job Description:

ABOUT ITW MEDICAL:

ITW (NYSE: ITW) is a Fortune 300 global multi-industrial manufacturing leader with revenue of $16 billion in 2025. General Accountability

The Lead Operator is the technical subject-matter expert for their assigned equipment, process, and production area. This role maintains hands-on ownership at the line level and serves as the first point of contact for real-time troubleshooting, process decisions, equipment issues, quality concerns, and operational support for production associates. The Lead Operator partners closely with the Shift Supervisor to achieve safety, quality, delivery, and productivity objectives while leading by example on the production floor.

12-hour weekly rotating shift: 7:00pm - 7:00am

Week 1: Monday, Tuesday

Week 2: Wednesday, Thursday, Friday

Duties and Responsibilities

  • Serve as the primary technical resource and subject-matter expert for assigned equipment and processes.

  • Lead by example in safety, quality, standard work, and operational discipline.

  • Conduct start-of-shift huddles and shift handoff communications within the assigned area.

  • Provide real-time troubleshooting and technical guidance to operators.

  • Conduct on-the-job training and maintain required training sign-off documentation.

  • Partner with the Shift Supervisor to identify operational risks and escalate issues promptly.

  • Provide hands-on leadership to stabilize quality, throughput, and equipment performance.

  • Make and communicate line-level operational recommendations including start/stop decisions in alignment with the Shift Supervisor.

  • Monitor productivity, scrap, downtime, flow, and process performance indicators.

  • Coordinate work activities to maximize equipment utilization and schedule attainment.

  • Maintain BOJ/EOJ records, production documentation, training records, and visual management systems.

  • Ensure adherence to work instructions, procedures, and quality requirements.

  • Review and maintain production records and documentation accuracy.

  • Identify, contain, and escalate quality concerns.

  • Support investigations and corrective actions.

  • Champion and exemplify safe work practices.

  • Address unsafe conditions immediately and escalate significant concerns.

  • Maintain workplace organization and housekeeping standards.

  • Track and communicate operational metrics.

  • Support inventory and production transactions.

Qualifications and Skills

Required

  • Minimum 2-3 years of manufacturing or production experience.

  • Minimum 1 year of experience operating equipment or processes within the assigned production area.

  • Demonstrated proficiency in established work instructions, procedures, quality requirements, and production documentation.

  • Ability to communicate effectively.

  • Demonstrated ability to train others and provide technical guidance.

Preferred

  • Experience performing equipment setup, changeovers, troubleshooting, and process adjustments.

  • Experience in a regulated manufacturing environment.

  • Experience leading projects, training initiatives, or continuous improvement activities.

  • Molding-specific process knowledge for molding area.

Competencies/Physical Demands

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

  • This position requires some physical movement around the machine areas, and an operator stands for 90% of their work shift.

  • While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to stand; walk; and use hands to finger, handle, or feel objects, tools, or controls.

  • The employee is frequently required to reach with hands and arms, stoop, kneel, or crawl; and talk or hear.

  • The employee must frequently lift and move 10-60 pounds.

  • Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, color vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus.

  • Ability to work safely around manufacturing equipment

  • Ability to wear PPE

title: Data engineer - Vessel data platform
description:
Cetasol builds iHelm, an AI-driven energy-optimisation and decision-support platform for commercial vessel fleets. An onboard main unit runs digital-twin models at the edge — including through weeks at sea without connectivity — a Captain's Display gives the bridge live fuel and speed guidance, and the iHelm cloud dashboard gives fleet managers performance analytics plus automated EU MRV and IMO DCS reporting. Operators using it report fuel savings of 10–25%. We are based in Gothenburg, backed by BackingMinds, Shift4Good and Sarsia, and deliberately focused on small and mid-sized vessels — the segment the large vendors overlook.

About the role

  • Own the data path from the onboard main unit to the cloud dashboard — ingestion, normalisation, and aggregation into trips, legs and voyages.
  • Build validation into that path so wrong values are caught before a customer sees them: unit and conversion checks, sensor plausibility bounds, drift and gap detection, and reconciliation between views that report the same metric.
  • Make data defects diagnosable. Today, "this number looks wrong" can take weeks to trace. We want lineage and tooling that make it an afternoon.
  • Model the warehouse layer that our reporting, analytics and ML work is built on.
  • Shape how we prevent recurrence instead of re-fixing: own the regression story for the data layer together with QA.

What we are looking for

  • 5+ years building production data systems, with Python as your primary language.
  • Real experience with time-series or streaming data — irregular sampling, gaps, late-arriving records, backfills.
  • Strong SQL and warehouse or dimensional modelling.
  • You test data, not only code: assertions, contracts and expectations that run in CI.
  • Comfort with physical measurement. You know why an instantaneous fuel-rate signal and a voyage consumption total can disagree, and how to establish which one is lying.
  • Experience with systems that must behave correctly over intermittent connectivity.
  • You can sit with a domain expert, understand what they mean, and turn it into a specification.

Nice to have

  • Maritime, automotive, energy or industrial IoT background.
  • AWS.
  • Exposure to digital-twin or physics-based modelling work.
  • Experience being the first senior person in a data function.

Practicalities

  • Location: Gothenburg, on-site.
  • Working language is English; Swedish is not required.

The ETS training philosophy is to provide every athlete (regardless of age and sport) the opportunity to significantly improve their relative strength, power, linear and lateral speed, ability to bio-mechanically master the art of deceleration while also significantly improving their overall athleticism and becoming less prone to injury.
Our systematic and step by step approach to developing better athletes will dramatically improve performance on the field, court, track, pool or ice. Our vision is that every athlete will experience an unmatched next level training atmosphere that is equally focused on character development, accountability and competition as it is the next level performance results that every athlete will gain. title: MECHANICAL ASSEMBLER
description:
Mechanical Assembler Job Description

Job Summary

Skilled in assembling complex mechanical systems and components with a strong emphasis on mechanical aptitude. Requires proficiency in using precision hand and power tools (wrenches, torque drivers, micrometers, etc.) to assemble, align, and test mechanical, hydraulic, pneumatic, and electro-mechanical systems. Candidates must demonstrate advanced problem-solving skills and hands-on experience in mechanical assembly, repair and trouble shooting

Key Responsibilities

  • Interpret and follow detailed technical drawings, blueprints, schematics, and work instructions to assemble machinery, equipment, and subassemblies with high precision.

  • Perform complex fitting, alignment, and fastening of mechanical components using tools such as torque wrenches, calipers, vises, and pneumatic tools to ensure accurate assembly.

  • Conduct functional testing and troubleshooting of assembled systems to verify performance, diagnose mechanical issues, and make necessary adjustments.

  • Handle, lift, and position heavy components (up to 50 pounds or more) using hoists, cranes, or manual methods, ensuring safe and efficient material handling.

  • Operate machinery to test functionality, including control levers, hydraulic systems, and precision instruments, while evaluating performance against specifications.

  • Maintain a safe work environment by adhering to safety protocols, using appropriate PPE, and identifying potential hazards in the assembly process.

  • Contribute to 5S workplace organization initiatives by maintaining a clean, organized workspace and proposing process improvements to enhance efficiency.

  • Collaborate effectively with team members, supervisors, and engineers to ensure high-quality assembly outcomes and maintain positive working relationships.

  • Meet or exceed expectations for productivity, quality, attendance, and safety while continuously improving mechanical skills and knowledge.

  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Work Environment

  • Manufacturing plant conditions (indoors, variable temperature, humidity, noise, and exposure to industrial materials such as oils, grease, and solvents).

  • Physical demands include lifting, pushing, pulling, and positioning items weighing up to 50 pounds or more.

  • Potential hazards include powered vehicles, pedestrian traffic, sharp tools, moving machinery, compressed air, and hydraulic systems.

  • Workdays may extend up to 10 hours with overtime as required.

Education and/or Experience

  • High school diploma or GED; equivalent combination of education and experience considered.

  • Minimum of 6 months to 1 year of hands-on mechanical assembly, repair, or maintenance experience in a manufacturing or industrial setting.

Job Qualifications

Required:

  • Demonstrated mechanical aptitude through prior experience in mechanical assembly, repair, or maintenance, with proficiency in using precision tools (e.g., torque wrenches, micrometers, dial indicators).

  • Ability to read and interpret complex technical drawings, blueprints, and schematics accurately.

  • Strong problem-solving skills to diagnose and resolve mechanical issues during assembly or testing.

  • Basic math and measurement skills, including the ability to use tape measures, calipers, and perform calculations involving fractions, percentages, and tolerances.

  • Proven ability to work independently and in a team, with a strong work ethic, reliable attendance, and focus on quality and safety.

  • Ability to multitask, prioritize, and adapt to changing priorities in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.

Preferred:

  • Advanced experience in mechanical assembly, including hydraulic, pneumatic, or electro-mechanical systems.

  • Familiarity with lean manufacturing principles or 5S methodologies.

  • Ability to write basic reports and maintain detailed assembly records.

  • Vocational training or certification in mechanical technology, machining, or a related field.

Job Description

Client Service Coordinator needed for Banfield Pet Hospital in Newton, MA!

SUMMARY OF JOB PURPOSE AND FUNCTION The Client Service Coordinator ("CSC") drives the flow of clients and pets through the hospital, maximizes the productivity of the veterinary medical team (in terms of numbers of clients and pets), ensures good communication with associates and clients, and coordinates the care of clients and pets in a happy, welcoming, friendly and efficient manner, influencing clients to return and refer their friends and families.

ESSENTIAL RESPONSIBILITIES AND TASKS

· Live and exemplify the Five Principles of Mars, Inc. within self and team.

· Actively recruit new clients by promoting hospital services and route the flow of clients and pets to ensure superior client care and maximum productivity of the veterinary medical team.

· Maximize the number of pets seen by the hospital team through through a productive and efficiently run hospital to support the needs of our wellness plan clients.

· Provide professional, efficient and exceptional service at all times. This includes encouraging hospital visits, welcoming clients and pets, ensuring that they are comfortable in the hospital, and educating them about their pet's health.

· Educate clients about Optimum Wellness Plans, preventative care, pet health needs and hospital services

· Assist incoming clients by completing the required documentation, entering all pet information and history in the computer, utilizing proper collars and tags for identification, and ensuring prompt service.

· Assist outgoing clients by providing all necessary instructions, information and invoices, dispensing prescription items per the veterinarian's instructions, selling retail products and scheduling future appointments.

· Manage the finances by maintaining accurate balances and utilizing proper opening and closing procedures.

· Conduct administrative functions as necessary.

· Other job duties as assigned.

SPECIAL WORKING CONDITIONS

· Ability to work at a computer for long periods of time.

· Ability to be confident around pets (i.e., dogs, cats, birds, reptiles, etc.)

· Client needs and work volume may often require more than 40 hours per week to complete essential duties of this job. This position requires special hours including working weekends and evenings.

· Associate is routinely exposed to a variety of pets that may bite or scratch, and on occasion, exposed to anesthesia, radiation, biological hazards and medication/controlled substances.

EXPERIENCE, EDUCATION AND/OR TRAINING

· High School Diploma or equivalent preferred.

The College Writer is a creative and experienced storyteller with a strong sense of narrative, voice, and audience. title: HR Info Systems Analyst, Sr
description:
Compensation Range

Who We Are:

At the City of High Point, we celebrate the creator in everyone. Building on our rich cultural history steeped in industrialism and innovation, our employees seek not only to transform themselves, but the world around us. We are collaborators, we are makers, we are visionaries.

We invite you to explore the many opportunities to serve our community, by sharing your talents, skills, and expertise. You'll join a diverse team of over 1300 individuals dedicated not just to making a career, but a difference; because what we create in High Point, changes the world!


Our Core Values:

  • Stewardship: We manage the city’s resources responsibly and make decisions that sustain High Point’s future. In other words, we take care of what we have today to build what we’ll need tomorrow
  • Welcoming: We create a friendly, open environment where residents, partners, and visitors feel valued and embraced. We want everyone who connects with High Point to feel welcomed, like they belong here.
  • Integrity: We act with honesty, transparency, and ethical responsibility in everything we do. That means doing what’s right – even when no one’s watching. This is how we earn our community’s trust.
  • Productivity: We stay focused on results, fostering creativity, innovation, and outside-the-box thinking. We don’t just get things done – we find smarter, better ways to do them.

What We Offer:
The City of High Point offers a competitive salary commensurate with education and experience. We also offer generous benefit package for full-time employees which include but are not limited to:

  • A guaranteed life-long monthly pension, once vested after 5 years of service
  • 401K and 457B Retirement Plans
  • PTO earned within first year
  • 13 Paid Holidays per year
  • Tuition Reimbursement Plan
  • Competitive medical, dental, and vision plans effective day one

What You'll Do:

The Senior HRIS Analyst serves as the functional lead for the City’s Human Resources Information Systems (HRIS), with primary responsibility for governance, optimization, and data integrity within the Workday environment. This role ensures alignment between HR business processes, position control practices, classification structures, compensation administration, and municipal budget authorization.
The position also serves as the City’s lead resource for workforce data and analytics, developing executive dashboards and operational reports that support data-driven decision-making by City leadership. Through accurate reporting and analysis of vacancy trends, FTE utilization, compensation structures, workforce demographics, and compliance requirements, the Senior HRIS Analyst enhances transparency, accountability, and strategic workforce planning.
This role partners with Human Resources, Payroll, Finance, Information Technology, department leaders, and external vendors to ensure effective system utilization, strong data governance, and continuous improvement of the City’s HR technology environment.

Essential Tasks & Responsibilities:

HRIS Administration

  • Manage the administration of HR systems, including Workday HCM
  • Serve as primary liaison with HRIS vendors and technical partners for system enhancements or integrations impacting HR data.
  • Monitor system functionality and coordinate resolution of issues with IT or external partners.
  • Maintain HRIS standards, documentation, and operating procedures.
  • Identify and implement process improvements that enhance efficiency and data quality.

Position Management & Compensation Administration

  • Serve as functional lead for position management, ensuring alignment with approved classifications, pay grades, funding sources, and organizational structure.
  • Oversee position control processes including reclassifications, creation of newly budgeted positions, deactivations, funding changes, and vacancy management to ensure compliance with budget and Council authorization.
  • Maintain and audit position restrictions, job profiles, supervisory organizations, FTE allocations, and reporting relationships.
  • Administer and support the City’s compensation plan, including classification studies and pay structure maintenance.
  • Compile and analyze data related to salaries, positions, benefits, and workforce trends.

Reporting, Analytics & Compliance

  • Develop and maintain executive dashboards, workforce analytics, and operational reports for HR leadership and City management.
  • Ensure data integrity through regular audits and validation processes.
  • Support compliance reporting, including EE04 and other regulatory workforce reporting requirements.
  • Provide insights into workforce metrics such as vacancy trends, FTE utilization, and compensation planning.

System Enhancements & End-User Support

  • Oversee testing and validation of HR system updates, enhancements, and data conversions.
  • Translate HR operational requirements into functional system specifications.
  • Diagnose and resolve end-user issues; provide training and user guidance.
  • Support stabilization and continuous improvement of the Workday environment.

Organizational Support & Special Projects

  • Act as internal consultant to HR and departments on system capabilities, reporting needs, and workforce data.
  • Provide process and policy improvement recommendations.
  • Assist the HR Director with employee engagement and recognition initiatives as assigned.

Qualifications:

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Public Administration, or related field
  • Minimum of three (3) years of progressive HR/HRIS experience.
  • At least two (2) years of hands-on Workday experience supporting configuration, reporting, or system administration.
  • Strong analytical and reporting skills within HR systems.
  • Ability to translate business requirements into effective system solutions.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Workday certifications
  • Experience in municipal or public sector HR.
  • Experience managing position control and classification processes
  • Experience supporting payroll, benefits, or timekeeping
  • Experience with regulatory and compliance reporting in government environments.
  • IPMA-SCP/CP
  • SHRM-SCP/CP
The work location of this job will be 211 S Hamilton St High Point, North Carolina.

Our Commitments
The City of High Point is dedicated to fostering a work environment that values individuals from all backgrounds and seeks to attract and retain the most qualified partners in service to the citizens of High Point. As an at-will employer, the City allows employees to terminate their employment, or be terminated at any time, with or without cause, as long as it is not prohibited by law.

The City of High Point is committed to classifying and compensating its employees fairly for the work they do, weighing both the internal capabilities and the external market. While the job description is not intended to and does not create a contract of employment, we are excited to use this “living document” as a guide for managing performance and positions to ensure job descriptions are reflective of the current work required by the incumbent or expected by any candidate to whom an offer of employment is extended.

The City of High Point is committed to providing a safe, comfortable working environment for all employees. To that end, we are proud to comply with all Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA) requirements, as well as make reasonable accommodations to candidates and employees as we are able in accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA). Candidates selected for employment must undergo (a.) a drug screening, in accordance with the City’s drug and alcohol policy and (b.) a background screening to determine whether there is any current, pending, or previous charge, conviction or other infraction deemed incompatible with service in the capacity for which the candidate is being hired. In lieu of or in addition to background screening, candidates selected for employment in a position that requires working with children in any capacity must be fingerprinted and undergo a criminal history record check conducted by the North Carolina State Bureau of Investigation. Certain positions are considered so critical to the health and safety of others that a candidate cannot be placed in any such position without passing a pre-placement physical exam. The City offers employment to successful candidates conditioned upon the City’s receipt of satisfactory results from all required screenings, checks, and exams, as applicable.

title: Program Manager
description:
The Program Manager (PM) at Dominique Dawes Academy is responsible for the operational and quality aspects of daily program delivery and coaching team leadership supporting the academy's core recreational gymnastics and ninja offerings. This role spends the majority of its time on the floor, serving as Manager on Duty (MOD) for a significant portion of scheduled hours, ensuring classes, camps, and events run safely, on time, and to a high standard. Reporting to the General Manager, the PM coordinates lesson plans, class schedules and rotations, and manages and develops coaching staff, while delivering an exceptional customer experience for families. The PM plays an integral part in fostering a fun, safe, and positive environment for children and families, and supports the General Manager on key performance indicators such as customer satisfaction, retention, and enrollment growth.


Key Responsibilities

  • Serve as Manager on Duty (MOD) for a significant portion of scheduled shifts, overseeing daily floor operations, safety, and staff presence.
  • Coordinate program change-overs, floor scheduling, and class rotations, ensuring classes and programs run on time and align with established quality standards.
  • Monitor cleanliness, safety, and readiness of the gym and equipment; assist with safety audits, enforce policies, and follow up on incident reports.
  • Ensure the training floor is maintained as a safe environment for participants and staff.
  • Build and maintain a welcoming, safe, and engaging training environment; serve as the on-floor point of contact for families, addressing inquiries and resolving concerns with professionalism and care.
  • Support the General Manager with hiring and selecting coaches for open positions.
  • Supervise, schedule, onboard, and develop staff and coaches.
  • Foster a culture of teamwork, accountability, and continuous improvement among staff.
  • Maintain open communication with parents regarding program updates and participant progress.
  • Support the General Manager with staffing and execution logistics for seasonal camps, special events, open gyms, and birthday parties.
  • Coordinate and drive all gymnastics and ninja fitness programs year-round, ensuring alignment with Dominique Dawes Academy’s mission and standards.
  • Partner with leadership to update curriculum and roll out timely lesson plans.
  • Partner with the General Manager to develop class schedules, program calendars, and event logistics plans to support efficient operations and high-quality participant experiences.
  • Lead day-of-execution of programming and events, ensuring camps, special events, open gyms, and birthday parties are properly staffed and executed to the academy's standards of excellence.
  • Provide operational input on program improvements as requested by the General Manager.
  • Assist with spotting and actively participate in floor activities/instruction when needed to support class flow and staff coverage.
  • Uphold and model the academy's core values of respect, teamwork, and excellence in all interactions.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.


Core Competencies


  • Strong leadership and team development skills, with the ability to coach, motivate and hold staff accountable.
  • Strong operational judgement with the ability to make timely decisions related to staffing, safety, programming, and daily floor operations.
  • Customer-focused mindset with a commitment to delivering exceptional experiences for families and participants.
  • Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills.
  • Collaborative approach to working with staff and leadership to address challenges continuously improve program operations.
  • Strong interpersonal and written skills to effectively engage with staff, families, and leadership.
  • Adaptable and proactive, with the ability to respond effectively to changing staffing, programming, and operational needs.
