title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join a growing AI team and take ownership of the application and integration layer behind a new generation of AI-powered products.

This is a genuinely full-stack engineering role, combining production-grade backend development, API design, AI integrations and frontend engineering. You'll work across the full application lifecycle, designing the services and interfaces that connect AI capabilities to the products customers and colleagues use every day.

You'll play a key role in building MCP integrations, agent-to-agent connectivity and robust API services, while also developing responsive, accessible interfaces in React and TypeScript.

What you'll be doing

  • Own the application and integration layer of AI products end to end, covering APIs, integrations, service boundaries and frontend development.
  • Design, build and maintain MCP servers that safely expose systems, content and tooling to AI agents.
  • Develop agent-to-agent connectivity, including message contracts, state management, retries and failure handling.
  • Design clear, scalable APIs using REST and/or GraphQL, including authentication, authorisation, versioning and streaming interfaces such as SSE or WebSockets.
  • Build production frontend applications using React, TypeScript and JavaScript.
  • Work closely with UX and product teams to turn designs into accessible, responsive and intuitive interfaces.
  • Develop AI-specific user experiences including streaming responses, citations, source information, agent/tool progress and graceful error handling.
  • Integrate with internal platforms and third-party services, considering security, scalability, performance and reliability.
  • Establish automated testing across backend and frontend applications, including unit, contract and end-to-end testing.
  • Work with the platform engineering team on deployment, observability, logging, tracing and operational readiness.
  • Act as the technical owner for the application and integration layer, making and documenting key architectural decisions.
  • Provide technical guidance, code reviews and mentoring to other engineers.

You should have:

  • Strong commercial experience with Python for backend and integration development.
  • Strong TypeScript/JavaScript and React experience building production applications.
  • Strong API design experience, including REST and/or GraphQL, authentication, authorisation, versioning and streaming.
  • Hands-on experience with MCP (Model Context Protocol) or comparable tool/plugin integration technologies, alongside an interest in AI agents and agent-to-agent connectivity.
  • Solid experience with AWS, ideally including services such as Lambda, ECS, API Gateway, S3, CloudFront, Cognito and IAM.
  • Experience designing and operating distributed or event-driven systems.
  • A strong understanding of observability, testing and CI/CD practices.
  • Experience working with data platforms or stores such as MongoDB, OpenSearch or Databricks.
  • Experience integrating internal systems and third-party services securely and reliably.
  • Experience working closely with designers to deliver production-quality frontend applications.
  • A good understanding of accessibility and frontend performance.

Experience with RAG, AI agents, tool use or other generative AI application patterns would be advantageous, although deep ML expertise isn't required.

This is an opportunity to have genuine ownership over how AI capabilities become usable, scalable software products.

You'll be joining an AI-focused engineering environment where you can work at the intersection of software engineering, APIs, cloud infrastructure and generative AI, while helping establish the engineering standards and architecture that will support future products.

If you're a senior engineer who enjoys moving between backend architecture and frontend delivery, wants ownership rather than simply a list of tickets, and is excited about where AI agents and modern application architecture are heading, we'd love to hear from you.

title: IT Support Analyst
description:
When you join AMA Group, you’re joining the largest collision repair network across Australia and New Zealand – an ASX-listed organisation with more than 3,200 team members across 140+ locations.

Every year, our teams help get more than 300,000 people and businesses back on the road.

Behind an operation of this scale is a technology environment that keeps thousands of people connected and our sites operating – and that’s where you come in.

We’re looking for an IT Support Analyst to join our IT Service Delivery team, based in Rowville.

If you love solving problems, enjoy helping people and want an IT role where you’ll be exposed to a large, geographically diverse business, this is an opportunity to do much more than sit behind a service desk.

Who is AMA Group?

AMA Group is a leader in the Australian and New Zealand collision repair industry, with operations spanning collision and heavy vehicle repair, automotive parts and workshop consumables, vehicle recycling and specialist automotive services.

Our network includes some of the most recognised businesses in the industry and supports everything from passenger and prestige vehicles through to commercial vehicles, trucks and buses.

We’re a large, complex and constantly evolving organisation – which makes IT an incredibly important part of keeping our people and our business moving.

For someone building a career in IT, that means exposure to the systems, technology and challenges that come with supporting a major multi-site organisation – along with opportunities to learn, develop and grow your career within the Group.

The opportunity

As an IT Support Analyst, you’ll be one of the first people our employees turn to when they need technology support.

And with thousands of employees across a national network, there’s plenty to keep things interesting.

One minute you could be troubleshooting Microsoft 365, the next setting up a new employee, configuring a laptop, resolving a connectivity issue or supporting the technology requirements of a new AMA Group site.

You’ll work alongside our broader IT team to solve problems, keep our people productive and make technology easier for our employees to use.

What you’ll get involved in

  • Be the first point of contact for IT incidents and service requests
  • Troubleshoot Windows, Microsoft 365, Teams, Outlook, OneDrive, mobile devices, printers and connectivity
  • Set up and deploy laptops, computers, mobile devices and other IT equipment
  • Support employee onboarding, offboarding and access changes
  • Complete standard administration across Active Directory and Microsoft Entra ID
  • Troubleshoot Wi-Fi, VPN and basic network connectivity issues
  • Own support tickets through to resolution and keep users informed along the way
  • Work with specialist IT teams and external providers to resolve more complex issues
  • Maintain IT assets, equipment and stock
  • Develop user guides, knowledge articles and support documentation
  • Get involved in new site openings, relocations, testing and other IT projects
  • Identify recurring problems and help us continually improve the employee IT experience

What we’re looking for

Technical capability matters, but so does how you work with people.

You’ll be someone who is curious, practical and enjoys figuring things out. You communicate clearly, take ownership and don’t consider a ticket resolved until the person at the other end is back up and running.

Ideally, you’ll bring:

  • Experience in an IT Service Desk, Help Desk or end-user support role
  • Working knowledge of Windows and Microsoft 365
  • Basic knowledge of Active Directory and Microsoft Entra ID
  • Confidence setting up and troubleshooting computers, mobile devices, printers and peripherals
  • An understanding of Wi-Fi, VPN and basic network troubleshooting
  • Experience with an IT ticketing or service management system
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills
  • Great communication skills and a genuine customer-service mindset
  • The ability to prioritise and stay organised in a busy environment
  • A collaborative attitude and, importantly, a willingness to keep learning
  • A full driver’s licence and ability to occasionally travel to AMA Group sites

Exposure to Microsoft Intune, ITIL practices or business applications, along with relevant IT qualifications or certifications, is advantageous – but not essential.

Why join AMA Group?

  • Scale and exposure - You’ll support technology across one of Australia and New Zealand’s largest automotive networks.
  • Variety - With 140+ locations and thousands of employees, you won’t be solving the same problem every day.
  • Career development - We’re a large Group with diverse businesses, teams and career opportunities. We want our people to develop and progress.
  • Get involved - This isn’t just about closing tickets. You’ll have opportunities to contribute to projects, new site openings, technology rollouts and improvements across our network.
  • Make an impact - When our technology works, our people can do their jobs, and our sites can keep our customers moving.

Ready to go further?

If you’re looking for an IT role where you can build your technical capability, work with great people and gain exposure to a large and diverse business, we’d love to hear from you.

Apply now and start your next chapter with AMA Group.

APPLICATIONS CLOSE - FRIDAY 11 SEPTEMBER 2026

title: Senior QA Automation Engineer
description:
Senior QA Automation Engineer - FinTech Trading Platform - London / Hybrid

(Tech stack: C#, .NET Core, .NET 8/9/10, AI-Assisted Testing, Test Automation, Reqnroll, SpecFlow, NUnit, Azure DevOps, SQL Server, ASP.NET Core, REST APIs, CI/CD, BDD, Automation Frameworks, Investment Management, Wealth Management)

Our client is a market-leading FinTech organisation developing an award-winning front-to-back investment and wealth management platform used by financial institutions across the UK and Europe. As part of a major investment in engineering excellence and AI-driven software delivery, they are seeking an experienced Senior Automation Engineer to define the future of quality engineering across a highly scalable, cloud-based platform that processes mission-critical financial transactions every day.

This is a rare opportunity to combine deep technical expertise with genuine technical leadership. As the technical owner of the automation framework, you will design and evolve the automation architecture, build scalable testing solutions in C# and .NET 10, and drive the adoption of AI-assisted testing practices across the engineering function. Working closely with Software Engineers, Architects, DevOps and Product teams, you will embed automation throughout the software development lifecycle, ensuring rapid, reliable feedback through modern CI/CD pipelines whilst continuously improving release quality and engineering efficiency.

You will lead the development of sophisticated automation frameworks using Reqnroll (or SpecFlow), NUnit, Azure DevOps Release Pipelines and SQL Server, delivering comprehensive regression, smoke and API test coverage across a modern microservices estate built on ASP.NET Core. Alongside mentoring Automation Engineers and establishing engineering best practices, you will evaluate emerging AI technologies, prototype innovative automation approaches and champion an automation-first culture that supports faster, higher-quality software delivery.

Experience with BDD, REST APIs, distributed systems and shift-left testing will be highly beneficial.

Successful Senior QA Automation Engineer candidates will have proven experience building enterprise-scale automation frameworks, excellent C#/.NET development skills and a passion for using AI to transform software testing. Experience within FinTech, investment management, wealth management or other regulated financial services environments would be advantageous, although candidates with strong technical leadership experience from other enterprise software businesses are equally encouraged to apply. This is an opportunity to influence engineering strategy, mentor talented teams and work with some of the latest automation and AI technologies available.

title: Senior Business Analyst
description:
At M&G, our purpose is to give everyone real confidence to put their money to work. With a heritage dating back more than 175 years, we have a long history of innovation in savings and investments, combining asset management and insurance expertise to offer a wide range of solutions.

Our two distinct operating segments, Asset Management and Life, work together to provide access to balanced, long-term investment and savings solutions.

Through telling it like it is, owning it now and moving it forward together with care and integrity; we are creating an exceptional place to work for exceptional talent.

We will consider flexible working arrangements for any of our roles and offer workplace adjustments to ensure you have the support you need to succeed in your role.

Senior Business Analyst

The Senior Business Analyst leads complex analysis across programmes and portfolios, turning business needs into clear requirements and value-driven technology solutions.

Sitting within Life Technology, the role works with Product Owners, Service Design, Change Business Analysts, Engineering, QA and DevOps. This role also involves providing guidance to Business Analysts working within the feature teams.

This is an opportunity to influence important business and technology initiatives while helping shape the Business Analysis capability. The role contributes to BA strategy, standards, capability development and continuous improvement.

Key Responsibilities

As a Senior Business Analyst, you will lead analysis activities across the full delivery lifecycle, translating business needs into clear, actionable requirements and solution designs that can be implemented effectively within complex technology environments. Working closely with Technology, Architecture, Product, Engineering, QA and Change teams, you will shape and validate solutions that balance business value, technical feasibility, quality and risk.

You will drive the definition of functional, non-functional and integration requirements, ensuring they are understood and deliverable within complex technology environments. The role requires strong stakeholder management, the ability to navigate ambiguity, and confidence in challenging assumptions to achieve the right outcomes.

In addition, you will support the growth of the Business Analysis capability by promoting consistent ways of working, coaching and mentoring analysts, and contributing to BA standards, knowledge sharing and continuous improvement initiatives.

Key Knowledge, Skills and Experience

Essential

  • Strong business analysis experience within complex technology, change or digital delivery environments.
  • Ability to independently lead analysis and take ownership of outcomes.
  • A proactive, self-driven approach with the ability to manage competing priorities.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving and facilitation skills.
  • Experience analysing complex systems, integrations and data flows.

  • Operate, calibrate, clean, and maintain laboratory equipment and ensure that it meets all quality control standards.

  • Accurately document testing results in log books, spreadsheets, and laboratory management software.

  • Support the implementation of GMPs, GLPs, HACCP/FSP, and other regulatory requirements related to quality and food safety.

  • Assist with root cause analysis for non-conformances and participate in the corrective and preventive actions process.

  • Conduct daily pre-operational evaluations of processing areas and equipment, ensuring compliance with Good Laboratory Practices (GLP).

  • Work closely with the production team to resolve quality issues and ensure product consistency.

  • Participate in internal audits and ensure non-conformance solutions are executed.

  • Troubleshoot issues with laboratory equipment and work with supervisors to address operational concerns.

  • Safety Protocol

  • Stop any observed unsafe acts and obey facility safety rules and procedures.

  • Equivalent combination of education and/or experience may be considered.

  • Experience with both metric and standard systems of measurement required.

Client Service Coordinator

Entry Level or Experienced

SUMMARY OF JOB PURPOSE AND FUNCTION

The Client Service Coordinator ("CSC") drives the flow of clients and pets through the hospital, maximizes the productivity of the veterinary medical team (in terms of numbers of clients and pets), ensures good communication with associates and clients, and coordinates the care of clients and pets in a happy, welcoming, friendly and efficient manner, influencing clients to return and refer their friends and families.

ESSENTIAL RESPONSIBILITIES AND TASKS

  • Provide professional, efficient and exceptional service at all times. This includes encouraging hospital visits, welcoming clients and pets, ensuring that they are comfortable in the hospital, and educating them about their pet's health.

  • Other job duties as assigned.

THE FIVE PRINCIPLES

  • Quality – The consumer is our boss, quality is our work and value for money is our goal.
  • Responsibility – As individuals, we demand total responsibility from ourselves; as associates, we support the responsibility of others.
  • Mutuality – A mutual benefit is a shared benefit; a shared benefit will endure.
  • Efficiency – We use resources to the full, waste nothing and do only what we can do best.
  • Freedom – We need freedom to shape our future; we need profit to remain free.

Leadership

  • Action Oriented
  • Listening

Functional

  • Preventative care and OWPs

CAPABILITIES AND EXPERIENCE (CAN DO)

  • Ability to multi-task- Manages multiple tasks at one time; quickly and accurately shifts attention among multiple tasks under distracting conditions without loss of accuracy or appearance of frustration.
  • Communication skills - Reads, writes and speaks fluent English, using appropriate grammar, style and vocabulary. Correctly spells commonly used English words and job specific terms. Demonstrates exceptionally strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Organizational ability – Demonstrates a systematic approach in carrying out assignments. Is very orderly and excels at cutting through confusion and turning chaos into order.
  • Problem solving skills - Demonstrates a strong ability to identify, analyze and solve problems. Translates problems into practical solutions.
  • Client service skills - Consistently ensures the team provides the client with attentive, courteous and informative service. Gains and shows personal satisfaction from delivering great service.
  • Intellectual ability - Accurately and consistently follows instructions delivered in an oral, written or diagram format. Can provide directions.
  • Mathematical ability - Ability to add, subtract, multiply and divide, and to compute rate, ratio and percent; ability to convert units of measurement.
  • Computer skills - Comfortably and confidently uses a computer and specialized software. Microsoft Word, Excel, Access, Outlook, etc.

ATTITUDES (WILL DO)

  • Initiative – shows willingness and aptitude to use own discretion in taking appropriate steps in finding solutions to problems; presents options and ideas to enhance current processes or procedures. Takes on additional responsibility when both big and small tasks need to be done.
  • Integrity – Firmly adheres to the values and ethics of Banfield Pet Hospitals. Exhibits honesty, discretion, and sound judgment.
  • Cooperativeness – Willing to work with others, collaborating and compromising where necessary; promptly share relevant information with others.
  • Flexibility – Is open to changing situations and opportunities and is willing to perform all tasks assigned.
  • Independence – Able and willing to perform tasks and duties without supervision.
  • Tolerance for Stress / Resiliency – Maintains a positive “can do” outlook, rebounds quickly from frustrations and unpleasantness, and maintains composure and friendly demeanor while dealing with stressful situations.

SPECIAL WORKING CONDITIONS

  • Ability to work at a computer for long periods of time.
  • Ability to be confident around pets (i.e., dogs, cats, birds, reptiles, etc.)
  • Client needs and work volume may often require more than 40 hours per week to complete essential duties of this job. This position requires special hours including working weekends and evenings.
  • Must have mental processes for reasoning, remembering, mathematics and language ability (reading, writing, and speaking the English language) to perform the duties proficiently.
  • The noise level in the work environment is moderately high.
  • Requires sufficient ambulatory skills in order to perform duties while at hospital.
  • Ability to stand, walk, stoop, kneel, crouch, and climb as well as manipulate (lift, carry, move) up to 50 pounds.
  • Requires good hand-eye coordination, arm-hand-finger dexterity with the ability to grasp, and visual acuity to use a keyboard and operate equipment.
  • Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus.
  • Associate is routinely exposed to a variety of pets that may bite or scratch, and on occasion, exposed to anesthesia, radiation, biological hazards and medication/controlled substances.

EXPERIENCE, EDUCATION AND/OR TRAINING

  • High School Diploma or equivalent preferred.
  • Must be at least 18 years old to perform duties involving radiography (x-ray) and exposure to radioactive substances.
  • One year related experience required with customer service preferred.

The Lead Operator is the technical subject-matter expert for their assigned equipment, process, and production area. This role maintains hands-on ownership at the line level and serves as the first point of contact for real-time troubleshooting, process decisions, equipment issues, quality concerns, and operational support for production associates. The Lead Operator partners closely with the Shift Supervisor to achieve safety, quality, delivery, and productivity objectives while leading by example on the production floor.

Week 2: Wednesday, Thursday, Friday

  • Conduct start-of-shift huddles and shift handoff communications within the assigned area.

  • Provide real-time troubleshooting and technical guidance to operators.

  • Conduct on-the-job training and maintain required training sign-off documentation.

  • Partner with the Shift Supervisor to identify operational risks and escalate issues promptly.

  • Provide hands-on leadership to stabilize quality, throughput, and equipment performance.

  • Make and communicate line-level operational recommendations including start/stop decisions in alignment with the Shift Supervisor.

  • Ensure adherence to work instructions, procedures, and quality requirements.

  • Review and maintain production records and documentation accuracy.

  • Identify, contain, and escalate quality concerns.

  • Support investigations and corrective actions.

  • Champion and exemplify safe work practices.

  • Address unsafe conditions immediately and escalate significant concerns.

  • Maintain workplace organization and housekeeping standards.

  • Track and communicate operational metrics.

  • Support inventory and production transactions.

Qualifications and Skills

Required

  • Minimum 2-3 years of manufacturing or production experience.

  • Minimum 1 year of experience operating equipment or processes within the assigned production area.

  • Demonstrated proficiency in established work instructions, procedures, quality requirements, and production documentation.

  • Ability to communicate effectively.

  • Demonstrated ability to train others and provide technical guidance.

Preferred

  • Experience performing equipment setup, changeovers, troubleshooting, and process adjustments.

  • Experience in a regulated manufacturing environment.

  • Experience leading projects, training initiatives, or continuous improvement activities.

  • Molding-specific process knowledge for molding area.

Competencies/Physical Demands

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

title: Team Leader - Retail (Garden City #25)
description:
ORGANIZATION:

For more than 60 years, Goodwill Industries of Kansas has been a trusted resource and advocate for people with disabilities and barriers to employment. At Goodwill Industries of Kansas, our mission is to transform lives and communities through the power of education, training and employment. Our vision is to be the leading resource for individuals seeking their fullest potential. We are looking for a Team Leader to play a key role in furthering our vision and mission in our retail area.


VALUES:

  • Sustainability: We commit to practices that support environmental, social and economic strength.
  • Ethics: We uphold high standards of honesty, integrity and fairness in all business dealings.
  • Respect: We treat ever individual with dignity, care and sincerity to build an equitable environment.
  • Voice: We listen to each other, value feedback and advocate for our communities.
  • Inspiration: We motivate, encourage and energize individuals to be their best through leadership and vision.
  • Community Engagement: We recognize the strength of collaboration and engage deeply with our stakeholders to transform lives together.
  • Excellence: We embrace innovation and strive for outstanding quality to deliver a positive impact to those we serve.


MISSION STATEMENT: We transform lives and communities through the power of education, training and employment.


PURPOSE OF POSITION: To open and close store. Manage and operate a Goodwill Retail store while fulfilling Goodwill's mission statement.


SUPERVISION RECEIVED: District Manager, Store Manager & Asst. Store Manager


SUPERVISION EXERCISED: Supervises workers in various personnel groups engaged in operating a retail store.


QUALIFICATIONS/EDUCATION:

  • High school diploma or the equivalent required.
  • Must have full knowledge of bookkeeping and accounting to maintain sales records and reports incidental to store operations. Must be a person with excellent character references and a well-developed sense of responsibility.
  • One year of management experience, required.
  • A valid driver’s license and insurability is required.


ORGANIZATIONAL RESPONSIBILITIES: Work with individuals who have disabilities and or barriers to employment and participate in the achievement of their goals. Demonstrate a positive, role model. Display commitment and involvement towards Goodwill's mission.


JOB PROFICIENCIES: Math Skills, Computer Skills, Oral Communications, Written Communications, Internal-Personal Communications Judgment and Problem Solving, Cash Handling, Job Knowledge, Planning and Organization, Leadership, Teamwork, Customer Service Orientation, Interviewing Skills, Quality, Product Knowledge, Ethics and Trust, Safety and Security.


JOB COMPETENCIES: Serves as hiring manager in the Manager and/or Assistant Manager’s absence and will complete employee work schedules, evaluations and ADP as needed. Will handle customer complaints. Oversees store operation including inventory, warehouse and stock rotation per manager. Per manager, performs all administrative and clerical details associated with store operation and orders supplies as needed. Provides supervision for all sales associates, trains employees and follows cash handling procedures on a daily basis.

As a member of the management staff, sets an example for his or her workers. Personal conduct must reflect the high standards of integrity expected of all Goodwill staff personnel. Is expected to exercise good judgement in handling the wide variety of day-to-day operational problems which arise continuously in store operation. Must be thoroughly familiar and continually stress the Goodwill sales philosophy. Performs those duties which are part of every day supervisory job.


ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

  • Must complete employees’ work schedules. They must complete employee evaluations as needed. They also counsel, hire, fire, and train employees, only when manager and assistant manager are not available.
  • Supervises the sales force and Sales Floor. Sells merchandise as time permits. Attends to and satisfies customer’s needs. Handles customer complaints in a fair and impartial manner, coordinating as necessary. Promotes special events.
  • Receives and checks incoming stock and supervises checkouts and stock transfers. Checks condition and placement of stock in a clean, neat, and orderly condition. Suggests and maintains displays and advertising ideas and prepares and places signs in sales areas and Windows's solely responsible for wares dept. being clean, stocked and rotated on a daily basis. Must make sure merchandise is being marked to Goodwill Standards from the processing warehouse area.
  • Trains and supervises store personnel and maintains projected sales goals.
  • Represents Goodwill in the area served, striving to enhance the Goodwill image through individual and group participation. May supervise solicitors and pick-up orders, including routing as authorized.
  • Maintain records of store operations as required. Reviews and analyzes sales to determine effectiveness of methods used and adequacy of prices. Make recommendations to Area Manager and Vice President of Operations/Sales.


DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Assures that the appearance of the store and premises is presentable at all times.
  • Performs administrative and clerical details of store operation, such as; preparing stock requests, ordering forms, bags and other supplies, receiving, and disposing of mail, handling cash as directed by current procedures, etc.
  • Responsible for safety and well-being for all employees.
  • Safeguards the premises and material under his or her care at all times. Seeks to reduce the possibility of pilferage or burglary. Constantly watches for fire hazards and unsafe conditions.
  • Greets customers.
  • Adhere to all ethical standards confidentiality of records.
  • Adhere to all safety policies and reports violations.
  • Support mission statement and activities of other departments.
  • Support the accessibility of our services and facilities free of architectural, attitudinal, environmental, financial, communication, transportation, employment and other barriers to person with disabilities and barriers to employment.
  • Must be able to work Saturdays and Sundays and at least two nights a week.
  • Must be able to count all monies for store operations.
  • Must be able to lift up to 50 lbs.
  • Must be able to make bank deposits with own transportation daily.
  • When working with monies, safe and monies must be locked up at all times.
  • Driving to the bank to ensure secure delivery of bank deposits.
  • Other duties as assigned.


STANDARDS FOR MEASURING PERFORMANCE/QUALITY STANDARDS:

  • Attendance and punctuality.
  • Quality and quantity of work performed.
  • Attitude and overall effectiveness of working relations with all stakeholders.
  • The manner in which duties and responsibilities, essential functions and job competencies are performed.
  • Supports and values diversity.
  • The manner in which the above listed duties are performed.
  • The ability to handle store in absence of manager’s or person in charge to preparing daily deposit, maintaining employee purchase forms.


RELATIONS WITH STORE PERSONNEL: Follows program plan in work assignments. Trains them in overall store operation. Represents management to them. Advises and counsels them as required. Is fair and impartial in his/her relations with them.


RELATIONS WITH STORE COSTUMERS: Is uniformly courteous to them. Listens to any complaints and attempts to adjust within policy to the satisfaction of the customer when merchandise is defective. Uses good judgement and does not hesitate to take responsibility. Stresses courtesy and enthusiasm to the public by all store workers.


RELATIONS WITH STORE MANAGER AND AREA MANAGER: Keeps him/her informed of significant events. Recommends changes in policies and procedures based on store operations. Is particularly sensitive to management requests and adheres to deadlines and due dates.


NOTE: Must have a telephone and maintain it in operating order within telephone company's maintenance capabilities. Must be a licensed driver-must be insurable. Must pass/complete background check.


PHYSICAL STRENGTH:

  • Lift -- push/pull while standing - up to 50 pounds on a daily basis. Rarely over 100 pounds.
  • Carry -- push/pull while moving - up to 50 pounds on a daily basis. Rarely up to 100 pounds.

  • Paid Holidays

title: IT Database & Data Migration Analyst
description:
We’re looking for an experienced IT Database & Data Migration Analyst to join our team and play a key role in the administration, optimisation and governance of our database environments, as well as supporting the implementation of IFS Cloud.

This is a key technical role, with responsibility for leading the data migration workstream of the IFS Cloud programme. You’ll ensure data is accurately extracted, cleansed, transformed, validated and successfully migrated from legacy systems into IFS Cloud, while maintaining high standards of data quality, security and integrity.

What you’ll be doing
  • Administer and maintain Oracle and Microsoft SQL Server databases.
  • Monitor and optimise database performance, security, availability and capacity.
  • Manage backups, restores, upgrades, patching and disaster recovery.
  • Lead the IFS Cloud data migration, including planning, extraction, cleansing, transformation, validation and reconciliation.
  • Coordinate migration activities with stakeholders, suppliers and implementation partners.
  • Identify and resolve data quality issues and support data governance.
  • Develop complex SQL queries, database views and support Power BI reporting.
  • Provide database expertise throughout the IFS Cloud implementation, including testing, cutover and go-live.
  • Maintain technical documentation and operational procedures.
What we’re looking for

You’ll have strong experience across both Oracle Database and Microsoft SQL Server, alongside a proven background in data migration and ERP implementations.

You’ll also have:

  • Advanced SQL development and troubleshooting skills.
  • Experience delivering data migration projects involving large and complex datasets.
  • Experience designing and carrying out data reconciliation and validation activities.
  • A good understanding of database security, data governance and data quality principles.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with technical teams, business stakeholders and external implementation partners.

This is an excellent opportunity for a technically experienced database professional to take ownership of a key data workstream and play a significant role in the successful delivery of our IFS Cloud programme.

title: Associate Experience & DEI Leader
description:
At Securian Financial, we believe our associates make the difference. We are committed to creating an experience where people feel empowered and supported to make a difference, thrive and succeed as part of the team.

We are looking for a strategic and collaborative leader to build and mature Associate Experience as an enterprise capability at Securian Financial. As a member of the Human Resources Leadership Team, this leader will shape the strategy, structure, measurement and practices that help us understand how associates experience Securian—and turn those insights into meaningful action and continuous improvement.

This is an opportunity to influence the associate experience and DEI at an enterprise level. You will work across HR and the business to understand the moments that matter throughout the associate journey, measure and monitor the experience, and use data to tell a compelling story that drives action. Diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging are integral to this work, providing an important lens for understanding differences in associate experiences and outcomes and ensuring our Associate Value Proposition is reflected in the everyday experiences of our associates.

What You Will Do

Shape the Associate Experience

  • Build and continuously evolve Securian’s enterprise Associate Experience capability, including the strategy, structure, roadmap and practices needed to measure, monitor and continuously improve the experience.
  • Develop a holistic view of the associate journey—from attraction and onboarding through development, advancement, transitions and departure—to identify opportunities to strengthen the experience.
  • Apply human-centered design, journey mapping and other experience-design approaches to understand associate needs and improve moments that matter.
  • Help steward Securian’s Associate Value Proposition by understanding and measuring how it comes to life throughout the associate experience.

Turn Listening and Insights into Action

  • Lead Securian’s associate listening and measurement strategy, bringing together enterprise surveys, pulse listening, lifecycle feedback, qualitative research, workforce data and external benchmarks.
  • Use workforce and experience data to identify patterns, differences and opportunities across associate populations, translating complex insights into compelling stories and recommendations that influence leaders and drive action.
  • Establish meaningful measures and feedback loops to understand progress, identify opportunities and help associates see how their feedback leads to action.
  • Partner with Strategic Insights, HR and business leaders to connect associate sentiment and experience to broader organizational priorities and outcomes.

Embed Equity, Inclusion and Belonging

  • Integrate diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging as a core lens throughout Securian’s Associate Experience strategy and culture.
  • Partner across HR to ensure DEI considerations are incorporated into talent practices, programs and decisions and to identify gaps, potential bias and differences in associate outcomes and experiences.
  • Use data and associate insights to understand whether associates are experiencing equitable outcomes and recommend focused actions where opportunities exist.
  • Build on Securian’s established DEI foundation by partnering with executive sponsors, the DEI Council and Associate Resource Groups to support governance, strengthen connection and advance enterprise priorities.
  • Keep Securian’s approach informed by evolving workforce trends, research and leading practices.

Lead Through Partnership and Influence

  • Serve as an active member of the Human Resources Leadership Team, bringing an Associate Experience and DEI perspective to HR strategy, talent practices and enterprise priorities.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to senior leaders on Associate Experience, culture, inclusion and belonging, using insights and data to influence decisions and action.
  • Bring associate needs, diverse perspectives and experience implications into enterprise initiatives and decisions.
  • Partner across HR, Technology, Facilities, Communications, Customer Experience, Strategic Insights and business teams to turn insights into coordinated action.
  • Explore connections between Associate Experience, Customer Experience and business outcomes.
  • Influence across organizational boundaries and integrate Associate Experience and DEI considerations into the work of other HR capabilities and enterprise partners through relationships, evidence, thoughtful recommendations and strong business judgment.

Lead the Function

  • Lead, develop and inspire the DEI and Associate Experience team, establishing clear priorities and measures of success.
  • Oversee applicable affirmative action, equal employment opportunity and regulatory responsibilities in partnership with Legal, Compliance and other internal stakeholders.
  • Represent Securian externally, as appropriate, and maintain connections to evolving Associate Experience, culture, DEI and inclusion practices.

What Will Help You Succeed

We are looking for a leader who combines Associate Experience expertise, strategic thinking and a strong data orientation with the ability to turn insights into action. You are comfortable navigating complexity, influencing across organizational boundaries and using data and storytelling to help leaders understand what the associate experience means for talent, culture and the business.

Qualifications include:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in human resources, organizational psychology, business, sociology, behavioral science, analytics or a related field.
  • 10+ years of progressively responsible experience in Employee/Associate Experience, diversity and inclusion, organizational effectiveness, culture, talent, people analytics or related disciplines, including people leadership experience.
  • Demonstrated success building or evolving an Employee/Associate Experience capability, strategy or listening and measurement practice within a complex organization.
  • Strong capability in employee research, listening strategy, qualitative methods, workforce analytics and experience measurement.
  • Demonstrated ability to use data, associate feedback and external research to uncover insights, tell a compelling story and influence executive-level decisions and organizational action.
  • Experience with human-centered design, design thinking, employee journey mapping, service design or related approaches.
  • Strong ability to influence and drive action across HR, business and enterprise functions without relying on formal authority.
  • Strong communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to make complex insights clear and actionable.
  • Sound judgment and the ability to navigate complex or sensitive topics with courage, empathy, curiosity and business acumen.

The Impact You Can Make

This role sits at the intersection of people, culture, insight and business strategy. You will have the opportunity to help shape how associates experience Securian, elevate associate voice in enterprise decisions, strengthen inclusion and belonging, and build the practices that help Securian continue evolving as a place where people can thrive and do their best work.

This position will have a hybrid working arrangement, working in-office for a minimum of 3 days a week. Securian Financial believes in hybrid work as an integral part of our culture. Associates get the benefit of working both virtually and in our offices. Our policy allows flexibility for the reality of business and personal schedules.

title: Solution Engineer — Integrations Focus
description:
Brickanta is only as strong as the data it can reach. Our customers run their projects across Autodesk, Dalux, Bidcon, SharePoint, Dropbox, ERPs, and a long tail of customised APIs they built themselves. Your job is to make Brickanta the agentic layer on top of all of it — and to make sure every enterprise customer actually gets there.

Think of it as a forward deployed engineer sitting inside Customer Success. You'll write code, read API docs, map data models and debug auth flows. You'll also run workshops, present to IT security, and sit with a projektchef to understand how a change order really moves. Half engineer, half deployment lead, fully accountable for the outcome.

We don't optimize for credentials. We optimize for builders who ship — and this role ships with a customer in the room.

What you'll build

  • Connectors to the systems our customers live in: Autodesk Construction Cloud and BIM 360, Dalux, Bidcon, SharePoint, Dropbox and more
  • The harder integrations too — customer-specific APIs, homegrown project databases, document archives nobody has touched since 2014
  • The technical architecture of enterprise rollouts: discovery, solution design, IT security reviews, SSO, permissions, data residency
  • Playbooks, documentation and reference setups that turn one-off integrations into repeatable product, so the next ten customers onboard without you
  • Adoption in real workflows — tender review, risk analysis, change orders, procurement — measured in usage, not in go-live dates
  • Prototypes directly in Brickanta when that's the fastest way to prove a case to product and engineering

How we evaluate

  • Show us what you've built — integrations you've shipped, customers you've taken from contract to daily use, systems you've untangled
  • Strong systems sense: you break a messy customer landscape into data flows, owners and interfaces, and you know where the risk sits
  • You're strong in the room — a technical session with IT in the morning, a workshop with a site team in the afternoon, in Swedish and English
  • You move fast and you care about craft

Who this is for

Solutions engineers, implementation engineers, and technical people from inside the built environment who can build. You need to have onboarded real customers onto a real product, and you need to build and debug integrations yourself in Python or TypeScript — but you don't need to be a full stack engineer, and we care more about what you've shipped than about years. Bonus if you know how a Swedish entreprenad runs.

To keep coordination clean: this role doesn't own account management or renewals, doesn't carry a sales quota, and doesn't replace the core engineering team. You build on the platform and at its edges.

Keen on doing your life's work — bringing one of the world's largest and most impactful industries, the $15 trillion construction industry, into the AI era? Send us an email at careers (a) or apply directly at .

About Brickanta

Brickanta () is the AI-native agentic platform for construction bid analysis, cost estimation and procurement. Brickanta's industry know-how AI raises margins and saves time by leveraging historical estimates, tender documents, and project data — so builders can focus on building. The founding team has been building with AI since 2018 and brings deep experience applying AI in construction and industrial sectors. Brickanta has raised over $8M in external funding from leading investors, including Northzone, Anton Osika and Mario Götze.

• Collaborates with the campus section chairpersons, campus Medical Chief of Staff, and contracted physicians to ensure that appropriate structure, policies and procedures are operational for accreditation and performance excellence
• Provides executive oversight for Associate CMO, medical director and medical staff services.
• Develops, monitors, and evaluates performance/process improvement, disease management, utilization review activities, and standards to improve quality outcomes both clinically and administratively ensuring the highest standards in treatment and care of patients. Advocates the use of evidence-based medicine.
• Establishes and implements standards and policies to ensure quality medical care while driving clinical outcomes for the campus. Works collaboratively with senior management, patient care leaders, and managers as well as staff to accomplish goals.
• Serves as a member of the campus senior management team and assists in strategic development of initiatives and programs.
• Consults and advises members of the medical staff on professionalism, quality and safety issues, and excessive or inappropriate utilization of resources.
• Consults and advises as needed on risk management reviews, and/or patient’s grievances when working in collaboration with the campus Risk Management team
• Collaborates with medical staff leaders including department medical directors and elected medical staff leaders on hospital and patient safety issues. Assists in the moderation of major physician-to-physician, physician-to-staff, and physician-to-patient interactions in partnership with the campus Medical Chief of Staff and other medical staff leaders.
• Ensures medical staff development plans and programs are implemented and aligned with those of the hospital. Promotes shared goals and teamwork in interactions with medical staff, clinical staff, and administration. Supports the clinical team and promotes individual growth among medical staff and clinical leaders.
• Participates in the annual operating and capital budget process by providing input.
• Responsible for physician engagement strategies including supporting community physicians in physician recruitment and promoting programs which enhance physician satisfaction. Actively engaged in efforts to recruit medical staff members who will support the mission, vision, values, and purpose of AdventHealth.
• Provides support to and champions the organization’s infection prevention program. Acts as intermediary between the campus infection prevention coordinator and individual physicians and/or physician groups to resolve problems related to infection control practice issues.
• Supports quality and safety initiatives of AdventHealth through education, standardization and implementation of system strategies.
• Facilitates data driven activities that lower the cost of care including evaluation of use of supplies, devices, medications, and other physician preference items.
• Serve as the medical liaison between the campus and the organization’s population health department with emphasis on operationalizing strategies that improve patient care across the continuum and outside the acute care setting.
• Provides medical support and content expertise to partnerships with external stakeholders (private companies, local government) that are designed with the intent of improving the health of the community.
• Provides support to internal and external communications teams and participate as needed on engagements with the media with the goal of educating the community on medical and public health topics that improve the health of the community
• Provides oversight for the medical service lines including strategic planning, accurate documentation, and multidisciplinary needs.
• Regularly attends all relevant campus medical staff meetings, administrative team meetings, and other meetings where appropriate.
• From a physician’s perspective, affirmatively provides counsel to senior management team discussions and action plans related to service changes, improvements, new service/program offerings inclusive of all operational and strategy decisions.
• Takes a lead role on campus sentinel event teams. During an emergency, disaster, or catastrophic event, CMO may be assigned to any disaster service activity that promotes the protection of public health and safety.
• Maintains current knowledge of accreditation bodies, State of Florida, AdventHealth, and any other relevant, regulatory, or reporting organizations standards on quality indicators and certification processes. Ensures compliance with all relevant licensing and accrediting bodies. Provides leadership and vision in the development of clinical guidelines and care pathways.
• Participates and leads campus Catalyst initiatives.
• Provides strategic oversight and guidance for the facility’s patient and workforce safety, ensuring clear goals, effective governance structures, and leadership accountability.
• Foster and sustain a facility-wide culture of safety that emphasizes psychological safety, continuous learning from harm and near-miss events, and meaningful engagement of patients, families, and the workforce.

Field Director

Summary and Qualifications:

Hire, coach and develop Practice Managers.

Partner with Director of Veterinary Quality (DVQ) and Area Chiefs of Staff to operate an effective and productive hospital team, ensure a safe and engaging hospital environment, and improve both the medical quality and business performance of the hospital.

Essential Responsibilities and Tasks:

This includes developing the skills and abilities of their paraprofessionals by providing clear communication on expectations and performance.

  • Ensure compliance with all practice protocols, policies, and procedures and with all local, state and federal laws, ensuring the safety of pets, clients and associates and the maintenance of clean, safe and organized hospitals (i.e., OSHA, Hazard Waste, business permits and assets protection audits). Enforce all Banfield standards, continuously building brand in connection with all medical and non-medical standards.

  • Responsible for overall hospital leadership and paraprofessional retention within market.

  • Develop a performance development plan (PDP) and conduct a formal review of each Practice Manager (PM) in market at least once a year; in lieu of a PM in the hospital, develop a PDP and conduct a formal review for each paraprofessional in that hospital.

  • Ensure effective execution of OGSM performance including financial results for all area hospitals, partnering with the DVQ to deliver on the quality and compliance KPIs and the quality OGSM.

  • Own the recruitment, hiring, coaching, supervision and mentorship of PMs, Veterinary Technicians, and paraprofessionals in assigned market.

TRUE CAREER GROWTH: The entire “ETS Family” will be there to assist and support the Performance Specialist to enhance and maximize the development of our athletes at the highest possible level. This opportunity includes a very competitive industry level salary along with personal development growth and promotions plan that can’t be matched.

THE METHOD: The ETS training philosophy is to provide every athlete (regardless of age and sport) the opportunity to significantly improve their relative strength, power, linear and lateral speed, ability to bio-mechanically master the art of deceleration while also significantly improving their overall athleticism and becoming less prone to injury.
Our systematic and step by step approach to developing better athletes will dramatically improve performance on the field, court, track, pool or ice. Each athlete will take part in a progressive ability-appropriate plan of strength, speed, agility and deceleration training that will not only allow them to maximize their skills and athleticism for their sport, but also improve their overall athleticism. It’s crucial for every athlete to develop the basic-fundamental athletic and bio-mechanical movements, strength techniques and deceleration protocols through a customized plan in order to truly maximize their potential.

We believe the missing link in most programs is the lack of consistent and professional emphasis and attention to detail on the basics of an athlete’s complete athletic development separated from their sport-specific skill work. Our vision is that every athlete will experience an unmatched next level training atmosphere that is equally focused on character development, accountability and competition as it is the next level performance results that every athlete will gain.

SERIOUS GAINS AND GOALS: Our goal is for every athlete to leave each session understanding the physical objective for that session, but also understand the importance of consistency, dedication and commitment to ensure they are maximizing their results.

We are seeking motivated Strength and Performance Specialists that are searching for a unique opportunity to work and flourish in the private sector of the Sports Performance industry.

COMMITMENT REQUIRED

  • Work week consists of a minimum of 40-60 hours a week
  • Available for off-site meetings – Should conduct a minimum of one offsite meeting per week with a coach or director of a team, school, or club/organization
  • Available via cell, email & social media for staff, athletes, parents, & potential leads
  • Committed to growing all of the ETS Performance Services (Speed Plus, Strength Plus, Elite Speed, Team Training, Adult Fit Program (off peak performance hours), etc.
  • Committed to following the ETS Marketing Plan and daily duties
  • Committed to monthly dialogue with parents to provide a training update/progress report for their athlete
  • Follow and adhere to all daily, weekly and monthly responsibilities via the ETS Directors Non-Negotiable Manual

PERFORMANCE EXPECTATIONS

  • Perform a minimum of 3-5 new athlete evaluations each week
  • Arrive 30 minutes early to work each day
  • Be present and command the training floor during all ETS training sessions
  • Follow-up with past inquiries and prospects
  • Provide a safe, clean and intense training atmosphere
  • Maintain a positive public image on social media platforms
  • Create and maintain a positive image both inside and outside the facility
  • Wear proper ETS attire for every session/shift
  • Interview and hire all new staff/interns each semester/quarter
  • Follow and adhere to ETS Directors Non-Negotiable Manual

Schedule: 8 hour shift

title: HOLISTIC THERAPIST
description:

Anantara Dhigu Maldives Resort



Anantara Hotels & Resorts is a global luxury hotel and resort brand rooted in Thai culture, with an intrinsic sense of authentic hospitality. Inspired by the Sanskrit word meaning ‘without end’, our spirit embodies freedom, movement, and harmony. We believe every journey should leave a lasting impression — for our guests and for our people.


Founded in 2001 in Thailand, we have since expanded across the world, welcoming guests in some of the world’s most captivating locales — from pristine beaches and private islands to ancient sites and vibrant metropolises. If you are driven by a passion for generosity, warmth and heartfelt hospitality, Anantara offers a career without limits.

Promote a true mind/body balance through your effective teaching style and utilize your persuasive sales ability to bring the art of health and wellness into the lives of others.

  9. Perform other related duties and responsibilities as
  10. Uses appropriate administrative, fiscal, physical, and technical safeguards to ensure the confidentiality, integrity, and security of CCEW client protected health information (PHI), per regulations outlined in the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act of 1996 (HIPAA).

  10. Excellent organizational skills, attention to detail and time management skills with a proven ability to meet project deadlines.

to perform this job successfully, an individual must have a bachelor’s degree in accounting, finance or an equivalent combination of education and experience. Three to five years as a Business Analyst working within multifamily housing or an adjacent industry is preferred but not required. Certification as a Housing Asset Manager (CHAM) or equivalent certification or ability to secure such certification within 6 months of employment.

Certificates/Licenses: MS Office certifications are preferred but not required

title: Associate, Project Finance
description:
Looking for a role where you can build your project finance career while providing critical support to live, high-value transactions? Join our Project Finance team in Copenhagen as an Associate.

European Energy is a growing company in the renewable energy sector. We are a privately owned Danish company founded in 2004, with our headquarters in Copenhagen. We develop, construct, finance, and operate solar (PV) and wind energy projects globally, as well as Power-to-X projects. In addition, we explore new technologies, including battery storage, biogas, and carbon capture. Our core values form the foundation of everything we do: In It Together, Trust and Courage, Ambition, Excitement, Inclusion, and Agility.

Your New Team

As a part of the CCO Area, the Project and Asset Finance team is responsible for sourcing all financing needed to construct EE's project pipeline. In this role, you will work directly with the Senior Associate and wider transaction team, as well as the more than 25 other members of the broader M&A and Project Finance department dedicated to commercialising EE's asset portfolio.

Your New Role

As an Associate, Project Finance you will provide hands-on support to the transaction team, working closely with the Senior Associate and wider deal team. You will become well-versed in the financial model and able to run scenarios and sensitivities, while supporting the team wherever needed. This is an excellent entry point into project finance, with direct exposure to live, high-value transactions from day one.

Your Responsibilities

  • Provide ad-hoc support to the transaction team as directed.

  • Become well-versed in the financial model and able to run scenarios and sensitivities.

  • Support the Senior Associate in maintaining the dataroom and coordinating lender/advisor Q&A.

  • Assist in preparing transaction information materials.

  • Support due diligence and documentation processes as needed.

Prerequisites to progress in the job

  • You have 0-2 years of relevant experience, for example from a graduate programme (with relevant coursework), internship, or junior analyst role in finance, infrastructure, or a related field.

  • You have strong quantitative and Excel skills, and an aptitude for financial modelling.

  • You have an interest in developing a career in project finance and renewable energy.

  • You are structured, thorough, and comfortable picking up new tasks quickly.

As a person, you are curious and eager to learn, with a structured approach to your work and an eye for detail. You are collaborative and communicate clearly, and you are motivated by the opportunity to build your project finance skills on live transactions from day one.

You may occasionally be asked to travel to meet with stakeholders across Europe.

With us you get

  • Close collaboration with senior colleagues and meaningful deal ownership from day one

  • A culture of knowledge sharing and international collaboration across 21+ countries

  • Flexible work policy and a diverse, inclusive work environment

  • Opportunities for career advancement in a growing company and sector

  • Six weeks of paid annual leave, a subsidised lunch scheme, employee discounts on glasses, furniture, and massage, free access to a gym, a mobile phone for both professional and personal use, and access to professional development opportunities, including on-the-job learning, internal and external training, and networking.

European Energy at a glance — The Power of Tomorrow, Today

We are now more than 970 employees with 51 nationalities represented in 21 countries, and we are growing rapidly in both Copenhagen and across our global offices. We all work for our common goal: to be a leading partner in the renewable energy transition and to create The Power of Tomorrow, Today.

Our working environment is built on mutual respect for the varied strengths and talents of our employees, with a flat hierarchy and a culture that encourages initiative and innovation. Our employees value our flexible working culture, which supports a better balance between work and personal life. We are a team, whether it is in the workplace, on our company trips, or during our weekly company training sessions. At European Energy, you will work with colleagues from around the world and become part of a collaborative international network.

We lead with purpose

At European Energy, our leadership culture is built on six guiding principles that shape how we collaborate, make decisions, and grow together. These principles help us act responsibly and empower each other to succeed.

Apply now

Workplace: Søborg, Denmark

Reference: Jeremy Bennett, Director, Global Head of Project and Asset Finance

How to apply: We value a diverse and inclusive workplace and encourage all qualified candidates to apply, regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, religion, or background. To support a fair and unbiased recruitment process, we kindly ask that you do not include a photograph in your CV. We assess all candidates based on their skills, experience, qualifications, and potential to succeed in the role. We review applications and conduct interviews on an ongoing basis and will close the position once a suitable candidate has been identified. We therefore encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

Please note that we do not accept applications via email or any other direct messaging channels. Applications must be submitted through the designated application link.

Background check: As a last step of the hiring process, a background check will be conducted on the final candidate. This is to safeguard our operations and ensure compliance with EU regulations for critical infrastructure. The check can include verification of identity, employment history, and criminal records.

Contact person: For more information about the position, please reach out to Jeremy Bennett, jben@europeanenergy.com

PRO ATHLETE STRENGTH & CONDITIONING DIRECTOR: TRAIN THE PROS AND UP AND COMING STARS. We are looking for athletes who know what it takes to perform at the highest level and have a passion to guide and motivate the next wave of athletes with the desire to achieve UNCOMMON results.

THE IDEAL MATCH TO LEAD OUR TEAM: The ideal candidate would have a strong interest in working with youth, high school, college and professional athletes in an electric atmosphere utilizing proven next level training and business systems that continue to set ETS apart from the competition.

PROFESSIONAL ATHLETE ATMOSPHERE AND DEVELOPMENT: In addition to being aligned with ETS Partner NFL All-Pro ADAM THIELEN, KIRK COUSINS, and CJ HAM among other notable current and past professional athletes, the candidate will immediately be surrounded by one of our elite ETS Sports Performance Facility Directors along with a host of other successful ETS Performance Specialists from across the country.

TRUE CAREER GROWTH: The entire “ETS Family” will be there to assist and support the Performance Specialist to enhance and maximize the development of our athletes at the highest possible level. This opportunity includes a very competitive industry level salary along with personal development growth and promotions plan that can’t be matched.

THE METHOD: The ETS training philosophy is to provide every athlete (regardless of age and sport) the opportunity to significantly improve their relative strength, power, linear and lateral speed, ability to bio-mechanically master the art of deceleration while also significantly improving their overall athleticism and becoming less prone to injury.
Our systematic and step by step approach to developing better athletes will dramatically improve performance on the field, court, track, pool or ice. Each athlete will take part in a progressive ability-appropriate plan of strength, speed, agility and deceleration training that will not only allow them to maximize their skills and athleticism for their sport, but also improve their overall athleticism. It’s crucial for every athlete to develop the basic-fundamental athletic and bio-mechanical movements, strength techniques and deceleration protocols through a customized plan in order to truly maximize their potential.

We believe the missing link in most programs is the lack of consistent and professional emphasis and attention to detail on the basics of an athlete’s complete athletic development separated from their sport-specific skill work. Our vision is that every athlete will experience an unmatched next level training atmosphere that is equally focused on character development, accountability and competition as it is the next level performance results that every athlete will gain.

SERIOUS GAINS AND GOALS: Our goal is for every athlete to leave each session understanding the physical objective for that session, but also understand the importance of consistency, dedication and commitment to ensure they are maximizing their results.

We are seeking motivated Strength and Performance Specialists that are searching for a unique opportunity to work and flourish in the private sector of the Sports Performance industry.

Skills

title: Solicitor
description:
Solicitor (Cancer Research Horizons)

Reports to: Senior Solicitor

Directorate: Research & Innovation

Contract: Permanent

Hours: Full time 35 hours per week (other flexible-working requests will also be considered if it meets business needs)

Salary: £79,000 - £84,000 pa plus benefits

Location Stratford, London Office-based with high flexibility (1-2 days per week in the office)

Closing date: Sunday 20th September 2026 at 23.59

If there are any changes or adjustments that would make it easier for you to apply, please contact recruitment@cancer.org.uk or 020 3469 8400 as soon as possible.

Recruitment process: Initial virtual interview, followed by onsite F2F interview for successful candidates.

Please note: You must be eligible to work in the UK to apply for this vacancy. Cancer Research UK cannot offer visa sponsorship.

At Cancer Research UK, we exist to beat cancer.

To support our mission, we are looking for a dedicated, committed and engaged Solicitor to provide effective legal support to Cancer Research Horizons (CRH).

As the world’s biggest medical research charity, we’ve helped bring fourteen new cancer drugs to market. However, there is still an urgent need to bring more effective treatments to patients faster.

Cancer Research Horizons (CRH) is CRUK’s internal translation engine. CRUK’s established drug discovery teams operate under one organisation and leadership team. Our unique combination of cancer biology expertise and access to CRUK’s world-class academic network, coupled with cutting edge technology platforms and clinical expertise enables us to 1) bring new treatments to patients faster and 2) tackle the biggest challenges in discovering cancer drugs by seeking out more radical ideas and embracing risk in our bid to achieve success.

What will I be doing?

  • Provide timely, proactive, pragmatic and commercially-focused legal advice and solutions across a broad range of business activities, involving IP, commercial, corporate and data protection law and from time to time extending into other areas of legal practice such as software, pharmaceutical regulatory, insolvency and litigation .

  • Develop a strong understanding of CRH and CRUK's operations, building effective relationships with internal stakeholders, external clients and partners.

  • Draft, review and negotiate a wide range of agreements relating to collaborative research, intellectual property protection, commercialisation and spin-out activities.

  • Advise on and support spin-out transactions, including the negotiation and execution of associated legal agreements.

  • Manage actual and potential disputes, including instructing and overseeing external legal advisers.

  • Promote robust contract management and compliance practices, ensuring adherence to contractual, corporate and legislative requirements.

  • Support the development of policies relating to translational research, intellectual assets and other strategic legal matters.

  • Contribute to cross-functional projects and deal teams, identifying, managing and reporting significant legal and business risks.

  • Develop legal know-how resources, template agreements and guidance materials, while monitoring and sharing relevant legal and regulatory developments.

  • Deliver training, coaching and support to business managers and colleagues, helping to foster a culture of learning and continuous development.

What are we looking for?


This is an excellent opportunity for a confident and solution-focused lawyer who combines strong technical expertise with commercial acumen, clear communication skills, exceptional stakeholder management skills and a dedication to supporting scientific discovery as it advances oncology diagnostics and therapeutics.

  • Qualified lawyer with strong legal training and relevant post-qualification experience gained in-house and/or in private practice.

  • Strong knowledge of commercial law and best practice, with working knowledge of intellectual property (particularly patents), commercial/company law, and data protection law.

  • Ability and willingness to rapidly acquire expertise in new legal areas and adapt to emerging business and legal issues.

  • Commercially minded, pragmatic and solution-focused, applying sound legal judgement to deliver practical business outcomes.

  • Skilled in drafting, reviewing and negotiating legal agreements and providing clear, actionable legal advice.

  • Able to identify, assess and manage legal and business risks, resolving routine issues independently and escalating complex matters appropriately.

  • Proven ability to work independently, manage a varied workload, prioritise effectively and deliver high-quality work under pressure and to tight deadlines.

  • Strong interpersonal, communication and relationship-building skills, with the ability to develop effective internal and external networks and collaborate across teams.

  • Client-focused, with a strong understanding of commercial objectives and a commitment to delivering responsive, clear, pragmatic and business-oriented support.

  • Positive team player who develops strong and supportive professional relationships with other team members and contributes to the success of the wider Legal Team.

Our organisation values are designed to guide all that we do.

Bold: Act with ambition, courage and determination

Credible: Act with rigour and professionalism

Human: Act to have a positive impact on people

Together: Act inclusively and collaboratively

We’re looking for people who can believe in and embody these organisation values and can use them to drive forward progress against our mission to beat cancer.

What will I gain?

This is a collegiate, supportive and collaborative team, highly-regarded by its business partners and very proud winner of The Lawyer’s In-house Legal Team of the Year 2025. We provide a wide range of career and personal development opportunities, highly interesting and mission-driven work projects and a generous benefits package. Our policies and processes support your career development, work-life balance and personal wellbeing.

You can explore our benefits by visiting our careers web page.

How do I apply?

We operate an anonymised shortlisting process in our commitment to equality, diversity and inclusion. CVs are required for all applications; but we won’t be able to view them until we invite you for an interview. Instead, we ask you to complete the work history section of the online application form for us to be able to assess you fairly and objectively. We would ask that you follow this process and please refrain from contacting members of the team directly regarding this opportunity.

For more information on this career opportunity please visit our website or contact us at recruitment@cancer.org.uk.

For more updates on our work and careers, follow us on: Linked In, Facebook, Instagram, X and YouTube.

There’s a place for everyone at Cancer Research UK. Our vision is to create a charity where everyone feels like they belong, benefits from and participates in, the work we do. We're committed to creating an inclusive culture where everyone can be themselves and reach their full potential.

We actively encourage applications from people of all backgrounds and cultures, in particular those from ethnic minority backgrounds who are currently under-represented, and believe that a diverse workforce will help us to beat cancer sooner.

If you’re interested in applying and excited about working with us but are unsure if you have the right skills and experience we’d still love to hear from you. We don’t expect everyone to meet all of the criteria listed.

We want to see every candidate performing at their best throughout the job application process, interview process and whilst at work. We therefore ask you to inform us of any concerns you have or any adjustments you might need to enable this to happen by emailing us at recruitment@cancer.org.uk.

Unfortunately, we are unable to recruit anyone below the age of 18, so that we can protect young people from health & safety and safeguarding risks.
