title: Tax Intern - Summer 2027
description:
Job Description:

Since its founding more than 100 years ago, ITW has become one of the world’s leading diversified manufacturers of specialized industrial equipment, consumables, and related service businesses. We place a high premium on the development of innovative solutions–most of which are developed in tandem with our customers. And we continue to ensure that our customers receive timely, cost-effective service for the innovative products we provide.

ITW’s differentiated business model is composed of a set of unique core capabilities: our proprietary 80/20 business process, customer-back innovation, and our well-known decentralized entrepreneurial culture. These capabilities are unmistakably ITW—and key to our longevity and strong performance.

ITW’s products and solutions are at work all over the world, in deep-sea oil rigs, aerospace technology, bridges and wind turbines, healthcare, the spaces in which we live and work, the cars we drive, and the mobile devices we rely on. We are never, whether we know it or not, more than a few steps from an innovative ITW solution.

Today, ITW (NYSE: ITW) is a Fortune 300 global multi-industry manufacturing leader with revenue of $16.0 billion in 2025 and employs ~43,000 people operating in 49 countries. Our headquarters located in Glenview, IL. includes a fitness center at no cost to the employees, a cafe, outdoor volleyball courts, walking trails around the facility, employee resource groups, corporate discounts, dry cleaning services, covered/outdoor parking, and much more. We are just a block away from the nearest Metra station, allowing for an accessible commute to downtown Chicago.

More details on our benefits can be found on our website at

Paid Tax Compliance Internship

Internship Program Overview

ITW’s “80/20” front-to-back business model, along with our entrepreneurial culture, will provide you with the opportunity to work in an organization that is committed to innovation and creativity. Our program gives interns the chance to collaborate with their teams and participate in exciting, enterprise-wide projects. Some of our intern engagement highlights include intern kickoff events, professional workshops, lunch & learns, volunteering during ITW’s Day of Action, networking, and more.

ITW’s Tax internship program provides exposure to the challenging aspects of either Domestic or International Taxation. Interns are encouraged to think and act like entrepreneurs and are provided responsibility and autonomy to take ownership of projects and complete assigned tasks. As an intern, you will gain substantial personal learning and career development opportunities through ownership of real-world job assignments, strong coaching and mentorship, and networking with senior leaders across the enterprise.

Position Summary

ITW’s Tax Compliance Internship Program offers meaningful and hands-on experience designed to develop the skills of our interns under the mentorship of experienced tax professionals. Throughout the internship, interns will receive comprehensive internal training and gain exposure to various tax systems and processes. Interns will be involved in the preparation of federal and state tax compliance filings, assist with transfer pricing documentation, and work on real-world projects that directly contribute to our team’s goal of successful return filings. Interns will develop a deep understanding of tax regulations and best practices while collaborating with professionals in a dynamic, supportive environment. This summer internship not only provides marketable experience and practical knowledge but also introduces interns to our company’s unique approach to business. Exceptional performance during the internship may lead to a full-time employment offer upon graduation.

Requirements

  • Full-time work schedule (40hrs / week)

  • Position is in-person at ITW’s corporate campus in Glenview, Illinois

  • Work within a cross-functional tax department, with a core focus on corporate tax compliance. Assignments will include working on analysis, preparing federal forms 1120, 8858, 5471 and various state income tax returns.

  • Support state team in the estimated tax payment process by preparing calculations and related payment requisition forms.

  • Assist with special projects, including tax planning transactions and transfer pricing documentation.

  • The internship is an hourly position that pays at a rate of $30/hour

Qualifications

  • Pursuing a bachelor's or master’s degree in accounting, finance, or taxation

  • Demonstrated academic success

  • Strong verbal and written communication skills

  • Ability to multi-task and prioritize

  • Strong organizational skills

  • Ability to analyze and manage complex information and data

  • Attention to detail and self-review

  • Work independently and in a team environment

  • Computer proficiency with MS Office, AI, and Alteryx experience a plus

*ITW Tax Department is not currently hiring individuals for this position who now or in the future require sponsorship for employment visa status.

Compensation Information:

The hourly rate for this position is $30.00

title: Solicitor
description:
Solicitor (Cancer Research Horizons)

Reports to: Senior Solicitor

Directorate: Research & Innovation

Contract: Permanent

Hours: Full time 35 hours per week (other flexible-working requests will also be considered if it meets business needs)

Salary: £79,000 - £84,000 pa plus benefits

Location Stratford, London Office-based with high flexibility (1-2 days per week in the office)

Closing date: Sunday 20th September 2026 at 23.59

If there are any changes or adjustments that would make it easier for you to apply, please contact recruitment@cancer.org.uk or 020 3469 8400 as soon as possible.

Recruitment process: Initial virtual interview, followed by onsite F2F interview for successful candidates.

Please note: You must be eligible to work in the UK to apply for this vacancy. Cancer Research UK cannot offer visa sponsorship.

At Cancer Research UK, we exist to beat cancer.

To support our mission, we are looking for a dedicated, committed and engaged Solicitor to provide effective legal support to Cancer Research Horizons (CRH).

As the world’s biggest medical research charity, we’ve helped bring fourteen new cancer drugs to market. However, there is still an urgent need to bring more effective treatments to patients faster.

Cancer Research Horizons (CRH) is CRUK’s internal translation engine. CRUK’s established drug discovery teams operate under one organisation and leadership team. Our unique combination of cancer biology expertise and access to CRUK’s world-class academic network, coupled with cutting edge technology platforms and clinical expertise enables us to 1) bring new treatments to patients faster and 2) tackle the biggest challenges in discovering cancer drugs by seeking out more radical ideas and embracing risk in our bid to achieve success.

What will I be doing?

  • Provide timely, proactive, pragmatic and commercially-focused legal advice and solutions across a broad range of business activities, involving IP, commercial, corporate and data protection law and from time to time extending into other areas of legal practice such as software, pharmaceutical regulatory, insolvency and litigation .

  • Develop a strong understanding of CRH and CRUK's operations, building effective relationships with internal stakeholders, external clients and partners.

  • Draft, review and negotiate a wide range of agreements relating to collaborative research, intellectual property protection, commercialisation and spin-out activities.

  • Advise on and support spin-out transactions, including the negotiation and execution of associated legal agreements.

  • Manage actual and potential disputes, including instructing and overseeing external legal advisers.

  • Promote robust contract management and compliance practices, ensuring adherence to contractual, corporate and legislative requirements.

  • Support the development of policies relating to translational research, intellectual assets and other strategic legal matters.

  • Contribute to cross-functional projects and deal teams, identifying, managing and reporting significant legal and business risks.

  • Develop legal know-how resources, template agreements and guidance materials, while monitoring and sharing relevant legal and regulatory developments.

  • Deliver training, coaching and support to business managers and colleagues, helping to foster a culture of learning and continuous development.

What are we looking for?


This is an excellent opportunity for a confident and solution-focused lawyer who combines strong technical expertise with commercial acumen, clear communication skills, exceptional stakeholder management skills and a dedication to supporting scientific discovery as it advances oncology diagnostics and therapeutics.

  • Qualified lawyer with strong legal training and relevant post-qualification experience gained in-house and/or in private practice.

  • Strong knowledge of commercial law and best practice, with working knowledge of intellectual property (particularly patents), commercial/company law, and data protection law.

  • Ability and willingness to rapidly acquire expertise in new legal areas and adapt to emerging business and legal issues.

  • Commercially minded, pragmatic and solution-focused, applying sound legal judgement to deliver practical business outcomes.

  • Skilled in drafting, reviewing and negotiating legal agreements and providing clear, actionable legal advice.

  • Able to identify, assess and manage legal and business risks, resolving routine issues independently and escalating complex matters appropriately.

  • Proven ability to work independently, manage a varied workload, prioritise effectively and deliver high-quality work under pressure and to tight deadlines.

  • Strong interpersonal, communication and relationship-building skills, with the ability to develop effective internal and external networks and collaborate across teams.

  • Client-focused, with a strong understanding of commercial objectives and a commitment to delivering responsive, clear, pragmatic and business-oriented support.

  • Positive team player who develops strong and supportive professional relationships with other team members and contributes to the success of the wider Legal Team.

Our organisation values are designed to guide all that we do.

Bold: Act with ambition, courage and determination

Credible: Act with rigour and professionalism

Human: Act to have a positive impact on people

Together: Act inclusively and collaboratively

We’re looking for people who can believe in and embody these organisation values and can use them to drive forward progress against our mission to beat cancer.

What will I gain?

This is a collegiate, supportive and collaborative team, highly-regarded by its business partners and very proud winner of The Lawyer’s In-house Legal Team of the Year 2025. We provide a wide range of career and personal development opportunities, highly interesting and mission-driven work projects and a generous benefits package. Our policies and processes support your career development, work-life balance and personal wellbeing.

You can explore our benefits by visiting our careers web page.

How do I apply?

We operate an anonymised shortlisting process in our commitment to equality, diversity and inclusion. CVs are required for all applications; but we won’t be able to view them until we invite you for an interview. title: Radiology Tech Assistant
description:
Per Diem Radiology Tech Assistant

We are an 85-bed acute care community hospital in Westfield, Massachusetts. We provide access to the world-class doctors, treatments, diagnostics, and technology of the Baystate Health network. Our team members, including skilled, compassionate nurses and medical support staff members, provide advanced and compassionate care.

Summary:

Under the supervision of the radiologic technologist, this position is responsible for assisting the technologists, residents, and radiology attendings in exam rooms, and with guided interventional procedures. This position also calls patients from the waiting room into the changing area as well as prepares/explains the procedure to the patient according to departmental and hospital procedures. The technical assistant performs a variety of patient care and clerical duties while aiding patients, technologists, and radiologists. The technical assistant demonstrates excellent communication skills and effectively works with all staff


Job Responsibilities:

1) Managing the Patient Experience:

Greets patients promptly in warm, friendly manner demonstrating an appropriate amount of interest or concern. Smile, make eye contact, use welcoming language (hello, welcome, how can I help you today). Gather and/or verify patient demographics as needed.

Hospitality:

Maintain a clean patient and working space. Direct patient and family members to restrooms and other amenities. Check to see if there is any other way you can assist. Employees at this level are developing their skills and understanding of needs of the patients and their families or caregivers.

2) Practices the BH operating principles of Trust, Respect, Integrity, Collaboration, and Communication.

3) Maintains patient confidentiality consistent with hospital policy.

4) Knowledge of lifting mechanics and proper moving techniques. Is responsible for assisting in the transfer of patients on and off stretchers, beds, wheelchairs, and other as needed.

5) Technical assistant will keep patients informed of wait times, assisting and accompanying patients where possible, and as appropriate.

6) Performs terminal cleaning, and surface cleaning in accordance with the hospitals infection control practices and policies.

7) Observes all health and safety requirements including body substance precautions.

8) Assist patients as needed to bathroom or with urinal or bedpan.

9) Participates in department and team projects as requested and communicates effectively with team and patients.

10) Is skilled in handling transport, lifting, sliding, oxygen tanks, and IV poles as needed.

11) Is skilled in the use of all necessary computer software such as, but not limited to, Teletracking, Safety and Injury Reporting (SRS), Cerner, Radnet, Synapse, etc.

12) Assists with supplies and inventory. Properly puts stock away, as well as fills and empties laundry bins as needed.

13) Maintains yearly In-service validations. Attends departmental staff meetings. Other duties as requested.

14) Technical assistant will be responsible for clerical duties to including computer use, scheduling, report and image retrieval, obtaining and delivering of "wet reads", communicating with patients and offices over the phone and in person.

15) Technical assistant will be responsible for assisting technologist, and radiology resident/attending while performing interventional biopsy exams.

16) Technical assistant will assist the technologist in preparing exam trays for biopsy procedures.

17) Technical assistant will be responsible for assisting the technologist, resident, and radiology attending with pre, peri, and post patient care, as appropriate.

18) Performs all duties of a Radiology Technical Assistant I and II as necessary.

1) High school diploma or equivalent

2) Basic Life Support (BLS) from American Heart Association

Preferred Work Experience:

1) Medical Terminology and previous patient care.

Skills and Competencies:

1) Excellent verbal and written communications skills.

With hybrid work flexibility, comprehensive healthcare benefits, financial wellness programs, and cultural celebrations, we foster a holistic workplace experience. Additionally, the team plays a vital role in maintaining high standards of service delivery and contributes to Zelis’ award-winning culture.

Position Overview

We are seeking a Senior Data Engineer with strong hands-on experience in Snowflake and dbt to design, build, and optimize scalable cloud data solutions. The ideal candidate will have expertise in developing ELT pipelines, dimensional/data modeling, SQL optimization, and implementing reliable data transformation frameworks using dbt. The role requires close collaboration with data engineering, analytics, and business teams to deliver high-quality, governed, and performant data products.

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable data pipelines and data models using Snowflake and dbt.

  • Collaborate with upstream/downstream teams to understand data requirements and deliver reliable datasets.
  • Support CI/CD and automated deployment processes for dbt projects across environments.

Required Skills

  • Strong hands-on experience with Snowflake.
  • Strong hands-on experience with dbt (Data Build Tool).
  • Advanced SQL and strong understanding of query optimization.
  • Experience designing and implementing ELT/data transformation pipelines.
  • Strong understanding of data warehousing, dimensional modeling, fact/dimension tables, and SCD concepts.
  • Experience with Git and CI/CD development practices.
  • Experience implementing data quality, testing, monitoring, and documentation.
  • Strong debugging, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

Preferred Skills

  • Experience with Python for data engineering and automation.
  • Experience with orchestration tools such as Airflow.
  • Exposure to cloud platforms such as AWS or Azure.
  • Experience with dbt Cloud, including jobs, environments, deployments, and CI.
  • Familiarity with Snowflake security, RBAC, performance tuning, and cost optimization.

Ideal Experience: 5+ years in Data Engineering, including significant hands-on experience with Snowflake and dbt.

title: Van data analist naar data engineer
description:
Je bent data analist en wil meer bouwen aan de achterkant: stabiele datapipelines, slimme modellen en betrouwbare platforms. In ons 1,5-jarig programma groei je stap voor stap naar de rol van volwaardig Data Engineer. Je werkt projectmatig bij een opdrachtgever, met ruimte om jouw route te kiezen. Blijf jezelf voor: we helpen je vooruit, op jouw manier. Na 1,5 jaar kun je na jouw opleiding in dienst treden bij de opdrachtgever!

Dit ga je doen

Je volgt een leerroute richting Data Engineer en past die direct toe in je opdracht. Je ontwerpt en bouwt datapipelines (batch en/of realtime) en zet ETL-processen op, dit zodat je geen frustratie meer ervaart omdat je zelf bepaalt hoe duurzaam en robuust het gebouwd wordt. Dit doe je samen met collega's. Je werkt mee aan het ontwerpen en bouwen van een dataplatform binnen een Microsoft Azure omgeving, waarbij je data uit verschillende bronnen samenbrengt en ontsluit. Dit doe je middels de Medaillion architectuur.

Je modelleert data en levert datasets op die klaar zijn voor rapportages en analyses. Je borgt kwaliteit met testen, monitoring en heldere documentatie, bijvoorbeeld via Microsoft Purview.

Je stemt af met stakeholders; de inhoud verschilt per opdrachtgever en project Je bent fit for the job als je... je minimaal 3 jaar ervaring hebt als data analist, data scientist of BI developer. je een hbo- of wo-diploma hebt behaald in Informatica, Data Science, (Technische) Bedrijfskunde, (Toegepaste) Wiskunde, Econometrie of vergelijkbaar. je een stevige basis hebt in Power BI en Python en/of SQL je ervaring hebt opgedaan met data modelleren binnen een cloud (Microsoft Azure) omgeving is een pré. je enige ervaring hebt met Azure Datafactory, Databricks/Spark, dbt, CI/CD (Azure Dev Ops), Tests & Monitoring en/of Git workflows of soortgelijke tools zijn een sterke pré.

Je jezelf committeert aan een ontwikkeltraject van 1,5 jaar en beschikbaar bent voor 36-40 uur per week. Dit krijg je van ons We bieden een salaris tussen de 3.800 en 6.000 euro bruto per maand op basis van 40 uur per week passend bij je ervaring en expertise. Vanuit jouw rol als data analist groei je op opdracht naar een data engineer. Wij zorgen voor passende opdrachten die deze ontwikkeling stap voor stap mogelijk maken. Het ontwikkelprogramma ondersteunt je hierin en versnelt jouw groei naar een volwaardig data engineer.

Je volgt praktische trainingen waarin je erkende certificeringen behaalt richting de Azure stack, krijgt coaching van je performance manager en maakt deel uit van een groep die dezelfde ontwikkeling doormaakt. Juist door samen te leren en ervaringen te delen, versnellen jullie elkaars groei. Ontdek of deze vacature goed bij u past door alle informatie hieronder te lezen.

Klik hier voor onze onepager met alle belangrijke informatie die je nodig hebt voordat je besluit te solliciteren op dit programma! Creëer je ideale thuiswerkplek met onze vergoeding Leer van Olympische topsporters hoe je topprestaties levert én volhoudt Trap je werkdag af op 2 wielen. Lease een (elektrische) fiets en blijf in beweging. Een premievrij pensioen. Goed geregeld!

Boost je salaris met onze verschillende bonussen Met 25 vakantiedagen heb je alle tijd voor jouw avonturen Met kennissessies en webinars blijf je bij in je vakgebied Op tijd naar je afspraak in je (elektrische) leaseauto Ontwikkel je onbeperkt met de Team EIFFEL Academy trainingen Mobiliteitsbudget: jij bepaalt hoe je reist Dit zijn wij Groot in interim capaciteit en sterk in consultancy, dat is EIFFEL. We versterken organisaties precies waar dat nodig is, of het nu gaat om een bank, gemeente of ziekenhuis.

Dat doen we door slimmer te werken, ideeën van papier naar praktijk te brengen en de juiste mensen op de juiste plek te zetten. Voor grote transformaties én snelle oplossingen. Van start up tot multinational: als professional bij EIFFEL kom je overal binnen. Binnen team Technology werken we in twee focusgebieden: Data & Analytics en IT. Job Summary

This position is responsible for supervising case managers and other program staff supporting residents in permanent supportive housing projects. The position also facilitates the operations of the collaborative Onsite Supportive Housing Services (OSHS) team, including staff scheduling, ensuring development and maintenance of care plans for all residents, facilitating staff meetings, coordinating with internal and external service partners, monitoring performance, and ensuring compliance with agency/funder requirements and standards. The OSHS team requires employees to maintain commitment to and working knowledge of the principles of service delivery for homeless and service-enriched housing services.

Job Duties/Responsibilities

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to satisfactorily perform each of the essential duties/responsibilities listed below. Reasonable accommodation may be provided to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential duties/responsibilities of this job.

  1. Provides supervision to permanent supportive housing care coordinators, healthcare coordinator, peer support specialists, and/or street outreach staff, or other direct service positions with OSHS.
  2. Ensures consistent development and monitoring of individualized case plans for each program client.
  3. Ensures compliance with funder and fidelity requirements.
  4. Monitors staff performance, including frequency of client engagement.
  5. Conducts routine audits of case plans and client files and other required documentation and provides feedback to case managers.
  6. Coordinates staff training and professional development.
  7. Provides direction in crisis situations following agency protocols.
  8. Monitors program data quality and prepares reports needed for agency and funders, ensuring accuracy and timeliness for Spokane’s HMIS database.
  9. Ensures case manager compliance with agency procedures and standards.
  10. Assists with grant applications, budget preparations, and other grants managements activities as needed.
  11. Ensure both internal and external deadlines are met.
  12. Coordinates with internal and external service partners.
  13. Maintains on-call availability at nights and weekends, as needed.
  14. Uses appropriate administrative, fiscal, physical, and technical safeguards to ensure the confidentiality, integrity, and security of CCEW client protected health information (PHI), per regulations outlined in the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act of 1996 (HIPAA).
  15. Regularly utilizes all forms of communication (email, text, phone, etc.) and database practices necessary for this position and as directed by supervisor.
  16. As a mandated reporter, follows all procedures outlined in agency policies and procedures to report to the proper agency when there is suspicion and/or confirmation that a child or adult has been a victim of abuse or neglect.

title: Strength & Conditioning Coach (Glenview, IL)
description:
Job description


ETS Sports Performance Specialist

Join ETS Partner Adam Thielen as we open additional ETS Sports Performance locations across the country!


Position Overview:

We are seeking motivated and experienced Strength and Performance Specialists that are searching for a unique opportunity to work and flourish in the private sector of the Sports Performance industry. The ideal candidate would have a strong interest in working with youth, high school, college and professional athletes in an electric atmosphere utilizing proven next level training and business systems that continue to set ETS apart from the competition. In addition to being aligned with ETS Partner and NFL All Pro Adam Thielen among other notable current and past professional athletes, the candidate will immediately be surrounded by one of our elite ETS Sports Performance Facility Directors along with a host of other successful ETS Performance Specialists from across the country. The entire “ETS Family” will be there to assist and support the Performance Specialist to enhance and maximize the development of our athletes at the highest possible level. This opportunity includes a very competitive industry level salary, full benefits along with a financial and personal development growth and promotions plan that can’t be matched.


ETS Training Philosophy:

The ETS training philosophy is to provide every athlete (regardless of age and sport) the opportunity to significantly improve their relative strength, power, linear and lateral speed, ability to biomechanically master the art of deceleration while also significantly improving their overall athleticism and becoming less prone to injury. Our systematic and step by step approach to developing better athletes will dramatically improve performance on the field, court, track, pool or ice.

Each athlete will take part in a progressive ability-appropriate plan of strength, speed, agility and deceleration training that will not only allow them to maximize their skills and athleticism for their sport, but also improve their overall athleticism. It’s crucial for every athlete to develop the basic-fundamental athletic and biomechanical movements, strength techniques and deceleration protocols through a customized plan in order to truly maximize their potential.

We believe the missing link in most programs is the lack of consistent and professional emphasis and attention to detail on the basics of an athlete’s complete athletic development separated from their sport-specific skill work. Our vision is that every athlete will experience an unmatched next level training atmosphere that is equally focused on character development, accountability and competition as it is the next level performance results that every athlete will gain. Our goal is for every athlete to leave each session understanding the physical objective for that session, but also understand the importance of consistency, dedication and commitment to ensure they are maximizing their results.


Position Qualifications:

  • Post graduate experience in the Strength/Conditioning or Performance field.
  • Must be a former competitive athlete and possess an accredited professional certification.
  • Outgoing, motivating and personable with a willingness to learn and continue growing.
  • Sports-minded with a strong desire for continual development of leadership skills.
  • Enjoys working with kids of all ages and ability levels.
  • Patient yet persistent with the task at hand.
  • Exercise Science/athletics or business background.
  • Accountable and dependable - on time and willing to put forth the extra effort.
  • Graduating GPA of a 2.5 or higher.


The ETS Opportunity:

With ETS being in significant growth mode we are looking to develop our Sports Performance Specialists in preparation for a larger role within our company. Mastering of the unique ETS training and business systems will provide each Sports Performance Specialist the opportunity to enter in our “ETS University Pool” of development to run and operate one of our new upcoming ETS locations.

In recap, this unique and one-of-a-kind opportunity offers the following:

  • Competitive fair market base salary, 401k, + incentives.
  • Health, dental, and vision benefits package.
  • Opportunity to enter in our Directors in Training (ETS University) Pool for future growth, promotion and expansion opportunities.
  • Personal growth, continued education, and career development.

title: Production Operative
description:
Closing Date for Application:

Sunday 20/09/2026

ADEY, the market leader in the provision of residential water treatment products for closed loop heating and cooling systems in the UK, is looking for a Business Development Manager to join the team.

Part of the Genuit Groups’ Climate Management Solutions (CMS) business unit, ADEY has ambitious growth plans to continue protecting the world's heating and cooling systems, to have a positive impact on the environment and people's lives.

The Role

As Production Operative, you are responsible for the assembly of the filters, Sure-stop, Sub-assemblies or Chemical area at the core of the role, production operators, coordinate and assemble various filters on a hourly/daily basis so that products are provided safely, while meeting or exceeding the hourly production target, to the required quality standard. You will work in close partnership with the Line leader and other production ops to ensure timely production of products. A large part of the role is working in making Filters, Sure-stop or in the Chems area making finished goods for our customers.

Working hours - on a Rota Shift:

AM Shift 05:30-13:45 Mon – Thu & Fri 05:30-12:30

PM Shift 14:00-23:00 Mon – Thu & Fri 13:00 - 17:0

Working style: On site - STONEHOUSE, GLOUCESTER GL10

Responsibilities

As a production Operator, you work in any filter cell usually in a max of 4 people to maximise productivity.

You will need to:

  • Work in the Production Line to complete the assembly of any filter job planned in any given cell.

  • Communicate with other colleagues or line lead if any issues arise.

  • Understand how all equipment and test machines work; promptly report defective equipment or parts and systems to avoid downtime to line lead or Shift supervisor.

  • Ensure you are at your workstation at shift start and leave at the shift end at the correct time.

  • Take allocated break times when required.

  • Record production numbers, serial numbers if applicable on an hourly basis if required.

  • Ensure Production Line is cleaned down thoroughly 10min at the end of the shift and at the end of each order if moving to another Line.

  • To work in any of the production cells, Filter, Sure-stop or Sub assembly or Chemical areas if required.

  • To be able to do the blending and mixing in the Chemical area.

  • To achieve the set targets required in the given production areas.

  • Be required to train and operate in 3 operations out of 4 in the Filter cells.

  • To load or unload cells / line as instructed by Line lead.

Quality:

  • Be aware of any Quality Alerts.

  • Report all defects to line lead in order that inventory and quality records are maintained and accurate.

  • Be accountable for the quality of the product produced and follow quality procedures rigorously.

  • Suggest ways to improve product quality via ECR’s, or Continuous Improvement suggestions

Health & Safety:

  • Ensure the prompt reporting of any accidents and near misses to Line lead or Supervisor in line with ADEY policy.

  • Wear any specified PPE, Hi-Vis, safety shoes or safety glasses when applicable in the production areas.

  • Adherence to objectives and H&S policy where required.

  • Ensure that health and safety guidelines are always followed; immediately address safety concerns.

The Person

  • Experience in a production / assembly factory desired but not essential.

  • Planning and organization skills to be able run and monitor the production line.

  • Attention to detail to ensure high levels of quality.

  • The ability to communicate clearly and with your Line lead / Supervisor.

  • The ability to work under pressure and multitask.

  • The ability to work in a logical, systematic manner.

  • The ability to work under pressure and to tight deadlines.

The Benefits

  • 23 days holiday

  • Pension contribution matched up to 8%

  • Life Assurance 3x base salary

  • Private health scheme

  • Genuit sharesave scheme

Here at the Genuit Group we recognise and develop the contribution our people make to the Group’s success and are committed to attracting talent from the widest pool. We have a role to play in making the built environment more sustainable, building a low carbon business ourselves as well as delivering sustainable solutions at scale.

title: Instructional Math Coach - Northeast - 26-27 SY
description:
Make a Lasting Impact in Classrooms Across the Region
Join the National Training Network (NTN) as an Instructional Math Coach and help transform math instruction for teachers and students alike. As a key member of our Professional Development team, you'll work closely with educators, school leaders, and district staff to bring NTN’s proven methodologies to life in classrooms.

This is more than just a coaching role—it’s an opportunity to empower teachers, raise student achievement, and help schools build a strong foundation for long-term success in mathematics.

Why Join NTN?

At NTN, we believe in the power of great teaching—and we know that behind every great teacher is a strong support system. As a Math Coach, you’ll be at the forefront of that support, delivering personalized coaching, leading impactful professional development sessions, and guiding schools through data-informed instructional improvements. A current coaches shared that working with NTN gives them “the opportunity to be a true change agent. As a classroom teacher, I was able to impact the students in my own classroom. With NTN, I have the opportunity to grow teachers, which in turn impacts hundreds, sometimes thousands, of students.”


We also recognize and reward your expertise with a supportive team environment, competitive benefits, and opportunities for professional growth.

What You’ll Do

  • Model best practices through engaging math lesson demonstrations
  • Lead interactive, standards-based training sessions rooted in NTN methodology
  • Coach and mentor teachers to improve classroom instruction and student outcomes
  • Collaborate with school and district leaders to align efforts and meet professional development goals
  • Analyze classroom data and help teachers plan purposeful, standards-aligned instruction
  • Provide actionable feedback and complete regular reports on coaching impact
  • Stay current with trends in mathematics education and contribute to continuous program improvement

What We’re Looking For

  • Certified educator with at least 5 years of math teaching experience (3+ consecutive years in the classroom)
  • Current Teaching License
  • Strong knowledge of Common Core State Standards – Mathematics (K–12) and Standards for Mathematical Practice (or your state specific process and content standards)
  • Skilled in mentoring, instructional coaching, and classroom observation
  • Mastery-level content knowledge and the ability to inspire and support educators
  • Effective communicator with excellent verbal and written skills
  • Proficient in planning, feedback, and data analysis
  • Familiarity with NTN’s Key Elements to Mathematics Success curriculum is a plus

Position Details

  • Full-time with competitive salary and comprehensive benefits:
    • Health, dental, and vision insurance
    • 401(k) with matching
    • Paid time off
    • Life insurance
    • Referral program
    • Cost of Living Adjustment (based on area of service)
    • Mileage reimbursement
    • Renewal Commissions
    • Performance Bonuses
  • Monday–Friday schedule, approx. 8-hour workdays
  • Travel may be required within your assigned region:
    • Northeast covers New York City, Trenton, and Hillside

Prefer Part-Time?

We also offer a part-time independent contractor option, compensated at a daily rate of $340 per day. Just indicate “Part-Time” when applying.

If you're passionate about supporting teachers and improving student success in math, we encourage you to apply and become a part of NTN’s mission-driven team.

Apply now and help us shape the future of math instruction—one classroom at a time.

title: Student Account Representative
description:
The primary focus of this position is to provide comprehensive student account support and customer service within the Bursar’s Office. The Student Account Representative assists students and their parents with account-related questions and issues, researches and resolves student account discrepancies, and provides guidance regarding billing, payments, financial aid, payment plans, and University policies and procedures.

The position is responsible for reviewing and maintaining student accounts, posting financial aid and other applicable payments or adjustments, assisting with registration clearance, and establishing Tuition Payment Plans. The Student Account Representative monitors active payment plans to ensure scheduled payments are received and follows up with students regarding upcoming, missed, or outstanding installments. The position proactively communicates with students to encourage timely payments and assists them in resolving payment-related issues or questions.

The Student Account Representative communicates and interacts with students, parents, and other customers to provide accurate, timely, and effective customer service. This includes receiving, researching, and appropriately responding to inquiries and concerns regarding student accounts, billing statements, payment plans, financial aid, Bursar’s Office services, University policies and procedures, and other related matters. The position also provides guidance and education to students and parents to help them understand their financial responsibilities and available payment options.


ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Student Account Advising and Customer Service

Provides knowledgeable and responsive assistance to students, parents, and other customers regarding student financial accounts and Bursar’s Office services.

● Advise students and parents regarding tuition, fees, educational expenses, account balances, and payment options.

● Respond to inquiries regarding student accounts, billing statements, registration, financial aid, transcripts, student records, payment plans, loans, refunds, and related Bursar’s Office services.

● Research customer inquiries and complaints and provide accurate and timely resolutions or referrals.

● Explain University policies, procedures, deadlines, and financial requirements in a clear and customer-focused manner.

● Maintain confidentiality when handling student financial and educational information.


Student Account Management and Reconciliation

Maintains accurate student account information and researches and resolves account discrepancies.

● Review, maintain, and update student account information and financial records.

● Research, analyze, and resolve discrepancies involving charges, payments, financial aid, credits, adjustments, refunds, and other account activity.

● Verify account information and supporting documentation to ensure accuracy and compliance with established policies and procedures.

● Coordinate with University departments and personnel to resolve account discrepancies and obtain information necessary to support accurate financial records.

● Maintain appropriate documentation of account research, adjustments, and resolutions.


Tuition Payment Plans

Administers and monitors Tuition Payment Plans and provides students with guidance regarding their payment obligations.

● Counsel students and parents regarding Tuition Payment Plan options, enrollment requirements, payment schedules, deadlines, and applicable policies.

● Assist students with establishing and maintaining Tuition Payment Plans in accordance with University guidelines.

● Monitor active payment plans to ensure scheduled installments are received timely.

● Identify missed, delinquent, or outstanding payment-plan installments.

● Proactively contact students regarding upcoming, missed, or outstanding payments and encourage timely resolution of their account obligations.

● Assist students in understanding payment-plan requirements and resolving payment-related questions or issues.

● Document student outreach, payment activity, and resolutions related to payment plans.

● Refer unresolved or escalated payment-plan matters to the appropriate supervisor or department.


Financial Clearance and Registration Support

Supports the University's financial clearance and registration processes by identifying outstanding balances and coordinating registration restrictions and clearances.

● Identify students with uncleared or outstanding balances and work with students to resolve account issues.

● Create and maintain registration-block lists based on established University guidelines.

● Communicate registration blocks and financial clearance requirements to students and appropriate school or departmental representatives.

● Document waivers or exceptions approved by authorized University personnel.

● Maintain waiver records and statistics for monitoring and follow-up.

● Assist students in understanding the requirements necessary to achieve financial clearance.


Financial Aid and Student Account Transactions

Processes and maintains financial transactions affecting student accounts and assists students with understanding the impact of financial aid and payments on their balances.

● Post financial aid and other authorized payments, adjustments, credits, and account transactions.

● Advise students and parents regarding the relationship between tuition costs, financial aid, account balances, and fiscal clearance.

● Process student account refunds and other financial transactions in accordance with established guidelines.

● Review transactions and supporting documentation to ensure accuracy.

● Research and resolve issues related to financial aid posting and other student account activity.

● Assist with the preparation of special accounting and student account reports for administrative use.


University Department and School Coordination

Maintains effective working relationships with University departments, schools, and programs to support accurate and timely student account services.

● Maintain familiarity with the policies, procedures, programs, and account-related requirements of assigned departments, schools, and/or programs.

● Serve as a liaison with appropriate school and departmental representatives regarding student account and financial clearance matters.

● Obtain and provide information necessary to verify or support the accuracy of financial records.

● Communicate relevant policy, procedure, and account-related information to Bursar’s Office staff.

● Collaborate with University personnel to resolve student account issues and ensure compliance with established policies and procedures.


Account Collections, Documentation, and Reporting

Maintains documentation and information necessary to support the monitoring and collection of outstanding student account balances.

● Maintain documentation related to outstanding student account balances.

● Identify and track students with unresolved or delinquent accounts.

● Maintain records that support collection activities for graduated, withdrawn, or otherwise inactive students.

● Maintain statistics related to outstanding accounts, payment plans, registration blocks, waivers, and other assigned activities.

● Identify trends and recurring issues related to student accounts and communicate significant concerns to the supervisor.

● Assist with preparing reports and analyses for administrative review and decision-making.


Correspondence and Administrative Support

Processes correspondence and performs administrative activities necessary to support the effective operation of the Bursar’s Office.

● Receive, review, analyze, and respond to written and electronic correspondence regarding student accounts and related matters.

● Research account information and provide appropriate responses or referrals.

● Identify patterns and trends in student inquiries and account-related problems and communicate concerns to the supervisor as appropriate.

● Process accounting and student account documents in accordance with established guidelines.

● Assist with planning, coordinating, and implementing registration and orientation fee payment activities and related logistics.

● Perform other related duties incidental to the work described herein.


EDUCATION, CERTIFICATIONS, AND/OR EXPERIENCE

Required

● Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, Higher Education, or a related field; or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.

● Two (2) years of experience in student accounts, accounting, finance, customer service, higher education administration, or a related area.

● Experience working with financial records, account transactions, billing, payments, or reconciliation.

● Experience providing customer service and communicating financial information to students, parents, or other customers.

● Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, particularly Microsoft Word and Excel.

● Experience working with ERP, student information, or financial systems; experience with Jenzabar or similar systems preferred.

● Ability to maintain confidentiality and appropriately handle sensitive student financial and educational information.

● Demonstrated ability to research and resolve account discrepancies and accurately process financial transactions.

● Ability to exercise sound judgment, prioritize multiple responsibilities, and work effectively with limited supervision.


Preferred

● Experience working in a college or university Bursar’s Office, Student Accounts, Financial Aid, or related student services area.

● Experience administering or monitoring tuition payment plans.

● Experience with student account billing, financial aid posting, refunds, registration clearance, or collections.

● Experience with Jenzabar or other higher education ERP/student information systems.

● Experience using Excel to maintain, organize, and analyze financial or student account data.

● Knowledge of higher education billing, student account practices, and financial aid processes.

● Knowledge of University policies and procedures related to student accounts, payment plans, registration clearance, and financial obligations.


Core Competencies

● Student-centered customer service

● Student account management and reconciliation

● Payment plan administration and monitoring

● Financial transaction processing and accuracy

● Research and problem-solving

● Attention to detail and data accuracy

● Effective written and verbal communication

● Confidentiality and professional judgment

● Organization and time management

● Ability to interpret and apply policies and procedures

● Collaboration and teamwork

● Proficiency with ERP and student information systems


Other Specifications

● Working knowledge of basic accounting principles and financial transaction processes.

● Ability to understand and explain student account balances, billing statements, payment requirements, and payment-plan options.

● Ability to research account discrepancies and identify appropriate solutions or referrals.

● Ability to communicate financial information clearly and professionally to students, parents, faculty, staff, and other University constituents.

● Ability to handle sensitive and confidential information with discretion and professionalism.

● Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks, deadlines, and student inquiries simultaneously.

● Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy in financial and student account transactions.

● Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with students, parents, University departments, and colleagues.

● Ability to work independently while recognizing when issues require escalation to a supervisor or other University department.

● Commitment to providing responsive, respectful, and student-centered service.


Physical Demands & Work Environment

● Primarily sedentary office work with extended periods of computer use.

● Frequent use of computers, telephones, and other standard office equipment.

● Occasional standing, walking, bending, and lifting of materials or supplies weighing up to 10 pounds.

● Ability to work effectively in a customer-facing environment with frequent interaction with students, parents, and University personnel.

● Ability to work under established deadlines while managing multiple priorities and interruptions.

● Work requires a high level of accuracy, attention to detail, confidentiality, and professionalism.

● Regular interaction with a diverse population of students, parents, faculty, staff, and other University constituents.

title: Lead Strategy & Vision
description:
At ING, procurement is about collaboration, innovation, and creating strategic impact that drives sustainable growth. We are a global organization in the CFO domain with a presence in more than 20 countries. We embed responsible practices, and deliver solutions that touch every part of the organization. If you thrive in a dynamic environment, approach challenges with curiosity, and want to help shape what’s next, this is your opportunity to make a real difference.

The Team

The Strategy & Excellence team is part of Global Procurement and is led by the Head of Strategy & Excellence, who reports directly to the Global Chief Procurement Officer (CPO). The team is responsible for shaping and driving Procurement's strategic agenda through key areas such as Strategy & Vision, Transformation & Change, ESG, Innovation & Technology, and Performance & Employee Experience.

In this role, you will join a team of senior (change) experts reporting to the Head of Strategy & Excellence. You will have the opportunity to influence strategic decisions, shape the future direction of Procurement, and deliver meaningful impact on a global scale. You will work closely with the Global CPO, Procurement Leadership Team and senior stakeholders across ING.

The Role

As Lead Strategy & Vision, you will:

  • Lead and govern major strategic initiatives and transformation programs across the Procurement organization, ensuring successful delivery and achievement of intended outcomes.
  • Manage complex projects and workstreams, coordinating dependencies and ensuring alignment across related initiatives.
  • Drive change adoption through structured change management approaches that embed desired behaviours, ways of working, and culture.
  • Independently lead high-impact strategic initiatives, proactively identifying opportunities and delivering results.
  • Guide and influence both direct and indirect teams, fostering collaboration across multiple stakeholders and organizational boundaries.
  • Act as a trusted strategic advisor, bringing clarity and direction to complex business challenges.
  • Provide strategic and tactical guidance to management, leveraging a deep understanding of the organization, the external environment, and industry best practices.
  • Support Category Management in developing and executing category strategies that contribute to Procurement's objectives.

In addition, you will:

  • Monitor and assess the effectiveness of the Procurement strategy, identifying opportunities for continuous improvement.
  • Act as the key liaison between Global Procurement and supporting functions across ING, ensuring alignment on strategic priorities, data capabilities, reporting requirements, and enabling initiatives.
  • Shape and drive Procurement's data and reporting strategy, translating business needs into actionable insights, performance reporting, and decision-making capabilities.
  • Leverage data, analytics and emerging technologies to strengthen decision-making, enhance performance transparency, and identify opportunities to increase Procurement's strategic impact.
  • Anticipate external trends, emerging technologies and market developments to inform Procurement's future direction.
  • Analyze ING's corporate strategy and identify implications and opportunities for the Procurement function.
  • Develop and maintain Procurement's strategic roadmap, including priorities, targets, KPIs, and success measures.
  • Own the portfolio of strategic initiatives and associated reporting, ensuring transparency, accountability, and effective financial oversight.
  • Identify and implement opportunities to improve the effectiveness, efficiency, and overall impact of the Procurement function.

Strategic Challenges:

One of the key challenges in this role, and across the broader organisation, is supporting the transition from a business partner model to a category-focused approach. Success in this position will depend on the ability to support the embedding of category management practices, in close collaboration with local procurement teams, thereby unlocking strategic category opportunities. Importantly, this challenge extends beyond capability building in alignment with global direction; it also involves ensuring the consistent adoption and practical application of these capabilities across all locations.

Join us if you want to be part of the next chapter of procurement journey at ING.

How to succeed

We hire smart people for their potential. Our biggest expectation is that you'll stay curious, keep developing yourself, and take ownership. In return, we'll support you in growing into an even stronger version of yourself.

This role is ideal for someone who combines strategic thinking with strong execution capabilities and thrives in a complex, international environment. You are comfortable navigating ambiguity, driving change, and influencing stakeholders at all levels of the organization.

To be successful in this role, you bring:

  • A university degree, preferably at Master's level.
  • Strong experience (>8 years) in transformation and change management.
  • Proven experience within Procurement organisation, ideally in a large international company, preferably within financial services.
  • Experience working in a global environment and collaborating with offshore / geographically dispersed teams.
  • Excellent communication skills with full professional proficiency in English, both written and spoken.
  • Strong project and program management capabilities, with the ability to coordinate multiple stakeholders and priorities.
  • Understanding of regulatory and compliance requirements relevant to Procurement within a regulated environment.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to turn insights into actionable recommendations.
  • A strategic mindset, balancing long-term vision with practical execution.
  • The ability to influence, build consensus, and effectively manage challenging stakeholder situations.
  • A self-driven, proactive personality with a strong sense of ownership and the agility to adapt in a changing environment.

Rewards and benefits
We want to make sure that it’s possible for you to strike the right balance between your career and your private life. Find out more about our employment conditions.


The benefits of working with us at ING include:

  • 25-28 vacation days depending on contract

  • Pension scheme

  • 13th month salary

  • 8% Holiday payment

  • Hybrid working

  • Personal growth and challenging work with endless possibilities

  • An informal working environment with innovative colleagues

About us
Curious about how ING empowers people and businesses to move forward?

Discover what we do and what we can offer you.

Questions?
Please visit our Frequently Asked Questions section to find some answers on questions you might have. If you're questions are not answered, you can also contact the recruiter attached to the advertisement. Want to apply directly? Please upload your CV and motivation letter by clicking the ‘Apply’ button.

title: IT Area Lead CoE AI TechNL
description:
We are TECH NL. We drive sustainable progress for all, powered by technology.

Our purpose is to serve our customers in the best possible way by creating reliable, secure, scalable, and responsible digital capabilities.

Artificial Intelligence is becoming a structural capability in how ING designs, builds and governs software delivery. AI-assisted and agentic workflows are changing the software development lifecycle and creating the opportunity to move from today’s human-only delivery model towards an AI-supported, and over time more AI-native, delivery model.

Beyond AI for software development, ING NL is also seeing increasing adoption of AI solutions across business and operational domains. As AI becomes embedded in more processes and products, there is a growing need to ensure implementation is aligned, secure, scalable and compliant. This creates an opportunity to establish clear governance, common standards and effective orchestration across AI initiatives within ING Netherlands

The role

We are looking for a technology leader to become IT Area Lead within the Engineering & Reliability domain, responsible for the adoption of AI technology and enabling of engineering execution of the full software development lifecycle as it becomes increasingly supported by agentic AI.

This role is about 1) making AI-assisted and agentic development workflows usable, safe, measurable and scalable within ING’s engineering environment, from pilots to controlled experiments to full roll-out. 2) Ensuring alignment and orchestration on both global and local AI initiatives, for IT and for Operations. This role will lead and orchestrate the implementation of platforms and software provided by global, in such a way that these are optimally implemented for Retail NL.

As IT Area Lead, you will lead an engineering team that enables AI-supported software delivery across the ING Software development lifecycle (SDLC). Your mandate is 1) to ensure that this new way of working, the AI agents, development workflows, engineering platforms and SDLC controls work together in a controlled way, with humans remaining accountable for judgement, validation and outcomes. 2) Act as a gatekeeper and orchestrate and control AI tooling implementation on a local level. As this initiative grows, the managerial scope could increase in line with the growth of the initiative pending where the needs are.

Roles and responsibilities

As IT Area Lead AI delivery within Engineering & Reliability, you are firstly accountable for the engineering enablement layer of AI-assisted and agentic software delivery. Secondly, you are accountable for orchestration and controlling of all local AI initiatives that might surpass IT for IT only. You ensure that ING can develop, test and scale AI-supported SDLC capabilities in a consistent, controlled and measurable way. After testing, you ensure that these new capabilities are rolled out in a scalable manner for whole of ING NL.

You use the development platforms and agent workflows provided by group. With group, you define the engineering guardrails, SDLC integration points and delivery paths that allow teams to implement AI-supported development. Product and domain teams remain accountable for their products and outcomes; your role is to make sure the development workflow is technically sound, controlled and reusable.

You will be part of the Engineering & Reliability leadership structure and report into the Engineering & Reliability IT Lead within Tech NL. You will lead a team of engineers and integrators who aid in the development and integration of AI tooling and this new AI native operating model. Based on the size and success of the new operating model, this team might grow in the future.

Key accountabilities

In this role, you will be expected to provide clear mandate, structure and engineering discipline for AI-supported development across the full software development lifecycle.

You will be successful in this role when you:

  • Lead the engineering implementation and guide execution of AI-supported software delivery as agentic AI becomes embedded in the software development lifecycle.
  • Align with ING Group on all AI IT for IT projects and support implementation
  • Act as a gatekeeper for new AI tools to ensure safe and reliable implementation of AI for Operation tools on a local level.
  • Focus the scope on AI for development purposes: requirements translation, planning, specification, design, coding support, testing support, review preparation and controlled handover into the regular engineering process.
  • Own the NL technical integration of AI-supported workflows into ING’s development environment, including Nanites, GitHub, repositories, CI validation, pull requests, quality checks and engineering controls.
  • Ensure teams use standard platform capabilities, agents and workflows, avoiding local workarounds, parallel tooling or human re-coding outside the agreed SDLC setup.
  • Design the development workflow around the principle that humans judge, validate, decide and remain accountable, while agents execute clearly bounded development tasks where feasible.
  • Define and enforce engineering guardrails for AI-generated or AI-assisted development outputs, including input quality, output quality, repository quality, traceability, reviewability and compliance with existing engineering standards.
  • Act as senior point of coordination between ING Group, Tech NL leadership, domain CIO/IT Leads, Architecture, CISO/Risk, Data and Operations to align priorities, resolve trade-offs and secure adoption of common AI delivery standards.
  • Develop and manage the area roadmap, capacity plan and budget input for AI-supported engineering enablement, including tooling adoption, platform integration effort, training needs, sourcing choices and measurable value realization.

What are we looking for?

We are looking for a technology leader who combines engineering leadership with practical understanding of AI-assisted software development, agentic workflows, SDLC controls and platform-based delivery in a regulated environment.

  • 7+ years of experience in complex technology environments, with a strong track record of leading, coaching and developing high-performing teams.
  • Experience with influencing and managing stakeholders at an executive level
  • Proven track record of collaboration with NL Executive Committee on AI topics
  • Involvement in strategic implementation of AI on both a local and global level
  • Excellent knowledge of current AI development strategy within ING NL
  • Experience with software engineering, SDLC design, development platforms, CI/CD, repository management, engineering quality, reliability and production controls.
  • Strong understanding of the ING Retail Technical and Operations landscape
  • Broad Understanding of AI in the context of Financial institutions and ING
  • Someone who can lead, coach and develop a multidisciplinary engineering team, building the capabilities required for AI-supported software delivery.
  • Practical and deep understanding of AI-assisted engineering and agentic development workflows, including how developers work with tools such as GitHub Copilot, Nanites-like platforms, and agents.
  • Ability to translate a strategic AI-native delivery vision into concrete design, platform requirements, engineering guardrails, workflow controls and measurable scaling criteria.
  • Strong understanding of risk, security, architecture, data and compliance considerations in software delivery, with the ability to embed them into the development workflow from the start.
  • Ability to manage trade-offs between speed, developer experience, quality, control, cost, reliability and long-term scalability.
  • Excellent (senior) stakeholder management skills, with the ability to align Tech, Business, Risk, Architecture, Security, Data and Group Tech.
  • Strong learning orientation, with the discipline to start small, test deeply, measure impact and scale only where evidence supports it.
  • Clear execution authority and the ability to stop or redirect work when AI-supported development does not meet agreed engineering, quality, risk or control requirements.

title: Experienced Yield Analysis Engineer
description:
About Samsung Austin Semiconductor
Samsung is a world leader in advanced semiconductor technology, founded on the belief that the pursuit of excellence creates a better world. At Samsung Austin Semiconductor, we are Innovating Today to Power the Devices of Tomorrow.

Come innovate with us!

Position Summary

We are seeking a highly analytical and detail-oriented Yield and Process Control and Investigation(PCI) Engineer to join our semiconductor manufacturing team. In this role, you will be critical in monitoring wafer manufacturing processes, driving yield enhancement, and investigating process excursions. You will utilize advanced statistical process control (SPC), defect inspection data, and parametric testing results to identify root causes of yield limiters. Working closely with cross-functional teams—including Process, Equipment, and Integration engineering—you will implement robust solutions to ensure process stability, minimize defects, and maximize product yield.

Role and Responsibilities

Here’s What You’ll Be Responsible For:

  • Predictive Yield Modeling: Develop, implement, and validate complex yield prediction models that correlate inline metrology, defect inspection data and FDC(Fault Detection and Classification) metrics.
  • Baseline Forecasting: Forecast yield trajectories for ramping and mature technology nodes, proactively identifying yield risk areas before wafers reach EDS test.
  • Yield Analysis & Improvement: Drive end-to-end yield performance across wafer sort, parametric, and final tests by performing advanced data mining and statistical analysis to identify yield limiters and correlate detractors with electrical, inline, and defect data to implement improvement actions.
  • Root Cause & Failure Analysis: Drive yield stability by leading root cause analysis through structured methodologies, correlating electrical signatures with physical defects via EFA/PFA partnerships, and collaborating with Design and Product teams to eliminate layout-dependent yield limiters before ramping.
  • Data Science & Modeling: Apply advanced data science techniques and machine learning to build sophisticated yield models and automated analytics pipelines using Python, JMP, and SQL to enhance yield dataset analysis.
  • Yield Management: Lead comprehensive yield management by defining strategic roadmaps, KPIs, and improvement strategies, while managing major yield excursions, mentoring junior engineers, and communicating yield health and risks to executive leadership.

Skills and Qualifications

Here's what you'll need:

  • B.E. M.Sc. in Electrical Engineering, Materials Science, Physics, Applied Physics, or related field.

  • Understanding of semiconductor device physics and CMOS fabrication processes (Lithography, Etch, Thin Films, CMP, Diffusion, Implant).

  • Understanding of electrical parametric testing, defect inspection mechanisms.

  • Strong technical writing and presentation skills to effectively communicate technical data to diverse audiences.

  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, 24/7 cleanroom manufacturing environment.

  • Capable of managing multiple high-priority investigations simultaneously while collaborating seamlessly with cross-functional teams.

  • Proactive and organized with excellent verbal and written communication skills for reporting to "home teams" and global stakeholders.

  • Cross-functional leadership and communication.

  • Exceptional analytical problem-solving skills with a proven track record of resolving complex process excursions.

The current base salary range for this role is between $95,000 - $120,000. Individual base pay rates will depend on factors including duties, work location, education, skills, qualifications and experience. Total compensation for this position will include a competitive benefits package and may include participation in company incentive compensation programs, which are based on factors to include organizational and individual performance.

Total Rewards
At Samsung Austin Semiconductor, base pay is just one part of our total compensation package. The base compensation for this role will depend on education, experience, skills, and location.

We offer a comprehensive benefits package, including:

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance

title: Sr Scientist, Tech - Science
description:
About the role and team

Working in Science at Uber means solving complex problems in a high-stakes, fast-moving environment. You’ll turn massive amounts of unstructured data into focused plans of execution, navigating ambiguity to build technologies that directly influence every decision made in our marketplace. This isn't just about building models; it’s about making smart decisions with imperfect information and owning the outcomes in an environment where speed and scale can't be separated.

In this role, you’ll be the bridge between technical depth and business impact, solving messy, high-priority problems that don’t always have a textbook solution. You’ll thrive here if you possess an owner’s mindset, stay calm under pressure, and have the grit to drive projects through their entire lifecycle from idea inception to production. We’re looking for someone who thinks critically and moves with urgency to shape the future of how people and things move in the real world.

What you’ll do

  • Develop data-driven business insights by collaborating across disciplines: product, engineering, and operations to identify growth opportunities and recommend prioritization of high-impact initiatives.

  • Build and scale statistical, optimization, and machine learning models that provide both strategic insights and real-time production enhancements to global products.

  • Design and analyze complex experiments using A/B testing and causal inference to provide results that drive critical decision-making.

  • Unblock technical barriers by driving the creation of logging, metrics, and diagnostic tools that orient teams around data-driven product development.

  • Define how teams measure success by developing robust metrics in close partnership with cross-functional stakeholders to align on long-term impact.

  • Lead through influence by effectively communicating complex technical findings and outcomes to leadership and technical partners.

Basic Qualifications

  • Ph.D., M.S. or Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Machine Learning, Operations Research, Economics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or other quantitative fields.

  • 5+ years of industry experience as an Applied or Data Scientist or equivalent (or 3+ years with a Ph.D.).

  • Proficiency in at least one programming language (eg. R, Python, Java, Ruby, Scala/Spark or Perl).

  • Experience designing experiments and interpreting results across a variety of key performance indicators.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Ph.D. degree in a quantitative field such as Machine Learning, Operations Research, or Statistics.

  • Outstanding communication skills with a track record of influencing leadership and technical teams through storytelling and data-driven insights.

  • Experience leading high-complexity technical projects and substantially influencing the scope and output of others.

  • Proven ability to work efficiently with large-scale datasets (e.g., 100M+ rows) using Spark, Hive, or HDFS.

  • Thought leadership to drive multi-functional projects from initial concept to production.

title: Account Payable Specialist
description:
The AP Specialist provides operational support and leadership to the Accounts Payable (AP) team within the North American Shared Services Centre located in Vaughan, Ontario. This role requires a strong background in accounting, finance, and internal controls, with responsibilities that include leading investigations, performing reconciliations, resolving issues, supporting process improvements, and maintaining business process documentation. The AP Specialist is also responsible for driving change initiatives, ensuring follow-through on action plans, and delivering service excellence in a fast-paced, growing shared services environment. The role works closely with business leaders to support Treasury and Shared Services objectives through high-quality service delivery and analysis.



Key Responsibilities:

AP Accounts Clean-up and Reconciliations

  • Provide leadership support to the AP team in reviewing and clearing aging and long-outstanding account balances, both on AP subledger and general ledger. This includes reviewing existing account balances of vendors, clearing accounts and other GLs used, owned and/or impacted by the AP team.

  • Create and follow-through on action plans to clear long-outstanding balances, understand and evaluate the financial risks and implications and propose write-offs/write-ons to the P&L as needed.

  • Lead and close-out any existing recovery audit efforts (e.g. Broniec) and ensure that recovery is complete and recorded properly in the right GLs.

  • Assist in reviewing and posting monthly AP transactions, ensuring accuracy and completeness in terms of amounts, documentations, SoD and other controls compliance.

  • Review and improve all AP processes relating to recurring invoices (such as utilities, rent, courier, and other corporate charges managed centrally by the shared services team).

  • Work with other Accounting groups to accurately and timely close Accounts Payable per the established close schedule. Ensure certain general ledger accounts are reconciled and accounted for to maintain the integrity of the financial statements.

Process Improvement & Internal Controls

  • Identify and present solutions to the AP and Shared services leadership, for continuous process improvement opportunities.

  • Support the monitoring and execution of internal control procedures to ensure confidential records and company assets are adequately protected.

  • Support in maintaining all AP procedural controls to ensure that sufficient evidence is in place and is monitored/tracked in order to adhere to corporate policies.

  • Validate and report on all key performance indicators for AP team to Senior Management, for all established process benchmarks.

  • Support continuous improvement through automating manual processes to drive efficiencies.

  • Assist with internal and external audit & ad-hoc requests as required.

  • Work with team to support any escalations from vendors and internal Partners.

  • Leverage systems to support the core AP Team with inquiries related to vendor accounts.

  • Support ad-hoc ancillary tasks as needed.

Leadership and Team Management

  • Provide mentorship and guidance to the team and ensure team members meet reconciliation and audit deadlines.

  • Foster teamwork and communication within and across organizational boundaries.

  • Support staff training as required.

Knowledge, Skills and Competencies:

  • Comprehensive knowledge of standard accounts payable accounting principles, policies and procedures, and internal controls.

  • Previous experience working in a multi-entity, multi-database organization structure handling high volumes of data.

  • Strong leadership skills and ability to drive and inspire change.

  • Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills.

  • Business partnering - internal and external relationships.

  • Strong analytical, time management, planning and problem-solving skills.

  • Previous experience managing and training large teams.

  • Demonstrated ability for leveraging technology to solve complex business process matter.

Requirements:

  • 5+ years of experience in an Accounting, Finance or Internal Audit roles. Experience in Payments, Accounts Payable or Procurement role as a Manager or Supervisor is ideal.

  • Bachelor’s degree with a major in finance, business, procurement or accounting.

  • Previous experience with Great Plains or other major Financial ERP system (Microsoft GP is an asset).

  • Advanced MS Excel skills.

  • Broad based experience in accounting and financial systems.
